arguments.en_name: work done by electric vehicle traction force
energy required to release from gasoline

question.en: Natural gas is an important energy source in the daily life of city residents, known for its high calorific value and low pollution. Given the calorific value of natural gas q = 7×10^7 J/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃). Calculate: If 60% of this heat is absorbed by water with a mass of 100 kg and an initial temperature of 20℃, what is the temperature increase of the water? If this natural gas (assuming a volume of Vm^3) is completely burned, and 60% of this heat is absorbed by water with a mass of 100 kg and an initial temperature of 20℃, what is the temperature increase of the water? (Supplement: The heat absorbed by the water is [X]; ) the parameter contact area value is 0.25 m^2. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 10℃, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 天然气是城市居民日常生活中重要的能源，它具有热值高、污染小的优点。已知天然气的热值q=7×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）。求：若这些热量的60%被质量为100kg，初温为20℃的水吸收，则水升高的温度是多少？若这些天然气（假设体积为Vm^3）完全燃烧，且这些热量的60%被质量为100kg，初温为20℃的水吸收，则水升高的温度是多少？ （补充：水吸收的热量是[X]; ）参数接触面积的值为0.25 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [水升高的温度]*[水的比热容]*[水的质量]
en: [ heat absorbed by water] = [ increase in water temperature]*[specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water]

question.en:
Since March 1, 2021, Chengdu has officially implemented the "Regulations on Household Waste Management in Chengdu," which will play an important and positive role in building a park city demonstration area that practices new development concepts. These reasonably classified waste can be turned into treasure when utilized. If 1 ton of waste can extract [X] tons of fuel oil, and the calorific value of the fuel oil is 4.0×10^7 J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). Find:  
How much heat is released when the fuel oil produced from 1 ton of waste is completely burned? The value of the parameter piston area is 100 cm^2. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^9 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
成都从2021年3月1日起将正式实施《成都市生活垃圾管理条例》，这将对成都建设践行新发展理念的公园城市示范区发挥重要积极作用。这些合理分类的垃圾利用起来就可以变废为宝，如果1吨垃圾可以榨出[X]吨燃料油，若燃料油的热值为4.0×10^7J/kg，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）。求：
1吨垃圾产生的燃料油完全燃烧释放出的热量为多少？参数活塞面积的值为100 cm^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^9 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [燃料油质量] = [燃料油完全燃烧释放出的热量]/[燃料油的热值]
[每吨垃圾产生燃料油的质量] = [燃料油质量]
en: [ mass of fuel oil] = [ heat released from complete combustion of fuel oil]/[ calorific value of fuel oil]
[mass of fuel oil produced per ton of garbage] = [ mass of fuel oil]

arguments.en_name: mass of fuel oil produced per ton of garbage

arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of fuel oil

question.en:
A school boiler room needs to heat 5000 kg of water from 20°C to 100°C every day. Find:
When using gas as fuel to heat the water, assuming the heat released by the complete combustion of gas is [X] absorbed by the water, how much heat is released by the complete combustion of gas? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). The rated voltage is 220 V. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 2.1×10^9 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
某中学锅炉房每天要将5000kg水从20℃加热到100℃.求：
用煤气作为燃料来烧水，设煤气完全燃烧释放热量的[X]被水吸收，煤气完全燃烧要放出多少热量？水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数额定电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.1×10^9 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量]=[水的比热容]×[水的质量]×[水温升高的温度]
[效率] = [水吸收的热量]/[煤气完全燃烧需要放出的热量]
en: [ heat absorbed by water]=[specific heat capacity of water]×[ mass of water]×[ temperature increase of water]
[ efficiency] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ heat released by complete combustion of gas]

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gas

question.en: Methane is the main component of landfill gas obtained from urban waste treatment. If it is collected, it can be utilized. Each kilogram of household waste, after special treatment, can produce an average of [X] cubic meters of landfill gas. It is known that the calorific value of this gas is 8.1×10^7 J/m^3. Please answer the following questions: If all this heat is used to heat water, how many kg of water can be heated from 25°C to 100°C?[] The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C) and the parameter time value is 34 s. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 18 kg, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
甲烷是城市生活垃圾处理后所得垃圾气体的主要成分，若将它收集起来可加以利用，每千克生活垃圾经特殊处理后平均能产生[X]的垃圾气体，已知该气体的热值为8.1×10^7J/m^3，^.请回答下列问题：
若将这些热量全部用来烧水，可使多少kg的水从25℃升高到100℃？[]水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数时间的值为34 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是18 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度差]=[水的末温]-[水的初温]
[水吸收的热量] = [水升高的温度差]*[水的比热容]*[水的质量]
[垃圾气体完全燃烧放出的热量] = [水吸收的热量]
[垃圾气体体积] = [垃圾气体完全燃烧放出的热量]/[热值]
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature of water]-[ initial temperature of water]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water]
[ heat released from complete combustion of garbage gas] = [ heat absorbed by water]
[garbage gas volume] = [ heat released from complete combustion of garbage gas]/[ calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 垃圾气体完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of garbage gas

question.en: A certain model car consumes gasoline [X] while driving at a constant speed of 80 km/h for 6 km on a straight road during the model test. The density of the gasoline is known to be 0.7×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg. Assuming the gasoline burns completely and the efficiency of the gasoline engine is 40%, find out how much heat is released when the gasoline is completely burned during this speed driving process. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 6.3×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 某型号汽车在车型测试中，在一段平直公路上以80km/h的速度匀速行驶了6km，消耗汽油[X]，已知汽油的密度为0.7×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.5×10^7J/kg。假设汽油完全燃烧，汽油机的效率为40%，求该型号汽车在以此速度行驶过程中，汽油完全燃烧放出多少热量？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
[汽油的体积] = [汽油的质量]/[汽油的密度]
en: [ mass of gasoline] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]
[ volume of gasoline] = [ mass of gasoline]/[density of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
In order to control the outbreak of COVID-19, it is necessary to urgently build a hospital specializing in infectious diseases. Shown are the actual image (A) and work scope image (B) of a certain model of excavator used in the construction, which uses diesel as fuel. The table below provides data related to this excavator. During construction, the excavator lifts 800 kg of soil, filling the bucket, from the maximum excavation depth to a loading truck at the maximum unloading height uniformly within 6 seconds. Take g as 10 N/kg and q_{diesel} as 4×10^7 J/kg. Try to calculate:
Total machine weight 5t
A Maximum excavation depth [X]
B Maximum unloading height 5m
Total track contact area 4m^2
Rated power 40kW
Diesel engine efficiency 40%
The work done by the excavator on the soil during this operation; the value of heat released by hydrogen parameters is 8.4×10^8 J. If it is known that the answer to the problem above is 6.4×10^4 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 为防控新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情，需要紧急建成一座传染病医院，所示为建设过程中使用的某型号挖掘机的实物图（甲）和作业范围图（乙），它以柴油为燃料，下表为该挖掘机的部分数据。施工过程中挖掘机在6s内将装满铲斗的800kg泥土从最大挖掘深度处匀速提升到位于最大卸料高度的装载车上。g取10N/kg，q_{柴油}=4×10^7J/kg。试求： 整机质量 5t A最大挖掘深度 [X] B最大卸料高度 5m 履带总触地面积 4m^2 额定功率 40kW 柴油机效率 40% 本次作业中挖掘机对泥土所做的功；参数氢气放出的热量的值为8.4×10^8 J。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.4×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [泥土的重力]=[泥土的质量]×[重力加速度]
[提升高度总和] = [挖掘机对泥土所做的功]/[泥土的重力]
[最大挖掘深度] = [提升高度总和] - [最大卸料高度]
en: [ gravitational force of soil]=[mass of soil]×[ gravitational acceleration]
[ total lifting height] = [ work done by the excavator on the soil]/[ gravitational force of soil]
[ maximum digging depth] = [ total lifting height] - [ maximum dumping height]

arguments.zh_name: 挖掘机对泥土所做的功
arguments.en_name: work done by the excavator on the soil

question.en: A gasoline-powered car travels at a constant speed of 54 km/h on a horizontal road with an actual engine power of 23 kW. If the car travels a distance of 75 km, with a fuel energy value q = 4.6×10^7 J/kg and an engine efficiency of 25%, determine during this journey: How many kilograms of [X] cold water could be heated to 40°C using the heat lost by the car for household use? (Round the result to the nearest integer.) The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). The calorific value of alcohol is 3×10^7 J/kg. If we know that the answer to the above question is 2738 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 一辆使用汽油为燃料的汽车，以54km/h的速度在水平路面上匀速行驶时，发动机的实际功率为23kw。若小汽车行驶的距离为75km，汽车的热值q=4.6×10^7J/kg，小汽车发动机的效率为25%。求小汽车在这段路程中：若将汽车在该次行驶过程中损失的热量用来加热水，可将多少千克的[X]冷水加热到40℃的温水供家庭使用？（结果保留整数）水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C)参数酒精的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2738 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [时间]=[路程]/[速度]
[汽车做的机械功]=[功率]×[时间]
[燃料燃烧产生的热量]=[汽车做的机械功]/[发动机效率]
[水吸收的热量]=[燃料燃烧产生的热量]-[汽车做的机械功]
[温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([所需水的质量]*[水的比热容])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] - [温度变化量]
en: [ Time]=[Distance]/[ Speed]
[ Mechanical Work Done by Car]=[ Power]×[ Time]
[ Heat Generated by Fuel Combustion]=[ Mechanical Work Done by Car]/[ Engine Efficiency]
[ Heat Absorbed by Water]=[ Heat Generated by Fuel Combustion]-[ Mechanical Work Done by Car]
[ Temperature Change] = [ Heat Absorbed by Water]/([ Required Mass of Water]*[ Specific Heat Capacity of Water])
[ Initial Temperature] = [ Final Temperature] - [ Temperature Change]

question.en: A certain middle school supplies hot water for students using a boiler to heat 200 kg of water from 25℃ to [X], burning 6 kg of anthracite coal. The specific heat capacity of water is c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of anthracite coal is 3.5×10^7 J/kg. Find: How much heat is absorbed by the water in the boiler? The value of the parameter time is 10 minutes. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 6.3×10^7 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 某中学为学生供应开水,用锅炉将200kg的水从25℃加热到[X],燃烧了6kg的无烟煤。水的比热容是c_水=4.2×10^3J(kg·℃),无烟煤的热值是3.5×10^7J/kg.求:锅炉内的水吸收的热量是多少?参数时间的值为10 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度差] = [锅炉内的水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[水的末温] = [水升高的温度差] + [水的初温]
en: [ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by the water in the boiler]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature of water] = [ temperature increase of water] + [Initial temperature of water]

arguments.zh_name: 锅炉内的水吸收的热量
arguments.en_name: heat absorbed by the water in the boiler

question.en:
A student read the manual of a certain car engine and created a chart of the energy flow in the internal combustion engine as shown. During a certain period, the car traveled at a constant speed of 72 km/h in a straight line for 46 seconds, consuming [X] gasoline.

What is the amount of heat released by the complete combustion of [X] gasoline? (The heat value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg) The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 9.2×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
一位同学阅读了某汽车发动机的说明书后，将内燃机的能量流向制成所示的图表，某段时间内，汽车以72km/h的速度匀速直线行驶了46s，消耗了[X]汽油。

[X]汽油完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？（汽油的热值是4.6×10^7J/kg）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是9.2×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
en: [Gasoline mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
When using a gas stove to boil water, 4 kg of water at an initial temperature of 25°C is heated to 75°C, consuming [X] gas in total, assuming the gas is completely burned. The specific heat capacity of water is known to be 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), and the calorific value of gas is approximately 4.2×10^7 J/m^3. Find: 
What is the heat released when the gas is completely burned? The parameter value for the mass of water is 1 kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.52×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
用煤气灶烧水时，把质量为4kg、初温为25℃的水加热到75℃，共燃烧了[X]煤气，设煤气完全燃烧。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃），煤气的热值约为4.2×10^7J/m^3，求：
煤气完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？参数水的质量的值为1 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [燃烧煤气的体积] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[煤气的热值]
en: [Volume of burned gas] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]/[ calorific value of gas]

arguments.zh_name: 煤气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gas

question.en: Solar water heaters, electric water heaters, and gas water heaters are three common types of water heaters. Now, using a gas water heater to heat water with a volume of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃ to increase its temperature to 50℃ (the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃), and the calorific value of gas is 4.2×10^7J/kg), calculate: how much heat is absorbed by the water; the density of water is 1×10^3kg/m³, and the value of the time parameter is 100 s. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1.26×10^6J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 太阳能热水器、电热水器、燃气热水器是常见的三种热水器，现用燃气热水器将体积为[X]、初温为20℃的水加热使其温度升高到50℃，（水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg⋅℃)，燃气的热值为4.2×10^7J/kg）求：水吸收的热量是多少；水的密度为1×10^3kg/m³参数时间的值为100 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.26×10^6J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ change in temperature of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ change in temperature of water])
[ volume of water] = [ mass of water]/[density of water]

question.en:
A certain model of a special-purpose vehicle undergoes a model test and travels at a constant speed along a straight section of a highway for 5.6 km, experiencing an average resistance of [X], consuming 1.5 L of fuel (assuming complete combustion of the fuel). Given the fuel density ρ = 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3 and calorific value q = 4×10^7 J/kg, find:
What is the efficiency of the car engine? The initial temperature parameter value is 20 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 35%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
某型号专用车在车型测试中，在一段平直的高速公路上匀速行驶
5.6km，受到的平均阻力是[X]，消耗燃油
1.5L（假设燃油完全燃烧），若燃油的密度\rho=0.8×10^3kg/m^3，热值为q=4×10^7J/kg，求：
汽车发动机的效率是多少？参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是35 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗燃油的质量]=[燃油密度]×[燃油体积]
[燃油完全燃烧放出的热量]=[消耗燃油的质量]×[燃油的热值]
[有用功] = [汽车发动机的效率]*[燃油完全燃烧放出的热量]
[牵引力] = [有用功]/[行驶路程]
en: [ mass of consumed fuel]=[fuel density]×[ fuel volume]
[ heat released from complete combustion of fuel]=[ mass of consumed fuel]×[ calorific value of fuel]
[ useful work] = [ efficiency of the car engine]*[ heat released from complete combustion of fuel]
[ traction force] = [ useful work]/[ traveling distance]

arguments.zh_name: 燃油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of fuel

question.en:
Under 1 standard atmosphere, a natural gas furnace is used to heat 2 kg of water to boiling. The initial temperature of the water is 25°C, the calorific value of natural gas is 8.4×10^7 J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). Find: 
How much heat does the pot of water absorb? The final temperature of the water is [X]. The calorific value of fuel oil is 4×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 6.3×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
在1个标准大气压下用天然气炉具将2kg的水加热至沸腾，已知水的初温为25℃，天然气的热值为8.4×10^7J/kg，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），求：
这壶水吸收了多少热量？水的末温为[X]参数燃油热值的值为4×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[Final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ change in water temperature]

question.en:
Xiaohong conducted an experiment in the laboratory using an electric heater to heat and complete the melting of ice, and plotted the graph showing the variation of ice temperature with heating time as shown. During the experiment, the mass of ice was 0.5 kg, and the heat absorbed by the ice and water was the same for equal periods. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃).

Calculate the specific heat capacity of ice. The temperature change of ice is [X] and the temperature change of water is [X]. The consumed natural gas volume is 0.28 m^3. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 2.1×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃), then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
小红在实验室利用电热器加热，完成了冰的熔化实验，并描绘出冰的温度随加热时间变化的关系图线所示，实验时，冰的质量为0.5kg，相同时间冰和水吸收的热量相同。水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg⋅℃）。

计算出冰的比热容。冰的温度变化量为[X]水的温度变化量为[X]参数消耗天然气体积的值为0.28 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.1×10^3 J/（kg⋅℃），那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [冰吸收的热量] = [冰的比热容]*[冰的温度变化量]*[冰的质量]
[水吸收的热量] = 2*[冰吸收的热量]
[水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ heat absorbed by ice] = [ specific heat capacity of ice]*[ temperature change of ice]*[ mass of ice]
[ heat absorbed by water] = 2*[ heat absorbed by ice]
[ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])

question.en:
After learning about thermodynamics, Wang Jun wanted to estimate the heat energy required for boiling water, cooking, and stir-frying at home each day. He carefully recorded the time needed for boiling water, cooking, and stir-frying each day and converted them into the time needed for boiling water, which is equivalent to heating [X] of water from 25°C to boiling point each day. Given that the specific heat capacity of water \(c_{\text{water}} = 4.2 \times 10^3 \, \text{J/(kg°C)}\) and the local atmospheric pressure is standard atmospheric pressure, the question is:

If the calorific value of household natural gas \(q = 3 \times 10^7 \, \text{J/m}^3\), theoretically, how much natural gas does Wang Jun's household need to burn each day to boil water, cook, and stir-fry? (Supplementary: the temperature increase of the water is 75°C; the current value of the parameter is 50 A.) Given that the answer to the above question is \(0.42 \, \text{m}^3\), what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
王军学习了热学的有关知识后，想估算一下自己家每天烧水、做饭、炒菜所需要的热量，于是他仔细记录了每天烧水、做饭、炒菜需要的时间，并把它们折算成烧水的时间，相当于每天将[X]的水从25℃加热到沸腾。已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），当地的气压为标准大气压。问：
如果家用天然气的热值q=3×10^7J/m^3，从理论上讲，王军家每天烧水、做饭、炒菜至少需要燃烧多少天然气？ （补充：水升高的温度是75℃; ）参数电流的值为50 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.42 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[所需天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气燃烧放出的热量]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ heat released by combustion of natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas required]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by combustion of natural gas]
[mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.zh_name: 天然气燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by combustion of natural gas

question.en: At a certain pressure, the ratio of the heat absorbed by a crystal when it melts into a liquid at the same temperature to its mass is called the latent heat of fusion of the crystal, denoted by the letter \lambda. Under standard atmospheric pressure, using an alcohol burner with an efficiency of 40% as the heat source, 500g of ice initially at 0°C is completely melted into 0°C water, burning [X] of alcohol in total. The heat value of the alcohol is 3×10^7 J/kg. Find: the latent heat of fusion of ice under standard atmospheric pressure_ice. (Supplement: the mass of ice is 0.5kg; ) the parameter of final temperature value is 80°C. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 3.36×10^5 J/kg, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
一定气压下，某种晶体熔化成同温度液体时所吸收的热量与其质量之比叫该晶体的熔化热，用字母\lambda表示。在标准大气压下，用一个热效率为40%的酒精炉为热源，将500g初温为0℃的冰全部熔化为0℃的水，共燃烧了[X]酒精，酒精的热值为3×10^7J/kg。求：
在标准大气压下，冰的熔化热_冰。 （补充：冰的质量是0.5kg; ）参数末温的值为80 °C。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^5 J/kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [冰吸收的热量] = [冰的熔化热]*[冰的质量]
[酒精燃烧放出的热量] = [冰吸收的热量]/[热效率]
[酒精的质量] = [酒精燃烧放出的热量]/[酒精的热值]
en: [ heat absorbed by ice] = [ heat of fusion of ice]*[ mass of ice]
[ heat released by alcohol combustion] = [ heat absorbed by ice]/[ thermal efficiency]
[mass of alcohol] = [ heat released by alcohol combustion]/[ calorific value of alcohol]

question.en:
A car moves in a straight line on a flat road with constant power, and its v-t graph shows that the speed reaches 20 m/s at the 10th second, with a distance of 120 m covered. Find:

If the engine's conversion efficiency is [X], how many kilograms of gasoline need to be burned for the engine to do this much work? (It is known that the calorific value of gasoline is approximately 5×10^7 J/kg.) (Supplement: Work is 8×10^5 J.) The final temperature parameter value is 105 °C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.02 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
一辆汽车以恒定的功率在平直的公路上做直线运动，其v﹣t图象，在第10s时速度达到20m/s，通过的路程为120m。求：

若发动机的转化效率为[X]，则需要燃烧多少千克汽油才能使发动机做这么多功。（已知汽油的热值大约为5×10^7J/kg） （补充：功是8×10^5J; ）参数末温的值为105 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.02 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [转化效率] = [功]/([汽油的热值]*[汽油质量])
en: [ conversion efficiency] = [Power]/([ calorific value of gasoline]*[ mass of gasoline])

question.en: A 1 kg mass of milk is heated, causing its temperature to rise by [X]. Find the amount of heat absorbed by the milk. [c_{milk} = 2.5×10^3 J/(kg•℃)] The calorific value of a new type of fuel is 2.1×10^7 J/kg. If we know the answer to the above question is 5×10^4 J, what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 质量为1千克的牛奶，加热后温度升高了[X]，求牛奶吸收的热量。[c_{牛奶}=2.5×10^3焦/（千克•℃）]参数新型燃料的热值的值为2.1×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牛奶的温度变化量] = [牛奶吸收的热量]/([牛奶的比热容]*[牛奶的质量])
en: [ temperature change of the milk] = [ heat absorbed by the milk]/([ specific heat capacity of the milk]*[mass of the milk])

arguments.en_name: specific heat capacity of the milk

question.en: A solar water heater contains 40 kg of water, and after being exposed to sunlight for a period of time, the water temperature rises from 10℃ to 60℃. Given that c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), if the heat absorbed by the water is provided by natural gas, how many cubic meters of natural gas would need to be completely burned at minimum? (The calorific value of natural gas is 8.4×10^7 J/m^3, assuming only [X] of the heat released from the complete combustion of natural gas is absorbed by the water.) The average value of solar energy received per 1 m^2 area per 1 hour is 2.52×10^6 J/(m^2·h). If we already know the answer to the above problem is 0.5 m^3, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 某太阳能热水器中装有40kg的水，阳光照射一段时间后，水温从10℃升高到60℃，已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），问：如果水吸收的热量用天然气来提供，至少需要完全燃烧多少立方米的天然气?（天然气的热值为8.4×10^7J/m^3，假设天然气完全燃烧放出的热量只有[X]被水吸收）参数1m^2面积上1h接收到的太阳能平均值的值为2.52×10^6 J/(m^2⋅h)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.5 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量]=[水的比热容]×[水的质量]×[水温升高的温度]
[天然气燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[需要完全燃烧的天然气体积]
[效率] = [水吸收的热量]/[天然气燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water]=[specific heat capacity of water]×[ mass of water]×[ temperature rise of water]
[ heat released by natural gas combustion] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas required for complete combustion]
[ efficiency] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ heat released by natural gas combustion]

arguments.en_name: heat released by natural gas combustion

arguments.zh_name: 需要完全燃烧的天然气体积
arguments.en_name: volume of natural gas required for complete combustion

question.en:
In the experiment "Investigating the Temperature Change Characteristics When Water Boils," a beaker of water is heated with an alcohol lamp. The beaker contains [X], and the mass of the water is 100g. It is heated to boiling under one standard atmospheric pressure, assuming 3g of alcohol is completely burned. [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of alcohol is 3.0×10^7 J/kg] Find:  
What is the amount of heat absorbed by the water? (Supplement: The mass of the water is 0.1kg; ) The parameter for the calorific value of alcohol is 3.0×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 3.36×10^4 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
在“探究水沸腾时温度变化的特点”实验中，用酒精灯给烧杯中的水加热，烧杯中盛有[X]、质量为100g的水，在一个标准大气压下加热至沸腾，假如完全燃烧酒精3g。[水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），酒精的热值为3.0×10^7J/kg]求：
水吸收的热量是多少？ （补充：水的质量是0.1kg; ）参数酒精的热值的值为3.0×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水温升高的量]
en: [ rise in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ rise in water temperature]

question.en: A certain model of solar water heater can receive solar energy E=[X] during effective sunlight hours on a sunny day, which can increase the temperature of 100 kg of water in the heater from an initial temperature of 26℃ to 46℃. Given the specific heat capacity of water is c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is q=4.2×10^7 J/m^3, please answer: How much natural gas needs to be completely burned to release an equivalent amount of heat as the solar energy received by the heater during effective sunlight hours on a sunny day? The parameter for the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we know the answer to the above question is 0.5 m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
某型号太阳能热水器能在晴天有效照射时间内接收到E=[X]的太阳能，可使热水器中质量为100kg、初温为26℃的水，温度升高到46℃。已知水的比热容为c=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），天然气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/m^3，请回答：
该热水器在晴天有效照射时间内接收到的太阳能，相当于完全燃烧多少天然气放出的热量？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.5 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

[热水器接收到的太阳能] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ volume of natural gas]*[ calorific value of natural gas]
[solar energy received by the water heater] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]

question.en: Hybrid vehicles have advantages such as energy saving and low emissions, making them a focus in the field of automotive research and development. When a certain new hybrid vehicle starts, the internal combustion engine does not work, and the battery transmits energy to the wheels. When high-speed travel is required or the battery energy is too low, the internal combustion engine starts, which can both transmit energy to the wheels and charge the battery. The relationship between vehicle speed and resistance is shown. In a certain test, the battery was fully charged with 7.6×10^8 J, and when starting, 20% of the energy was consumed in delivering to the wheels. When the vehicle speed reached 50 km/h, the internal combustion engine provided the energy and the vehicle continued to travel at a constant speed [X], consuming a total of 14 kg of fuel and the battery was fully charged. It is known that the efficiency of the internal combustion engine is 40%. (Ignore the thermal losses of the battery and motor, q_{fuel} = 4.5×10^7 J/kg) Find: The work done by the vehicle's traction force during uniform motion; the resistance encountered by the vehicle during uniform motion is 4000 N (Supplement: the travel distance is [X];) the current value is 50 A. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 8×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
混合动力汽车具有节能、低排放等优点，成为汽车研究与开发领域的重点，某新型混合动力汽车启动时，内燃机不工作，蓄电池向车轮输送能量，当需要高速行驶或蓄电池电能过低时，内燃机启动，既可以向车轮输送能量，又可以给蓄电池充电，车速与所受阻力的关系所示。在某次测试中，蓄电池存满电能7.6×10^8J，启动时，消耗了20%电能输送给车轮，当汽车速度达到50km/h时，由内燃机提供能量接下来汽车匀速行驶[X]，共消耗燃料14kg，蓄电池充满。已知内燃机效率为40%。（忽略蓄电池和电动机的热损失，q_{燃料}=4.5×10^7J/kg）求：
匀速行驶时，汽车牵引力所做的功；匀速行驶时，汽车受到的阻力为4000N （补充：行驶距离是[X]; ）参数电流的值为50 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [行驶距离] = [汽车牵引力所做的功]/[阻力]
en: [ travel distance] = [ work done by car traction force]/[resistance]

arguments.en_name: work done by car traction force

question.en: A gas stove is a type of stove that obtains heat by burning natural gas, while an induction cooker is a new generation of pollution-free stoves that consume electrical energy to generate heat. To compare the performances of the two stoves, the students from the innovation experiment group conducted a related survey, and the obtained data is shown in the table below. If the heat required for cooking and boiling water for an average family every day is equivalent to the heat needed to heat [X] of water from 20°C to 100°C, calculate: Gas StoveInduction CookerThermal Efficiency40%Rated Voltage220VNatural Gas Calorific Value8.0×10^7J/m^3Rated Power2000WNatural Gas Price3.25 yuan/m^3Electricity Price0.6 yuan/kW·hIf the heat is supplied by the induction cooker, which operates normally, what is the thermal efficiency of the induction cooker? (Supplement: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C); time is 80 min; ) The value of the parameter force area is 0.04 m^2. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 70%, then what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh: 天然气灶是利用燃烧天然气获得热量的炉具，而电磁炉是新一代消耗电能获得热量的无污染炉具。为了比较两种炉具的性能，创新实验小组的同学们进行了相关调查，得到的有关数据见下表。如果普通家庭每天做饭、烧水所需热量相当于将[X]的水从20°C加热到100°C所需热量。求：天然气灶电磁炉热效率40%额定电压220V天然气热值8.0×10^7J/m^3额定功率2000W天然气价格3.25元/m^3市电价格0.6元/kW·h若这些热量靠电磁炉提供，电磁炉正常工作了，该电磁炉的热效率是多少？ （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); 时间是80min; ）参数受力面积的值为0.04 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是70 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的度数]=[末温]-[初温]
[消耗的电能]=[功率]×[时间]
[水吸收的热量] = [消耗的电能]*[电磁炉的热效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature increase of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ consumed electrical energy]=[ power]×[ time]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ consumed electrical energy]*[ thermal efficiency of the induction cooker]

question.en: The rhyme "On the fifth day of the fifth month, celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival, steam zongzi, eat dumplings, hang wormwood, wear sachets, race dragon boats" vividly presents the local customs of the Dragon Boat Festival. Steaming zongzi uses steam generated by boiling water for heating. If water at [X] is heated to boiling, the water temperature increases by 80°C, [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), q_coal=3×10^7 J/kg], in this process, find: the heat absorbed by the water; the volume of natural gas parameter value is 0.05 m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 顺口溜“五月五、过端午、蒸粽子、吃包子、挂菖蒲、佩香囊、赛龙舟”，生动的呈现了某地端午文化习俗。蒸粽子是利用水沸腾产生的蒸气进行加热。若将[X]的水加热到沸腾，水温升高了80℃，[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），q_煤=3×10^7J/kg]，在此过程中，求：水吸收的热量；参数天然气体积的值为0.05 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

question.en: Xiaoming's family has bought a new natural gas water heater. After learning about thermal efficiency, Xiaoming attempts to estimate the thermal efficiency of this water heater. It is known that the heater contains tap water with a mass of 40 kg and a temperature of 20°C. He sets the "outlet water temperature" to 40°C and starts heating. When the water temperature reaches 40°C, the heating automatically stops. The natural gas meter reading was 129.96 m^3 before heating and became [X] after stopping the heating. [The calorific value of natural gas q_{natural gas} = 4.2×10^7 J/m^3, the specific heat capacity of water C_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C).] Find: the thermal efficiency of this water heater. The time parameter value is 2.5 h. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 80%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 小明家新买来一台天然气热水器。小明学习了热效率的知识后，尝试估测该热水器的热效率，已知热水器内装有质量为40kg、温度为20℃的自来水，他把“出水温度”设置为40℃后，开始加热。当水温达到40℃时，自动停止加热。加热前天然气表的示数为129.96m^3，停止加热后变为[X]。[天然气的热值q_{天然气}=4.2×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容C_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg.℃)。]求：该热水器的热效率。参数时间的值为2.5 h。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是80 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

question.en:
Xiao Ming's family has recently purchased a new gas water heater with a capacity of [X]. He fills the heater with water at a temperature of 20°C and starts heating. When the water temperature reaches 40°C, he stops heating and consumes a total of 0.1m³ of natural gas. (The calorific value of natural gas, q_gas=4.2×10^7J/m³, and the specific heat capacity of water, c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg•°C). 

Calculate:
The heat absorbed by the water in the tank; the density of water is 1.0×10^3kg/m³. At this time, the current value is 0.6 A. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 3.36×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
小明家新买来一台容积为[X]的天然气热水器。他把热水器注满温度是20℃的水后，开始加热，当水温达到40℃时，停止加热，共消耗0.1m^3天然气。（天然气的热值q_气=4.2×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃)。
求：
水箱中水吸收的热量；水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m³参数此时电流的值为0.6 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ Temperature change of water]=[ Final temperature]-[ Initial temperature]
[ Mass of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Temperature change of water])
[ Volume of water] = [ Mass of water]/[Density of water]

question.en: Using a natural gas stove to heat water, under 1 standard atmosphere, heating 10L of water from 15°C to boiling, find: if heat loss is neglected, how many m^3 of natural gas need to be burned? (q_{natural gas}=4.2×10^7J/m^3) The density of water is 1.0×10^3kg/m^3, the boiling point temperature is [X], and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C) with the parameter time value being 60 s. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 0.085 m^3, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 用天然气灶给水加热，在1标准大气压下，把体积为10L，温度为15℃的水加热到沸腾，求：若不计热量损失，需要燃烧多少m^3的天然气？（q_{天然气}=4.2×10^7J/m^3）水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3沸点温度为[X]水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数时间的值为60 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.085 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[天然气放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[需要燃烧天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气放出的热量]
[水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[沸点温度] = [初始温度] + [水升高的温度]
en: [ Mass of water]=[Density of water]×[ Volume of water]
[ Heat released by natural gas] = [ Calorific value of natural gas]*[ Volume of natural gas required to burn]
[ Heat absorbed by water] = [ Heat released by natural gas]
[ Temperature increase of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])
[ Boiling point temperature] = [ Initial temperature] + [ Temperature increase of water]

question.en:
As shown is a 5G autonomous vehicle with a mass of 1.2t and a total contact area of 0.1m^2 between the wheels and the horizontal ground. In a test, it travels at a constant speed of 20m/s on a straight highway [X], and the engine's output power is 27.6kW. (Take g as 10N/kg) Calculate:
If the engine's efficiency is 30%, what is the minimum amount of gasoline in kg required to complete this test? (Assume) (Supplement: The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7J/kg; ) The current value of the resistor R_1 is 1 A. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1 kg, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
所示是一辆5G无人驾驶汽车，质量为1.2t，车轮与水平地面总接触面积为0.1m^2。某次测试中它以20m/s的速度在平直公路上匀速行驶[X]，发动机的输出功率为27.6kW。（g取10N/kg）求：
若发动机的效率为30%，完成此次测试至少需要消耗多少kg汽油?（取） （补充：汽油的热值是4.6×10^7J/kg; ）参数电阻R_1的电流的值为1 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油燃烧放出的热量] = [汽油的热值]*[消耗汽油的质量]
[发动机做的功] = [发动机效率]*[汽油燃烧放出的热量]
[时间] = [发动机做的功]/[功率]
[路程] = [时间]*[速度]
en: [ Heat released by gasoline combustion] = [ Calorific value of gasoline]*[ Mass of gasoline consumed]
[ Work done by the engine] = [ Engine efficiency]*[ Heat released by gasoline combustion]
[ Time] = [ Work done by the engine]/[ Power]
[Distance] = [ Time]*[ Speed]

question.en:
Xiaoming's mother bought a box of 24 cartons of milk. He found that each carton was labeled with "[X]mL" on the outer packaging. The cardboard box has a mass of 7kg. Xiaoming found online that the density of this brand of milk is 1.08g/cm^3, and the specific heat capacity is approximately 4.0×10^3J/(kg•℃). Find:

What is the mass of one carton of milk? The parameter value for time is 20 min. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 270 g, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
小明的妈妈买回来一箱24盒装的牛奶．他发现每盒外包装都标有“[X]mL”字样，纸箱的外包装有质量为7kg，小明上网查知，这个品牌的牛奶密度为1.08g/cm^3，比热容约为4.0×10^3J/（kg•℃），求：


一盒牛奶的质量为多少？参数时间的值为20 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是270 g，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牛奶的体积] = [一盒牛奶的质量]/[牛奶的密度]
en: [ volume of milk] = [ mass of a box of milk]/[density of milk]

question.en: Xiao Jiang's new home uses an instant gas water heater to supply water for household washing. He wants to estimate the heating efficiency of the water heater at home. He turns on the water heater and measures the water temperature of the inlet pipe with a thermometer to be 16℃, and the water temperature of the outlet pipe is [X]. After releasing 50L of hot water, the consumption of natural gas is read from the gas meter as 0.25m^3. Find: [1L=10^{-3}m^3, ρ_water=1.0×10^3kg/m^3, q_{natural gas}=4.2×10^7J/m^3, c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)] the heat absorbed by 50L of water; the value of the parameter charging time is 10 min. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 小江的新家使用即热式天然气热水器供家里洗刷用水，他想估测家中热水器的加热效率。打开热水器，用温度计测得热水器进水管的水温为16℃，出水管的水温为[X]，放出50L的热水后，从燃气表中读取出消耗天然气0.25m^3。求：[1L=10^{-3}m^3，ρ_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，q_{天然气}=4.2×10^7J/m^3，c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)]50L的水吸收的热量；参数充电时间的值为10 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [热水的质量]=[水的密度]×[热水的体积]
[水温升高的量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[热水的质量])
[出水管水温] = [水温升高的量] + [进水管水温]
en: [ mass of hot water]=[Density of water]×[ volume of hot water]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of hot water])
[ outlet water temperature] = [ temperature rise of water] + [ inlet water temperature]

question.en:
The fuel consumption for a car per 100 kilometers often refers to the amount of fuel consumed by the car when driving at a constant speed of 90 km/h on a flat road for 100 km. The fuel consumption per 100 kilometers for a certain car is [X] liters, and when it is driving at a constant speed of 90 km/h on a flat road, the resistance it experiences is 1200 N. Calculate: (The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, and the density of gasoline is 0.7×10^3 kg/m^3) 
The efficiency of the car's engine when driving at a constant speed of 90 km/h on a flat road. (The final result is retained to 3 significant figures.) The specific heat capacity value for water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 31.1%, then what should [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
汽车的百公里油耗常指汽车在平直公路上以90km/h的速度匀速运动100km所消耗的燃油量。某汽车百公里油耗为[X]，当它以90km/h的速度在平直公路上匀速运动时，所受阻力为1200N。求：（汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，汽油的密度为0.7×10^3kg/m^3）
该汽车在平直公路上以90km/h的速度匀速运动时发动机的效率。（最后结果保留3位有效数字）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是31.1 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [有用功]=[阻力]×[路程]
[燃料完全燃烧放出的热量] = [有用功]/[发动机效率]
[燃油质量] = [燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[燃油体积] = [燃油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ useful work]=[Resistance]×[ distance]
[ heat released from complete combustion of fuel] = [ useful work]/[ engine efficiency]
[ fuel mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of fuel]/[ gasoline calorific value]
[ fuel volume] = [ fuel mass]/[ gasoline density]

question.en: An experimental hydrogen-powered car travels at a constant speed for 13 km on a straight and flat road, consuming [X] of hydrogen. During this process, the car engine produces a traction force of 1.0×10^3 N (the calorific value of hydrogen is taken as 1.4×10^8 J/kg). What is the efficiency of the car engine? (Round the result to the nearest integer) The specific heat capacity of copper is 0.39×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 62%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 一辆氢气动力试验汽车在平直路面上匀速行驶13km，消耗了[X]的氢气，此过程中汽车发动机产生的牵引力为1.0×10^3N（氢气的热值取1.4×10^8J/kg）。问：汽车发动机的效率是多少？（结果保留整数）参数铜的比热容的值为0.39×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是62 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽车牵引力做的功]=[牵引力]×[行驶路程]
[氢气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [汽车牵引力做的功]/[汽车发动机的效率]
[氢气的质量] = [氢气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[氢气的热值]
en: [ work done by traction force]=[ traction force]×[ travel distance]
[ heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen] = [ work done by traction force]/[ efficiency of the car engine]
[hydrogen mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen]/[ hydrogen calorific value]

question.en: Reasonable classification and utilization of garbage can protect the environment and turn waste into treasure. Under certain conditions, 1t of classified garbage can be "squeezed" out [X] fuel oil, if the calorific value of the fuel oil is 5×10^7J/kg. Calculate: How much heat can be released by the complete combustion of the fuel oil extracted from 1t of garbage? The final temperature value of the parameter is 70 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 8.75×10^9 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 合理分类和利用垃圾可以保护环境、变废为宝。在一定条件下，1t分类后的垃圾能“榨”出[X]燃料油，若燃料油的热值为5×10^7J/kg。求：1t垃圾“榨”出的燃料油完全燃烧能释放多少热量?参数末温的值为70 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.75×10^9 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [燃料的质量] = [燃料完全燃烧释放的热量]/[燃料的热值]
en: [mass of fuel] = [ heat released from complete combustion of fuel]/[ calorific value of fuel]

question.en:
Using a natural gas stove to heat water, [X] volume of natural gas is burned to raise the temperature of 100 kg of water from 20°C to 70°C. Given that the specific heat capacity of water c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C) and the calorific value of natural gas q = 7.0×10^7 J/m^3. Find:
The total heat released Q_release by the complete combustion of [X] volume of natural gas. The final temperature parameter is 100°C. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 3.5×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
用天然气灶烧水，燃烧[X]的天然气，使100kg的水从20℃升高到70℃。已知水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J（kg·℃），天然气的热值q=7.0×10^7J/m^3。求：
[X]的天然气完全燃料放出的热量Q_放。参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.5×10^7J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ natural gas volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[natural gas calorific value]

question.en:
On April 8, 2020, exciting news came from the Tarim Basin in Xinjiang, China: a new oil reserve discovery of 228 million tons. This discovery further confirms that there is abundant oil beneath the Tarim Basin (given c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C), q_oil calculated as 4.4×10^7J/kg). Determine:  
If 21% of the heat released from the complete combustion of the oil in the previous part is absorbed by water, how many kilograms of water can have its temperature raised from 20°C to 70°C? (Supplement: The heat released from the complete combustion of the oil is 2.2×10^7J; the temperature change of the water is [X]; the rated voltage of parameter bulb L_2 is 6 V. If we already know the answer to the above question is 22 kg, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?)
question.zh:
2020年4月8日，中国新疆塔里木盆地传来振奋人心的消息：人们新发现了储量达到2.28亿吨的石油。这一发现进一步证实了塔里木盆地下方富含石油[已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），q_{石油}按4.4×10^7J/kg计算]，求：
若上小问中石油完全燃烧放出热量的21%被水吸收，可以使多少kg的水的温度从20℃升高到70℃？ （补充：石油完全燃烧放出的热量是2.2×10^7J; 水温变化量是[X]; ）参数灯泡L_2的额定电压的值为6 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是22 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量]=21%×[石油完全燃烧放出的热量]
[水温变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ heat absorbed by water]=21%×[ heat released by complete combustion of petroleum]
[ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of petroleum

question.en: An electric kettle with a rated power of 1800W contains [X] of water, which is heated normally for 5 minutes after being powered on, raising the temperature of the water from 20°C to 100°C. Given that c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), calculate the heat absorbed by the water. Assume the electrical appliance operates at a normal working voltage U_1 of 6 V. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 5.04×10^5 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh: 有一额定功率为1800W的电热水壶，内装[X]的水，通电后持续正常加热5min，水的温度从20°C升高到100°C，已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，求：水吸收的热量；参数用电器正常工作电压U_1的值为6 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.04×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

question.en: Xiao Ming bought an electric kettle, and its nameplate is as follows: ModelRated VoltageFrequencyRated PowerCapacityHX-201306220V50Hz[X]2L Xiao Ming added 2kg of water to the kettle, and the electric kettle took 420s to boil the water when working normally (under 1 standard atmospheric pressure). The initial temperature of the water is known to be 20°C. Find: The heat power of the electric kettle when boiling water? (Supplement: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); the final temperature is 100°C; the heat value of dry firewood is 1.2×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 80%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?)
question.zh: 小明买了一把电水壶，其铭牌如下：型号额定电压频率额定功率容量HX-201306220V50Hz[X]2L小明向壶中加入2kg水，电水壶在正常工作时将水烧至沸腾用了420s（1标准大气压下），已知水的初温为20°C，求：电水壶烧水的热功率？ （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); 末温是100°C; ）参数干木柴的热值的值为1.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是80 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的温度差]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量]=[水的质量]×[水的比热容]×[水温升高的温度差]

question.en: During the "May Day" holiday, Xiao Zhang's family is driving to Baise for a tour. The mass of the car (including the people and items inside) is [X], and the total contact area between the tires and the ground is 0.08 m². When the car travels at a constant speed of 80 km/h on a flat road, the traction force of the car engine is 1000 N, with an efficiency of 30%. The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg (assuming gasoline is completely burned). Find: the pressure exerted by the stationary car on the horizontal road. The volume value of water is 3×10^(-3) m³. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 1.6×10^4 N, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: “五一”假期，小张一家开车到百色旅游，汽车（包括车上的人和物品）质量为[X]，车轮与地面的总接触面积为0.08m^2．当汽车以80km/h的速度在平直路面匀速行驶时，汽车发动机的牵引力为1000N，效率为30%，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg（假设汽油完全燃烧）．求：汽车静止时对水平路面压力的大小．参数水的体积的值为3×10^(-3) m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.6×10^4 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽车的质量] = [汽车的重力]/[重力加速度]
en: [mass of the car] = [ weight of the car]/[ gravitational acceleration]

question.en:
A household gas water heater heats [X] of water from 20°C to 70°C, completely burning 0.21m^3 of gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C) and the calorific value of gas is 4×10^7 J/m^3. Find:  
How much heat is absorbed by the water? The value of the parameter time is 1 min. If the answer to the above question is already known to be 4.2×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
