If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1.68×10^6 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
所示是一台电热水器铭牌上的部分信息．请根据铭牌提供的信息解答下列问题：[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg∙℃）]
若给该电热水器装满水进行加热，使水的温度从22℃升高到[X]，求水吸收的热量．水的密度为1×10^3kg/m^3参数天然气的热值的值为8×10^7 J/m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ mass of water]=[ density of water]×[Volume of water]
[ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en: The engine is the core component of the car, and the quality of the engine determines the performance and quality of the whole vehicle. If a car using 93 octane gasoline as fuel has engine-related data listed in the table below. In the table, the air-fuel ratio refers to the mass ratio of air and fuel in the cylinder. Number of work cycles completed in 1min2400 cyclesDensity of gasoline-air mixture in cylinder1.3kg/m^3Work volume of the cylinder1.8LHeat value of gasoline4.6×10^7J/kgMaximum engine power[X]Air-fuel ratio12:1 When the car is moving at a constant speed of 120km/h, the engine's output power is at its maximum. At this time, what is the useful work done by the car in 1min? The value of the mass parameter of water is 10 kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.968×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 发动机是汽车的核心部件，发动机的质量决定了整车的性能和品质．若某台以93号汽油为燃料的汽车，其发动机的相关数据如下表所示．表中空燃比指汽缸内空气和燃油的质量比．1min内完成的工作循环数2400个汽缸内汽油和空气混合气体的密度1.3kg/m^3汽缸的工作容积1.8L汽油的热值4.6×10^7J/kg发动机最大功率[X]空燃比12：1汽车以120km/h的速度匀速运动时发动机的输出功率最大，此时汽车1min内做的有用功是多少？参数水的质量的值为10 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.968×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [发动机最大功率] = [汽车1min内做的有用功]/[时间]
en: [Engine maximum power] = [ useful work done by the car in 1 minute]/[ time]

arguments.en_name: useful work done by the car in 1 minute

question.en:
The nameplate of the gas water heater used in Xiaohua's home is shown in the table below. The nameplate of the water heater indicates its thermal efficiency, which represents the proportion of chemical energy from the complete combustion of natural gas that is converted into the internal energy of the water when the water heater is in operation. It is known that the tap water temperature is 15°C, the output temperature of the hot water from the heater is set to a constant 40°C, and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.2×10^7 J/m^3.
Net Weight 14.3 kg
Control Method Microcomputer
Rated Flow 16 L/min
Grade Efficiency 84%
Gas Source Natural Gas
It is known that the tap water temperature is 15°C, and the output temperature of the hot water from the heater is set to a constant 40°C. During Xiaohua's bath, he adjusted the water temperature to the highest setting and released hot water at the rated flow rate. Before the bath, the natural gas meter reading was 2366.05 m^3, and after the bath, the meter reading was [X]. Based on the grade efficiency on the nameplate, calculate how long it took him to take a bath. (During this process, no other equipment in the house was using natural gas.) (Supplement: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C); the density of water is 1×10^3 kg/m^3; the parameter voltage value is 3 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 8 min, what should be the value of [X] in the problem?)
question.zh: 小华家用的天然气热水器铭牌如下表所示，该热水器的铭牌标明了它的热效率，表示该热水器工作时，天然气完全燃烧所消耗的化学能，有多大比例转化为水内能。已知当时自来水的温度是15℃，热水器输出热水的温度为40℃，天然气的热值为3.2×10^7J/m^3。 净重 14.3kg 控制方式 微电脑 额定流呈 16L/min 等级效率 84% 气源 天然气 已知当时自来水的温度是15℃，热水器输出热水设定的温度为40℃不变。小华在洗澡时将水温调至最高并按额定流量放出热水，洗澡前天然气表的示数是2366.05m^3，洗澡后天然气表的示数是[X]。按照铭牌上的等级效率计算他洗一次澡用了多长时间？（此过程中家里没有其他设备使用天然气) （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); 水的密度是1×10^3kg/m^3; ）参数电压的值为3 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8 min，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的度数]=[热水温度]-[冷水温度]
[洗澡用水体积] = [洗澡时间]*[热水器额定流量]
[水的质量] = [水的密度]*[洗澡用水体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容]*[水的质量]
[天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [水吸收的热量]/[热水器效率]
[消耗天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
[洗澡后天然气表读数] = [洗澡前天然气表读数] + [消耗天然气体积]
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ hot water temperature]-[ cold water temperature]
[ shower water volume] = [ showering time]*[ rated flow rate of water heater]
[ mass of water] = [ density of water]*[ shower water volume]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water]
[ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ water heater efficiency]
[ natural gas consumption volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]
[Natural gas meter reading after showering] = [ natural gas meter reading before showering] + [ natural gas consumption volume]

arguments.en_name: Natural gas meter reading after showering
natural gas meter reading before showering
rated flow rate of water heater

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas
arguments.en_symbol: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.zh_symbol: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量

question.en:
A household gas water heater heats 100 kg of tap water from 20℃ to 70℃, consuming a volume of [X] natural gas (assuming the natural gas burns completely). Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃) and the calorific value of natural gas is 3×10^7 J/m^3, find: 
The heat released from the complete combustion of natural gas; the total contact area between the tire and the ground is 4.2 m^2. If we already know the answer to the question above is 6×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg、温度为20℃的自来水加热到70℃，消耗的天然气体积为[X](假设天然气完全燃烧)．已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，天然气的热值为3×10^7
J/m^3，求：
天然气完全燃烧放出的热量；参数轮胎与地面总接触面积的值为4.2 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [Volume of consumed natural gas] = [ heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: In modern home decoration, bathrooms mostly use gas water heaters to provide hot water. Xiao Fang's home is equipped with a gas water heater. It is known that the temperature of the water before entering the water heater is [X], and the temperature of the hot water delivered by the water heater during bathing is set at 40℃; it is also known that the density of water ρ_water = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), if Xiao Fang uses 0.05 m^3 of hot water for one bath. Find: How much heat is absorbed by the water from the water heater? (Supplement: the density of water is 1.0×10³kg/m³; the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10³J/(kg·℃).) The total working time of the electric motor is 2 minutes. If we know the answer to the above question is 6.3×10^6 J, then what should the contents corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 现代家庭装修中浴室大多用燃气热水器提供热水，小芳家安装了燃气热水器。已知水进入热水器前的温度是[X]，洗澡时热水器输出热水的温度设定为40℃；且知水的密度ρ水=1.0×103kg/m3，水的比热容c水=4.2×103J/（kg•℃），如果小芳洗一次澡用热水0.05m3。求：水从热水器中吸收多少热量? （补充：水的密度是1.0×10³kg/m³; 水的比热容是4.2×10³J/(kg·℃); ）参数电动机工作总时间(分)的值为2 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [热水质量]=[水的密度]×[热水体积]
[水温升高量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[热水质量])
[进入热水器前的水温] = -[水温升高量] + [热水器输出热水温度]
en: [ mass of hot water]=[Density of water]×[ volume of hot water]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by the water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of hot water])
[ temperature of water before entering the water heater] = -[ temperature rise of water] + [ output hot water temperature from the water heater]

arguments.en_name: temperature of water before entering the water heater
output hot water temperature from the water heater

question.en:
China's Type 05 amphibious main battle tank is the world's fastest and most advanced amphibious assault vehicle in the water. The tank has a mass of 3×10^4 kg and the maximum power of its engine is 7.2×10^5 W. (The calorific value of diesel is taken as 4.0×10^7 J/kg, g=10 N/kg). Find:
If [X] diesel is consumed during the above operation, what is the efficiency of the engine? If [X] diesel is consumed during the above operation and the engine works for 300 s with an initial temperature parameter value of 20 ℃, and if we already know the answer to the above question is 36%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
我国05两栖主战坦克是世界上水上速度最快、最先进的两栖突击车，该坦克质量达3×10^4kg，发动机的最大功率是7.2×10^5W．（柴油的热值取4.0×10^7J/kg，g=10N/kg）求：
在上述行驶过程中共消耗[X]柴油，则发动机的效率是多少？在上述行驶过程中共消耗[X]柴油，发动机工作时间为300s参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是36 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [有用功]=[功率]×[时间]
[柴油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [有用功]/[发动机的效率]
[消耗柴油的质量] = [柴油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[柴油的热值]
en: [ useful work]=[Power]×[ time]
[ heat released by complete combustion of diesel] = [ useful work]/[ engine efficiency]
[ mass of diesel consumed] = [ heat released by complete combustion of diesel]/[ calorific value of diesel]

arguments.zh_name: 柴油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of diesel

question.en: In order to measure the specific heat capacity of a certain liquid, a 1 kg iron block is heated to 80℃ and then quickly placed into the liquid to be tested, which has a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃. The final mixed temperature is 30℃. Assume no heat loss. The specific heat capacity of iron, c_iron, is 0.46×10^3 J/(kg•℃). Find the specific heat capacity of the liquid. (Supplementary information: the heat released by the iron block is 2.76×10^4 J; the heating time parameter value is 35 min. If we know that the answer to the above problem is 1.38×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃), what should the value be for [X] in the problem?)
question.zh: 为了测量某种液体的比热容，把质量为1kg的铁块加热到80℃后，迅速投入质量为[X]、温度为20℃的待测液体中，混合后的共同温度是30℃，不计热量损失，铁的比热容c_铁=0.46×10^3J/（kg•℃）。求：这种液体的比热容。 （补充：铁块放出的热量是2.76×10^4J; ）参数加热时间的值为35 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.38×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [液体吸收的热量]=[铁块放出的热量]
[液体质量] = [液体吸收的热量]/([液体温度变化量]*[液体的比热容])
en: [Heat absorbed by liquid]=[ Heat released by iron block]
[ Mass of liquid] = [Heat absorbed by liquid]/([ Change in temperature of liquid]*[ Specific heat capacity of liquid])

question.en: A substance with a mass of 4 kg releases 2.52×10^5 J of heat as its temperature decreases from [X] to 20℃. What is the specific heat capacity of this substance? The time for this process is 1 min. If the answer to the above question is known to be 2.1×10^3 J/(kg·℃), what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
质量为4kg的某种物质，温度从[X]下降到20℃，放出了2.52×10^5J的热量，求这种物质的比热容是多少?
参数时间的值为1 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.1×10^3 J/（kg·℃），那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [温度变化量] = [放出的热量]/([比热容]*[质量])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] + [温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change] = [ heat released]/([ specific heat capacity]*[mass])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] + [ temperature change]

question.en: Wang Jun, after learning about thermodynamics, wants to estimate the amount of heat needed for boiling water, cooking, and frying in his home every day. So he carefully records the time needed for boiling water, cooking, and frying daily and converts it into the equivalent boiling water time, which is equivalent to heating [X] of water from 25℃ to boiling point each day. Given that c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃) and the local air pressure is standard atmospheric pressure. Question: What is the amount of heat needed for Wang Jun's home for boiling water, cooking, and frying daily? The final temperature of the water is 100℃, and the parameter for gasoline volume is 30 L. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.26×10^7 J, what should the value of [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
王军学习了热学的有关知识后，想估算一下自己家每天烧水、做饭、炒菜所需要的热量，于是他仔细记录了每天烧水、做饭、炒菜需要的时间，并把它们折算成烧水的时间，相当于每天将[X]的水从25℃加热到沸腾。已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），当地的气压为标准大气压。问：
王军家每天烧水、做饭、炒菜所需要的热量是多少？水的末温=100℃参数汽油体积的值为30 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.26×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[水的末温]-[水的初温]
[水的质量] = [所需热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ temperature change of water]=[ final temperature of water]-[ initial temperature of water]
[ mass of water] = [ required heat amount]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ temperature change of water])

question.en:
An incandescent lamp is marked with "220V100W".  
If this incandescent lamp is connected to a distant power supply using long wires, the power supply voltage is constant at [X], the actual electrical power consumed by the lamp is only 81W, find the electrical power loss in the wires. (Assume the filament resistance remains unchanged) The initial temperature parameter value is 20 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 9 W, what should the value corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
一盏白炽灯上标有“220V100W”字样．
若用长导线把这盏白炽灯接到远处的电源上，该电源的供电电压恒为[X]，这时白炽灯实际消耗的电功率仅为81W，求导线上损耗的电功率．（设灯丝的电阻不变）参数初始温度的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是9 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [灯泡电阻]=[额定电压]^2/[额定功率]
[实际电压]=sqrt([实际电功率]×[灯泡电阻])
[实际电流]=[实际电功率]/[实际电压]
[导线电压损耗] = [导线上损耗的电功率]/[实际电流]
[电源电压] = [实际电压] + [导线电压损耗]
en: [ bulb resistance]=[Rated voltage]^2/[ rated power]
[ actual voltage]=sqrt([ actual electric power]×[ bulb resistance])
[ actual current]=[ actual electric power]/[ actual voltage]
[ voltage drop across the wire] = [ power loss in the wire]/[ actual current]
[ power supply voltage] = [ actual voltage] + [ voltage drop across the wire]

question.en: Combustible ice is a new type of energy source. It is a crystalline substance resembling ice, formed from water and natural gas under high-pressure and low-temperature conditions. Its main component is methane. Extraction of combustible ice is a worldwide challenge. According to CCTV’s report on May 18, 2017, China announced the successful pilot production of combustible ice in the South China Sea, achieving stable gas output, which drew significant attention from various countries and marked China's mining technology for combustible ice as world-leading. When heating water with a gas boiler, 50 kg of water at an initial temperature of [X] is heated to 100°C, during which 1.2 m^3 of natural gas is burned. Given that the calorific value of natural gas is q = 4.2×10^7 J/m^3, and combustible ice has a calorific value 160 times that of the same volume of natural gas, find: the heat absorbed by the water. The specific heat of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), the volume of gasoline consumed is 20 L. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.68×10^7 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 可燃冰是一种新型能源，它是水和天然气在高压低温情况下形成的类冰状结晶物质，主要成分是甲烷，其开采是世界难题，据中央电视台2017年5月18日报道，中国宣布对南海可燃冰试采实现稳定产气，引发世界各国高度关注，标志着我国可燃冰开采技术已处于世界领先地位。用燃气锅炉烧水时，把质量为50kg，初温为[X]的水加热到100℃，共燃烧了1.2m^3天然气，已知天然气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/m^3，可燃冰的热值为同体积天然气的160倍，求：水吸收的热量；水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数消耗汽油的体积的值为20 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水升高的温度差]
en: [ temperature difference of water increase] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [final temperature] - [ temperature difference of water increase]

question.en: The rated voltage of a certain model of electric kettle is 220V, and the current when working normally is [X]. The kettle contains 2kg of water at a temperature of 20°C. Given c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C). Find: the electric power of the electric kettle when working normally. The mass of liquid hydrogen is 92 t. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1100 W, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 某型号电热水壶的额定电压为220V，正常工作时的电流为[X]，壶中装有2kg温度为20℃的水．已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）．求：该电热水壶正常工作时的电功率．参数液氢的质量的值为92 t。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1100 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [正常工作电流] = [电热水壶正常工作时的电功率]/[额定电压]
en: [ normal operating current] = [ electric power of the electric kettle during normal operation]/[Rated voltage]

arguments.zh_name: 电热水壶正常工作时的电功率
arguments.en_name: electric power of the electric kettle during normal operation

question.en: Xiaohua boils water at home using an electric kettle. It is known that the mass of the water is 2 kg and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃). How much heat is needed to raise the water's temperature from [X] to a final temperature of 70℃? The volume of water is 0.1 m^3. If we already know the answer to the aforementioned problem is 4.2×10^5 J, what should the value of [X] be?
question.zh:
小华在家中用电热水壶烧水，已知水的质量为2kg，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)。
将水从加热到需要吸收多少热量？水的初始温度为[X]水的最终温度为70℃参数水的体积的值为0.1 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水温变化量]
en: [ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ change in water temperature]

question.en: In the South China Sea, the combustible ice mined by our country is a new type of energy that is clean, pollution-free, and has enormous reserves. The calorific value of combustible ice is more than 10 times that of natural gas, calculated as 15 times. [c_water = 4.2×10 J/(kg⋅℃); the calorific value of natural gas q_natural gas = 4.2×10^7 J/m^3]. Find: the heat released by the complete combustion of [X] combustible ice; the mass of water parameter is 100 kg. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 6.3×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
我国在南海开采的可燃冰是一种清洁无污染、储量巨大的新型能源。可燃冰的热值是天然气热值的10倍以上，若按15倍计算。[c_水=4.2×10J/(kg⋅℃)；天然气的热值q_{天然气}=4.2×10^7J/m^3]。求：
完全燃烧[X]的可燃冰放出的热量；参数水的质量的值为100 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [可燃冰的热值]=15×[天然气的热值]
[体积] = [完全燃烧放出的热量]/[可燃冰的热值]
en: [ heating value of combustible ice]=15×[Heating value of natural gas]
[ volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion]/[ heating value of combustible ice]

question.en: The Tianjin People's Broadcasting Station has a program with a frequency of 500 kHz. What is its wavelength? Frequency = 5×10^5Hz (Supplement: The wave speed is [X];) The value of the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 600 m, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 天津人民广播电台有一套节目的频率是500千赫，求它的波长是多少？频率=5×10^5Hz （补充：波速是[X]; ）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是600 m，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [波速] = [波长]*[频率]
en: [ wave speed] = [ wavelength]*[frequency]

question.en:
A group of students from a physics interest group used a coal stove to heat 10 kg of water with an initial temperature of 20°C. After 6 minutes, 0.2 kg of coal was completely burned. Given: the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), the calorific value of coal q_coal = 3×10^7 J/kg. If the efficiency of the coal stove when heating water is η = [X], calculate: 

What is the amount of heat absorbed by the water? The initial temperature is 20°C. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 2.52×10^6 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
某物理兴趣小组的同学，用煤炉给10kg、初温为20℃的水加热，经过6min，完全燃烧了0.2kg的煤。已知：水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，煤的热值q_煤=3×10^7J/kg。若煤炉烧水时的效率η=[X]，求：
水所吸收的热量是多少？参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤完全燃烧放出的热量]=[煤的质量]×[煤的热值]
[煤炉烧水时的效率] = [水所吸收的热量]/[煤完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of coal]=[mass of coal]×[ calorific value of coal]
[ efficiency of coal stove when heating water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ heat released by complete combustion of coal]

arguments.zh_name: 煤完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of coal
efficiency of coal stove when heating water

question.en: As shown, a student uses a gas stove to boil water for disinfecting tableware. It is known that the mass of the water in the sealed pot is 5 kg, and the initial temperature of the water is 22°C. When the water just boils, [X] of natural gas has been consumed, and the heat efficiency of the gas stove for boiling water is 70%. [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the calorific value of natural gas is 4.0×10^7 J/m^3] Find: The amount of heat released by the complete combustion of [X] natural gas; the temperature change parameter value is 80 °C. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 2.4×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
所示，某同学用燃气灶烧水给餐具消毒。已知密闭锅内水的质量为5kg，水的初温为22℃，当水刚好烧开时，共消耗了[X]的天然气，该燃气灶烧水的热效率为70%。[水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），天然气的热值为4.0×10^7J/m^3]求：
[X]的天然气完全燃烧所放出的热量；参数温度变化量的值为80 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.4×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
en: [natural gas volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ natural gas calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: A lamp is labeled "220V40W" and is connected to a circuit with an actual voltage of [X]. The resistance of the bulb does not change with temperature. Find: What is the actual power consumption of the bulb? The volume of parameter gasoline is 20 L. If we already know the answer to the above question is 10 W, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
有一盏标有“220V40W”的电灯，将它接在实际电压为[X]的电路中，灯泡的电阻不随温度变化，求：
该灯泡实际消耗的功率是多少？参数汽油体积的值为20 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [灯泡电阻]=[额定电压]^2/[额定功率]
[(实际电压)] = -sqrt([灯泡电阻]*[该灯泡实际消耗的功率])
en: [ bulb resistance]=[Rated voltage]^2/[ rated power]
[ (actual voltage)] = -sqrt([ bulb resistance]*[ the actual power consumed by the bulb])

arguments.zh_name: 该灯泡实际消耗的功率
arguments.en_name: the actual power consumed by the bulb

question.en:
As shown, two identical cylindrical containers are filled with equal volumes of two different liquids, A and B, where the mass of liquid A is [X] kilograms. After each liquid absorbs 9.6×10^3 joules of heat energy, the temperature increase of liquid A is greater.

Assuming that liquid A absorbs heat, find the temperature increase of liquid A. The specific heat capacity of liquid A is 2.4×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the volume of natural gas is 30 dm³. If we already know that the answer to the problem above is 10 ℃, what should the value of [X] be?
question.zh:
所示，在两个相同的圆柱形容器内装入体积相同的甲、乙不同液体其中液体甲的质量为[X]千克。两液体分别吸收9.6×10^3焦的热量后，液体甲升高的温度较多。

若，求吸收热量后液体甲升高的温度。甲液体的比热容为2.4×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数天然气体积的值为30 dm³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [甲液体的质量] = [吸收的热量]/([液体甲升高的温度]*[甲液体的比热容])
en: [mass of liquid A] = [ absorbed heat]/([ temperature increase of liquid A]*[ specific heat capacity of liquid A])

arguments.en_name: specific heat capacity of liquid A

question.en:
The nameplate of a certain electric kettle shows that Xiao Ming uses this electric kettle to boil 1 kg of water at a temperature of 23℃, and the time taken is 7 minutes. Given that c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), assuming the environment for boiling water is at 1 standard atmosphere pressure and the kettle is working normally, find:

The thermal efficiency of the electric kettle The power of the electric kettle is [X] The final temperature is 100℃ The total contact area between the tire and the ground is 1.5 m^2. If we already know the answer to the above question is 70%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
某电热水壶的铭牌所示，小明用这个电热水壶将1kg、温度为23℃的水烧开，所用时间是7min。已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），假设烧水的环境在1标准大气压下，
水壶正常工作．求：


电热水壶的热效率电热水壶功率为[X]末温为100℃参数轮胎与地面接触总面积的值为1.5 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是70 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度]=[末温]-[初始温度]
[水吸收的热量]=[水的比热容]×[水的质量]×[水升高的温度]
[消耗的电能] = [水吸收的热量]/[电热水壶的热效率]
[电热水壶功率] = [消耗的电能]/[时间]
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water]=[ specific heat capacity of water]×[ mass of water]×[ temperature rise of water]
[ electric energy consumed] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ thermal efficiency of the electric kettle]
[Power of the electric kettle] = [ electric energy consumed]/[ time]

arguments.en_name: thermal efficiency of the electric kettle

question.en: A household needs to heat [X] kg of water from 20°C to 60°C for domestic use. They use a gas stove and need to burn 0.8 kg of gas. The calorific value of the gas is q = 4.2×10^7 J/kg. The specific heat capacity of water is c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C). Calculate: the efficiency of this gas stove in heating water. The parameter for the consumption of natural gas volume is 10 m^3. If we know the answer to the above problem is 25%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 某家庭需要将[X]、20℃的水加热到60℃作为生活用水，他们利用煤气灶烧热水时，需要燃烧0.8kg的煤气．已知煤气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/kg．水的比热容为c=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）．求：此煤气灶烧水的效率．参数消耗天然气体积的值为10 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是25 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]=[煤气的质量]×[煤气的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[燃气灶烧水的效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature increase in water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gas]=[ mass of gas]×[ calorific value of gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]*[ efficiency of the gas stove]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase in water]*[Specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.zh_name: 煤气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gas

question.en:
When burning [X] natural gas on a stovetop, it can raise the temperature of 100 liters of water from 20°C to 70°C. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C) and the calorific value of natural gas is q = 7.0×10^7 J/m^3. Determine:
The heat released Q_release from the complete combustion of [X] natural gas. The value of the parameter for the final temperature is 35°C. If we know the answer to the above problem is 3.5×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem statement?
question.zh:
天然气灶烧水，燃烧[X]的天然气，能使100L的水从20℃升高到70℃。已知水的比热容为c=4.2×10^3
J／(kg·℃)，天然气的热值为q=7.0×10^7J／m^3。求：
[X]天然气完全燃烧放出的热量Q_放。参数最终温度的值为35 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.5×10^7J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
en: [natural gas volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ natural gas calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: During the melting process, a crystal absorbs heat. In physics, the heat absorbed when a certain mass of 0°C ice is completely melted into 0°C water, divided by its mass, is called the heat of fusion of ice, denoted by the letter λ. Currently, an alcohol lamp with a thermal efficiency of [X] is used to heat 500g of ice initially at -20°C. When this ice completely melts into 0°C water, 16g of alcohol has been burnt. Given that the specific heat capacity of ice is c_ice = 2.1×10^3 J/(kg·℃) and the calorific value of alcohol is 3×10^7 J/kg, calculate: how much heat in joules is absorbed by the ice from the start of melting to being entirely melted into 0°C water? (Supplement: the mass of alcohol is 0.016 kg; the parameter for the increase in water temperature is 80°C.) If the known answer to the above problem is 1.68×10^5 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 晶体在熔化的过程中要吸收热量。物理学中把一定质量的0℃冰全部熔化为0℃的水吸收的热量与其质量的比值叫冰的熔化热，用字母λ表示，现用一个热效率为[X]的酒精炉加热500g的初温为-20℃的冰，当这些冰从开始熔化到全部熔化为0℃的水，共燃烧了16g的酒精。已知冰的比热容为c_冰=2.1×10^3J/(kg·℃)，酒精的热值为3×10^7J/kg，试求：这此冰从开始熔化到全部熔化为0℃的水，共吸收多少J的热量？ （补充：酒精质量是0.016kg; ）参数水的温度升高量的值为80 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [酒精完全燃烧放出的热量]=[酒精热值]×[酒精质量]
[热效率] = [冰熔化为水吸收的热量]/[酒精完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of alcohol]=[Alcohol calorific value]×[ alcohol mass]
[ thermal efficiency] = [ heat absorbed by ice melting into water]/[ heat released by complete combustion of alcohol]

arguments.zh_name: 酒精完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of alcohol

arguments.zh_name: 冰熔化为水吸收的热量
arguments.en_name: heat absorbed by ice melting into water

question.en: Given that a certain model of a freight truck travels at a constant speed [X] on a straight highway, the time taken is 300s, and 2kg of fuel is consumed (assuming complete combustion of the fuel). The engine power of the truck during this period is 60kW. If the calorific value of the fuel is 3×10^7J/kg, find: what is the speed of the truck; the parameter [X] in the problem should correspond to what if we already know that the answer to the above problem is 20 m/s.
question.zh: 已知某型号的载重汽车在一段平直的高速公路上匀速行驶[X]，所用时间是300s，消耗燃油2kg(假设燃油完全燃烧)，汽车发动机在这段时间内的功率为60kW。若燃油的热值为3×10^7J/kg，求：汽车行驶速度是多少；参数煤的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是20 m/s，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [行驶路程] = [汽车行驶速度]*[行驶时间]
en: [Distance traveled] = [ Automobile speed]*[ Travel time]

question.en:
After learning about the calorific value of fuels, Xiao Ming wants to know the calorific value of the natural gas used at home. However, he could not find this information in the fuel calorific value table in his textbook. Therefore, he placed a kettle containing 2 kg of water on the natural gas stove at home to heat it (as shown), measuring with a thermometer the process in which the water was heated from 20°C to [X], and observed that the numbers on the natural gas meter changed by 0.035 m^3. He learned online that the efficiency of the natural gas stove is approximately 36%, and it is known that the specific heat capacity of water is c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). 

Calculate the amount of heat absorbed by the water during this process. The calorific value of the reference bituminous coal is 3×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 5.04×10^5 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem statement?
question.zh:
小明学习了燃料的热值后，他很想知道家中使用的天然气的热值是多少，但是他在教材的燃料热值表中没有查阅到。于是，他在家里将装有2kg水的水壶放到天然气灶上去烧（所示），用温度计测量水从20℃加热至[X]的过程中，观察到天然气表的数字变化了0.035m^3。他通过上网查阅得知天然气灶的效率约为36%，已知水的比热容为c水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)。
求在这个过程中水吸收了多少热量?参数烟煤的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.04×10^5J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
Xiao Ming is boiling water at home using a pot, heating 3kg of water from 20℃ to [X].  
What is the efficiency of the heating process? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.186kJ/(kg·℃) and the heat released by the water heater is 7.2×10^5J. The value of time for the parameter is 0.1 s. If we already know the answer to the above question is 35%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
小明在家用锅烧水，将3kg的水从20℃加热到[X]。
加热过程的效率是多少？水的比热容为4.186kJ/(kg·℃)热水器放出的热量为7.2×10^5J参数时间的值为0.1 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是35 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [加热过程的效率]*[热水器放出的热量]
[温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [温度变化量]
en: [ heat absorbed by water] = [ efficiency of heating process]*[ heat released by water heater]
[ temperature change] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change]

question.en:
Solar energy is one of the key sources of energy for development and utilization in the 21st century. Nowadays, solar water heaters have become common in many households. As shown, the solar water heater of a certain household absorbs 7.0×10^6 J of solar energy per hour when exposed to sunlight. If the solar water heater absorbs solar energy for 8 hours, it can increase the temperature of water with a mass of [X] by 50℃. Given that the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃) and the calorific value of natural gas q = 3.5×10^7 J/m^3. Determine:
The efficiency of the solar water heater; if we know that the answer to this question is 37.5%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
太阳能是21世纪重点开发利用的能源之一，如今太阳能热水器已走进千家万户。所示，某家庭太阳能热水器阳光照射时，平均每小时吸收7.0×10^6J的太阳能，若热水器吸收8h的太阳能，可以使质量为[X]的水温度升高50℃。已知水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，天然气的热值q=3.5×10^7J/m^3。求：
该太阳能热水器的效率；参数干木柴的热值的值为1.0×10^6 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是37.5 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [太阳能热水器8小时内吸收的总热量]=[时间]×[平均每小时吸收的热量]
[水吸收的热量] = [太阳能热水器8小时内吸收的总热量]*[太阳能热水器的效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容])
en: [ total heat absorbed by the solar water heater in 8 hours]=[ time]×[average heat absorbed per hour]
[ heat absorbed by the water] = [ total heat absorbed by the solar water heater in 8 hours]*[ efficiency of the solar water heater]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by the water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.zh_name: 平均每小时吸收的热量
arguments.en_symbol: 平均每小时吸收的热量
arguments.zh_symbol: 平均每小时吸收的热量

arguments.zh_name: 太阳能热水器8小时内吸收的总热量
arguments.en_name: total heat absorbed by the solar water heater in 8 hours
efficiency of the solar water heater

question.en:
Classifying household waste is not only a fashion but also an ecological and environmental necessity. After classifying household waste, excluding recyclable waste and waste requiring special treatment, the remaining waste can produce 150 kg of fuel oil per 1 ton of waste under certain conditions. If the fuel oil pressed from 1 ton of waste is burned in a heating system boiler, it can heat water with a mass of 1.5×10^4 kg and an initial temperature of 20°C to [X]. [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), q_fuel oil=4.0×10^7 J/kg] Find:
The heat absorbed by the water; the calorific value of ethanol gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 5.04×10^9 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
对生活垃圾进行分类既是一种时尚，更是生态环保的需要。将生活垃圾进行分类后，除去可回收垃圾和需要特殊处理的垃圾，其余垃圾在一定条件下，1t垃圾能榨出150kg燃料油。若将1t垃圾榨出的燃料油给供暖系统的锅炉燃烧，可以将质量为1.5×10^4kg、初温为20℃的水恰好加热到[X]。[c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，q_{燃料油}=4.0×10^7J/kg]求：
水吸收的热量；参数乙醇汽油的热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.04×10^9 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
A solar water heater is equipped with 160L of water, and under sunlight, the water temperature rises from [X] to 65°C. Find:
The amount of heat absorbed by the water in the tank, in joules (assuming no heat loss). The density of water is 1.0×10^3kg/m³ and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃). The calorific value of straw coal is 2.4×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 3.36×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
一种太阳能热水器，装有160L的水，在太阳照射下，水温由[X]升高到65℃。求：
水箱中的水吸收的热量为多少焦?(不计热量损失)水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m³水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数秸秆煤的热值的值为2.4×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ water mass]=[water density]×[ water volume]
[ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ water mass])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ change in water temperature]

question.en: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards, cars have increasingly become a part of ordinary households. A car that uses gasoline as fuel has a mass of 1.5 tons and travels at a speed of [X] on a horizontal road for 108 km, consuming 9 kg of gasoline. The actual power of the engine is 23 kW. Given that the calorific value of gasoline is q = 4.6×10^7 J/kg, calculate the work done by the engine over this distance. (Supplement: The speed (m/s) is [X]; the power is 23×10^3 W; the calorific value of natural gas is 7.0×10^7 J/m^3.) If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.24×10^8 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
随着人们生活水平的日益提高，小汽车越来越多地走进了百姓人家。一辆用汽油作为燃料的小汽车，质量为1.5吨，该车以[X]的速度在水平路面上匀速行驶108km，消耗汽油9kg，发动机的实际功率为23kW。已知汽油的热值q=4.6×10^7J/kg，求小汽车在这段路程中：
发动机所做的功； （补充：速度(m/s)是[X]; 功率是23×10^3W; ）参数天然气的热值的值为7.0×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.24×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [时间] = [发动机所做的功]/[功率]
[速度(m/s)] = [路程]/[时间]
en: [ Time] = [ Work done by the engine]/[ Power]
[ Speed (m/s)] = [Distance]/[ Time]

question.en: A household gas water heater heats tap water with a mass of [X] and a temperature of 20℃ to 50℃, consuming 1m^3 of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of the gas). The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.2×10^7 J/m^3. Calculate the efficiency of the water heater. The voltage parameter is 220 V. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 39.4%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为[X]、温度为20℃的自来水加热到50℃，消耗的天然气体积为1m^3(假设天然气完全燃烧）。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg．℃），天然气的热值为3.2×10^7J/m^3，求该热水器工作的效率。参数电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是39.4 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的度数]=[末温]-[初温]
[天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]=[天然气的热值]×[消耗天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[热水器的工作效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]=[ calorific value of natural gas]×[ volume of natural gas consumed]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]*[ efficiency of the water heater]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: After studying electric knowledge, Xiao Ming used an incandescent lamp marked with "[X]V40W" and raised the following questions: What is the resistance of the filament in ohms when this bulb is working normally? The calorific value of the fuel is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1210 Ω, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 小明在学习了有关电学的知识后，利用一只标有“[X]V40W”的白炽灯提出了以下几个问题，请你作出解答：这只灯泡正常工作时灯丝的电阻是多少Ω？参数汽油的热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1210 Ω，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [额定电压] = -sqrt([灯丝的电阻]*[额定功率])
en: [Rated voltage] = -sqrt([ filament resistance]*[ rated power])

question.en: A soymilk maker is primarily composed of a motor and a heating element, both of which can operate independently or together. The rated voltage of a certain soymilk maker is [X], with the motor's rated power being 110W and the heating element's (constant resistance) rated power being 1210W. Once, Xiaoming turned off all other appliances at home and observed that when the heating element of the soymilk maker worked alone for 1 minute, the disk of the electricity meter marked with "1200r/(kW⋅h)" rotated 20 times. Calculate: the current through the motor when the soymilk maker is working normally; the volume of natural gas consumed is 0.2 m^3. If the answer to the above problem is already known to be 0.5 A, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
豆浆机主要由电动机和电热管组成，两者可单独工作也可一起工作。某豆浆机的额定电压是[X]，其中电动机的额定功率是110W，电热管（电阻不变）的额定功率是1210W。某次小明将家里的其他用电器都关闭，观察到豆浆机的电热管单独工作1min，家里标有“1200r/（kW⋅h）”字样的电能表的转盘转过了20r。求：
豆浆机正常工作时，通过电动机的电流；参数消耗天然气的体积的值为0.2 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.5 A，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [额定电压] = [电动机的额定功率]/[电动机的工作电流]
en: [ rated voltage] = [Rated power of the motor]/[ working current of the motor]

question.en:
Xiao Ming's family has recently purchased a new car that uses gasoline as fuel. Xiao Ming noticed that fuel consumption varies with different driving speeds. The car is most fuel-efficient when traveling at a constant speed of 90 km/h, and the engine's useful power is 25 kW at this speed. If the car is driven at the most fuel-efficient speed [X], calculate during this process: 

The work done by the car's traction force; the parameter water has a mass value of 17×10^3 kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 2.7×10^8 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
小明家新买了一辆使用汽油为燃料的小汽车。细心的小明发现行驶的速度不同时，耗油量不同。当小汽车以90km/h的速度匀速行驶时最省油，此时发动机的有用功率为25kW。若小汽车以最省油的速度行驶[X]，求在这过程中：（要求有解析过程）

汽车牵引力做的功；参数水的质量的值为17×10^3 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.7×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力]=[功率]/[速度]
[行驶距离] = [汽车牵引力做的功]/[牵引力]
en: [traction force]=[ power]/[ speed]
[ travel distance] = [ work done by traction force of the car]/[traction force]

arguments.en_name: work done by traction force of the car

question.en:
Every day, the boiler room of a certain middle school needs to heat 5000 kg of water from [X] to 100℃. Find:
How much heat is absorbed by this water? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). The voltage value is 50 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1.68×10^9 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
某中学锅炉房每天要将5000kg水从[X]加热到100℃.求：
这些水要吸收热量为多少？水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数电压的值为50 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^9 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[水的初温] = [水的末温] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ change in temperature of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[initial temperature of water] = [ final temperature of water] - [ change in temperature of water]

question.en: A car with a power of 46 kW and a thermal efficiency of 20% is traveling on a straight road. The fuel tank has only [X] gasoline left. The car moves forward at a constant speed of 20 m/s along a straight line. Question: How much heat energy in Joules is released when [X] gasoline is completely burned? (The calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, and the initial water temperature is 5 ℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.3×10^8 J, what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh:
有一功率为46kW、热机效率为20%的汽车正在一平直的公路上行驶，此时油箱中仅剩下[X]的汽油，汽车以20m/s的速度向前匀速沿直线行驶，问：
完全燃烧[X]的汽油能放出多少J的热量？（）汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg参数初始水温的值为5 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.3×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量] = [完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
en: [gasoline mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion]/[ gasoline calorific value]

question.en:
Known: The mass of water to heat is 50kg; initial temperature of water is 10℃, final temperature is 42℃; specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃); calorific value of natural gas is 3.2×10^7J/m^3; the temperature of the water after combustion is 100℃.

Find: What does the variable [X] correspond to when the answer to the above problem is known to be 8×10^6 J?

Solution: First, calculate the energy required to heat the water from 10℃ to 42℃ using the specific heat formula \( Q = mc\Delta T \).

Answer: Determine the value of [X] based on the problem's answer of 8×10^6 J.
question.zh: 用天然气热水器将50kg的水从10℃加热到42℃，用去了[X]的天然气，已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，天然气的热值为：3.2×10^7J/m^3.(按“已知、求、解、答”格式)，求：天然气完全燃烧释放的热量参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧释放的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [Volume of natural gas] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧释放的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
A is a smart toilet of a certain brand, equipped with automatic flushing and seat heating functions. The simplified heating diagram of the seat is shown in figure B, which has two heating power modes: "high temperature" and "low temperature". The "high temperature" setting has a power of 36W, while the "low temperature" setting has a power of [X]. R_1 and R_2 are heating wires.

How many hours can 1 kilowatt-hour of electricity supply the seat to work under the low temperature setting? The fuel calorific value parameter for the low temperature setting with power of [X] is 4×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 50 hours, what should the value corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
甲是某品牌智能马桶，具有自动冲洗和座圈加热功能。座圈的简易加热原理图乙所示，有“高温”、“低温”两种加热功率，“高温”挡功率为36W，“低温”挡功率为[X]，R_1、R_2为电热丝。


1千瓦时的电能可供该座圈低温挡工作多少小时；低温挡功率为[X]参数燃料热值的值为4×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是50 h，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [低温挡功率] = [电能]/[工作时间]
en: [ Low Temperature Gear Power] = [Electrical Energy]/[ Working Time]

question.en:
As shown, Chongqing's internet-famous "Wooden Barrel Fish" involves placing high-temperature pebbles into a wooden barrel, then adding fish soup with a mass of 2 kg and an initial temperature of 60°C. The heat released by the pebbles can cause the fish soup to boil (at standard atmospheric pressure, the specific heat capacity of the fish soup is considered to be the specific heat capacity of water, c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg°C)). Find:
If the heat [X] released by the pebbles is absorbed by the fish soup, and if this heat is provided by burning natural gas completely, how many m^3 of natural gas is required? (q_{natural gas} = 3.5×10^7 J/m^3) (Supplement: the final temperature is 100°C; ) The rated voltage value is 220 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 0.012 m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
所示，重庆网红“木桶鱼是在木桶里放入高温的鹅卵石，再加入质量为2kg、初温为60℃的鱼汤，鹅卵石放热能使鱼汤沸腾(在一标准大气压下，鱼汤的比热容视为水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J(kg℃)求：
若鹅卵石放出热量的[X]被鱼汤吸收，若鹅卵石放出的这些热量由天然气提供，天然气完全燃烧，则需要多少m^3天然气？(q_{天然气}=3.5×10^7J/m^3) （补充：末温是100℃; ）参数额定电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.012 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[鱼汤吸收的热量]=[水的比热容]×[鱼汤的质量]×[温度变化量]
[鹅卵石放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[所需天然气体积]
[效率] = [鱼汤吸收的热量]/[鹅卵石放出的热量]
en: [ temperature change]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by fish soup]=[specific heat capacity of water]×[ mass of fish soup]×[ temperature change]
[ heat released by pebbles] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas needed]
[ efficiency] = [ heat absorbed by fish soup]/[ heat released by pebbles]

question.en: Xiaoming's house has an electric kettle with a nameplate indicating "220V, 1000W." He fills the kettle with water up to the 500mL mark, places the kettle on the heating base, and it operates at the rated voltage. After a period of time, the water boils, and the kettle automatically cuts off the power. The initial temperature of the water is [X]. How much heat does this water absorb? [Density of water is 1×10^3 kg/m^3] The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃) and the parameter voltage value is 10^8 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1.68×10^5 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 小明家有一个电热水壶，铭牌上标有“220V，1000W”的字样，他接水到500mL的刻度线，然后把水壶放在加热座上，在额定电压下工作，一段时间后水烧开，水壶自动断电，已知水的初温为[X]。这壶水吸收的热量为多少？[水的密度为1×10^3kg/m^3]水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)参数电压的值为10^8 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[水的温度升高量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = -[水的温度升高量] + [沸点]
en: [ mass of water]=[ density of water]×[volume of water]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = -[ temperature increase of water] + [ boiling point]

question.en: Electric welding uses the thermal effect of electric current to produce high temperatures, melting the welding rod to join two metal components. When the electric welder works intermittently, a rapidly changing strong current is generated in the circuit. Assume the output voltage of the electric welder is 40V and the output power is [X]. If the melting point of the welding rod is 1200°C, the specific heat capacity is 0.4×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the ambient temperature is 30°C, with 80% of the electrical energy consumed by the electric welder converted into heat and fully absorbed by the welding rod, raising its temperature, can the electric welder completely melt a welding rod with a mass of 20g during normal operation for 4 seconds? The parameter value of the fuel's heat of combustion is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1070°C, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 电焊是利用电流的热效应产生高温，将焊条熔化而使两金属部件焊接在一起的．电焊机时断时续地工作时，电路中会产生迅速变化的强大电流，设电焊机工作时输出电压为40V，输出功率为[X]，若焊条熔点为1200℃、比热容为0.4×10^3J/(kg·℃)，环境温度为30℃，电焊机工作时所消耗的电能有80%转化为热量且被焊条全部吸收，并使焊条升温，问：电焊机正常工作4s能使一根质量为20g的焊条全部熔化吗？参数燃油热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1070 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [焊条升高的温度] = -[初始温度] + [最终温度]
[转化成的热量] = [比热容]*[焊条升高的温度]*[焊条质量]
[电焊机消耗的电能] = [转化成的热量]/[能量转换效率]
[输出功率] = [电焊机消耗的电能]/[时间]
en: [ temperature increase of the welding rod] = -[ initial temperature] + [ final temperature]
[ converted heat] = [ specific heat capacity]*[ temperature increase of the welding rod]*[ mass of the welding rod]
[ electric energy consumed by the welding machine] = [ converted heat]/[ energy conversion efficiency]
[Output power] = [ electric energy consumed by the welding machine]/[ time]

arguments.en_name: electric energy consumed by the welding machine
temperature increase of the welding rod

question.en: In order to reduce environmental pollution and build a beautiful ecological environment of green mountains and clear waters, some rural areas in our city have started using natural gas for boiling water and cooking. If [X] of natural gas is completely burned in 5 minutes, and the heat released by the natural gas is fully absorbed by 10 kg of water, causing the water's temperature to rise from 20℃ to 80℃ (the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is approximately 4.2×10^7 J/m^3). Find: the thermal efficiency of natural gas when boiling water. The value of the time parameter is 10 s. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 30%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 为了减少环境污染，共建绿水青山的美好生态，我市部分农村地区已经用上了天然气烧水煮饭，若在5分钟内完全燃烧了[X]的天然气，天然气放出的热量被10kg的水完全吸收，使水的温度从20℃升高到80℃（水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）、天然气的热值约为4.2×10^7J/m^3）。求：天然气烧水时的热效率。参数时间的值为10 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是30%，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的度数]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量]=[水的质量]×[水的比热容]×[水温升高的度数]
[天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [水吸收的热量]/[天然气烧水时的热效率]
[天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
en: [ temperature increase of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water]=[ mass of water]×[ specific heat capacity of water]×[ temperature increase of water]
[ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ thermal efficiency of natural gas heating water]
[natural gas volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ natural gas calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

arguments.en_name: thermal efficiency of natural gas heating water

question.en: A fuel-powered car travels at a constant speed along a straight road for 108 km, taking [X] time, and consumes 10 kg of gasoline. The resistance experienced by the car during travel is constant at 1380 N (the calorific value of gasoline \( q_{\text{gasoline}} \) is \( 4.6 \times 10^7 \) J/kg). Find: the speed of the car; the initial temperature parameter is 25 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 30 m/s, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 一辆燃油汽车沿平直公路匀速行驶了108km，所用时间为[X]，消耗汽油10kg，汽车在行驶过程中所受阻力恒为1380N（汽油的热值q_{汽油}=4.6×10^7J/kg）。求：汽车行驶的速度；参数初温的值为25 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是30 m/s，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [行驶时间] = [行驶路程]/[汽车行驶的速度]
en: [ travel time] = [distance traveled]/[ car's speed]

question.en:
Xiaohua's home uses a natural gas stove, and he attempts to estimate the stove's efficiency. Xiaohua adds 5L of water to a kettle, with an initial temperature of 20°C, and then heats the water until it boils. He observes that this process uses [X] of natural gas, with the calorific value of natural gas being 3.2×10^7 J/m^3. The specific heat capacity of water c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the local atmospheric pressure is standard atmospheric pressure. Find:
The total heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas, Q_release; the increase in water temperature is 26 °C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 3.2×10^6 J, then what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
小华家里用的是天然气灶，他尝试估测该灶的效率。小华在水壶中加入5L水，水的初温是20℃，然后将水烧开，他观察天然气表发现此次烧水用了[X]天然气，天然气的热值为3.2×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），当地大气压为标准大气压。求：
天然气完全燃烧放出的热量Q_放；参数水温升高的量的值为26 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.2×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ the volume of natural gas consumed] = [ the heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[The calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.en_name: The calorific value of natural gas
the volume of natural gas consumed

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: the heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: On May 8, 2018, the world's first intelligent rail express system was trial-launched in Zhuzhou, Hunan. The intelligent rail express train uses a fast-charging lithium titanate battery with a capacity of [X] kWh, an energy consumption of 4 kWh/km when fully loaded, and a maximum operating speed of 70 km/h. The energy stored in the fully charged battery is equivalent to the heat released by the complete combustion of how many kg of gasoline. (The heat value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg) The final temperature value is 60 ℃. If we know that the answer to the above question is 13.3 kg, what should the value corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 2018年5月8日，全球首条智能轨道快运系统在湖南株洲试开通。该智能轨道快运列车使用新能源的快充钛酸锂电池，电池容量为[X]k·Wh，满载时电耗为4kW·h/km，最高运行速度为70km/h。该电池充满电储存的能量相当于多少kg的汽油完全燃烧放出的热量。（汽油的热值是4.6×10^7J/kg）参数末温的值为60 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是13.3 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [电池储存的电能] = [汽油的热值]*[汽油质量]
[电池容量] = [电池储存的电能]
en: [Energy stored in the battery] = [ calorific value of gasoline]*[ mass of gasoline]
[ battery capacity] = [Energy stored in the battery]

question.en:
As shown, it is the prototype of the latest driverless car. When the car is in automatic driving mode, it uses radar sensors and laser rangefinders to understand the surrounding traffic conditions. When the car travels a certain distance at a constant speed on a straight road, it consumes 1 kg of gasoline. The efficiency of the gasoline engine is 30%. During this motion (given: the heat value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg, C_water=4.2×10^3 J/kg•℃), find:

If the efficiency of the gasoline engine is increased to [X], and other conditions remain unchanged, then how much gasoline will the car consume over this distance? The calorific value of butane is 9×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 0.75 kg, then what should [X] be?
question.zh:
所示，是最新一款无人驾驶汽车原型图。汽车自动驾驶时使用雷达传感器，以及激光测距器来了解周围的交通状况。该款车以某速度在一段平直的公路上匀速行驶了一段距离时，消耗汽油1kg。汽油机的效率为30%，那么，在这段运动过程中，（已知：汽油的热值为4.5×10^7J/kg，C_水=4.2×10^3J/kg•℃）求：

如果汽油机的效率提高到[X]，其他条件都不变，那么汽车在这段路程消耗的汽油是多少？参数丁烷的热值的值为9×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.75 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [新效率] = [原效率]*[原消耗汽油质量]/[新的汽油消耗量]
en: [ new efficiency] = [Original efficiency]*[ original gasoline consumption quality]/[ new gasoline consumption quantity]

question.en: Incineration power generation is currently the most widely used, safest, and most effective municipal waste treatment technology in the world. After waste is sorted and then incinerated, its calorific value can increase by 30% to 40%, and dioxin (a carcinogen) emissions can be reduced by 80%. Shown is the largest waste incineration power plant located in central China, processing 4200 tons of municipal waste per day, equipped with three generator units each with a power of 3×10^4 kW, working an average of 15 hours per day. Find: What is the waste incineration power generation efficiency of the power plant? (With the result rounded to an integer) (Supplement: The total heat release is [X]; ) The parameter value for the volume of water is 40 L. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 19%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
焚烧发电是目前世界上普遍采用的最安全、最有效的生活垃圾处理技术。垃圾分类后再焚烧，其热值可提升30%至40%，二噁英（致癌物质）排放量可降低80%。所示是位于中国中部最大垃圾焚烧发电站，日处理生活垃圾4200t，发电站配备3台功率均为3×10^4kW的发电机组，平均每天工作15h。求：
该发电站垃圾焚烧发电效率为多少？（结果保留整数） （补充：总热量释放是[X]; ）参数水的体积的值为40 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是19 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [单台机组一天的发电量]=[功率]×[时间]
[总发电量]=[单台机组一天的发电量]×3
[总热量释放] = [总发电量]/[发电站垃圾焚烧发电效率]
en: [ Daily Power Generation of a Single Unit]=[Power]×[ Time]
[ Total Power Generation]=[ Daily Power Generation of a Single Unit]×3
[ Total Heat Release] = [ Total Power Generation]/[ Power Plant Waste Incineration Power Generation Efficiency]
