arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
A family needs to heat [X] kilograms of water from 20℃ to 60℃ for household use. They use a gas stove to heat the water, which requires burning 0.8 kg of gas. The calorific value of the gas is q=4.2×10^7 J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water is C=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃).
Find:
The efficiency of the gas stove in heating the water. The value of parameter time t is 10 s. If we already know the answer to the above question is 25%, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
某家庭需要将[X]、20℃的水加热到60℃作为生活用热水，他们利用煤气灶烧水，需燃烧0.8kg煤气．已知煤气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/kg，水的比热容C=4.2×10^3J/kg．
求：
煤气灶烧水的效率．参数时间t的值为10 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是25 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[煤气燃烧放出的热量]=[煤气质量]×[煤气的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤气灶烧水的效率]*[煤气燃烧放出的热量]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature increase of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat released by gas combustion]=[ mass of gas]×[ calorific value of gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ efficiency of gas stove in heating water]*[ heat released by gas combustion]
[mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
Combustible ice will become the main alternative energy source in the future. It is known that the complete combustion of [X] combustible ice releases 6.3×10^6J of heat. Find:
What is the calorific value of combustible ice in joules per cubic meter? The value of the parameter time is 1 min. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 6.3×10^9 J/m^3, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
可燃冰将成为未来主要替代能源。已知[X]的可燃冰完全燃烧放出的热量为6.3×10^6J。求∶
可燃冰的热值是多少焦每立方米？参数时间的值为1 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.3×10^9 J/m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [可燃冰的体积] = [完全燃烧放出的热量]/[可燃冰的热值]

question.en:
The rear of Xiaohui's car is marked with "2.0T", where "T" stands for "Turbocharged", which utilizes the high-temperature, high-pressure exhaust gas to impact the "exhaust turbine", causing it to rotate at high speed and drive the "intake turbine" on the same axis to also rotate at high speed. This increases the intake volume and intake pressure during the air intake stroke, allowing the gasoline to burn more fully, resulting in higher combustion pressure of the gas while also reducing harmful substances in the exhaust, thereby achieving the purpose of improving engine efficiency and reducing exhaust pollution. The car's minimum fuel consumption can reach [X]/(kW•h), given that the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. (Friendly reminder: Minimum fuel consumption refers to acquiring maximum useful work energy by burning the least amount of gasoline; [X]/(kW•h) indicates the gasoline consumed to obtain 1 kW•h of energy). Calculate:

What is the maximum efficiency that the car engine can achieve? (Round the result to the nearest integer) (Supplement: The useful work done by the car engine is 3.6×10^6 J; ) The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 39%, what should the value corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
小辉家的汽车尾部上标有“2.0T”的字样，其中“T”就是“涡轮增压”，是利用高温、高压的废气去冲击“废气涡轮”高速旋转，来带动同轴的“进气涡轮”也高速旋转，从而增加吸气冲程的进气量并增大进气气压，使汽油燃烧更充分，燃气压强更大，同时也减少了废气中的有害物质，达到提高发动机效率和减少废气污染的目的。这辆汽车的最低油耗可达[X]/（kW•h），已知汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg。（温馨提示：最低油耗是指燃烧最少的汽油获得最大有用功的能量；[X]/（kW•h）表示获得1kW•h能量消耗[X]汽油）。求：
该汽车发动机的效率最高可达多少？（结果保留整数） （补充：汽车发动机所做的有用功是3.6×10^6J; ）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是39 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [汽车发动机所做的有用功]/[汽车发动机的效率]
[消耗的汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ useful work done by the car engine]/[ efficiency of the car engine]
[Mass of consumed gasoline] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ heating value of gasoline]

question.en: In order to reduce environmental pollution and jointly create a beautiful ecology of green waters and mountains, some rural areas in our city have already used natural gas for boiling water and cooking. If 0.2 m^3 of natural gas is completely burned in 5 minutes, the heat released by the natural gas is completely absorbed by [X] of water, causing the water temperature to rise from 20°C to 80°C (the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of natural gas is approximately 4.2×10^7J/m^3). Find: after 5 minutes of heating, the heat absorbed by the water; the calorific value of the gas as a parameter is 4.2×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.52×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 为了减少环境污染，共建绿水青山的美好生态，我市部分农村地区已经用上了天然气烧水煮饭，若在5分钟内完全燃烧了0.2m^3的天然气，天然气放出的热量被[X]的水完全吸收，使水的温度从20℃升高到80℃（水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）、天然气的热值约为4.2×10^7J/m^3）。求：经过5分钟时间加热，水所吸收的热量；参数煤气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高量]*[水的比热容])
en: [ increase in water temperature]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ increase in water temperature]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: With the development of the national economy, cars have entered households. A car travels at a constant speed of 100 km on a straight road, consuming [X] liters of gasoline. If 30% of the heat released by the complete combustion of the gasoline is used to power the car to do useful work, with the gasoline's calorific value being 4.6×10^7 J/kg and its density being 0.7×10^3 kg/m^3, find the resistance experienced by the car when traveling at this constant speed. The final temperature value is 100°C. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 966 N, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 随着国民经济的发展，汽车已走进家庭。一辆小轿车以某一速度在平直路面上匀速行驶100km，消耗汽油[X]。若这些汽油完全燃烧放出的热量有30%用来驱动汽车做有用功，所用汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，密度为0.7×10^3kg/m^3，求：这辆轿车以该速度匀速行驶时受到的阻力。参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是966 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力] = [阻力]
[有用功] = [牵引力]*[行驶路程]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [有用功]/[能量转化效率]
[汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[汽油体积] = [汽油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ traction force] = [ resistance]
[ useful work] = [ traction force]*[ travel distance]

[ gasoline mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[Gasoline density]

question.en:
Xiao Ming's family has a kettle with a capacity of 4 kg, filled with water initially at 25℃. Under 1 standard atmosphere, Xiao Ming heats the water using a natural gas stove. Given that the calorific value of natural gas is q=8.4×10^7J/m^3 and the specific heat capacity of water c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃), find: 

How many cubic meters of natural gas need to be completely burned to release such an amount of heat? (Supplement: The heat absorbed by the water is [X]; ) The specific heat capacity value of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.025 m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?

小明家有一个容积为4kg的水壶，水壶里装有初温为25℃的水，在1标准大气压下小明用天然气炉具对水进行加热，已知天然气的热值q=8.4×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)。求：
释放这么多热量需要完全燃烧多少m^3的天然气？ （补充：水吸收的热量是[X]; ）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.025 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[完全燃烧天然气的体积]
en: [heat absorbed by water] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of completely combusted natural gas]

arguments.en_name: volume of completely combusted natural gas

question.en: How long can a light bulb work using 1 kilowatt-hour of electricity? (Supplement: the power of the light bulb is [X];) The value of the mass of bituminous coal is 13.0 t. If we already know the answer to the above question is 50 hours, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?

zh: [灯泡功率] = [消耗的电能]/[工作时间]
en: [ bulb power] = [Consumed electricity]/[ working time]

question.en:
A metal pot with a mass of 1 kg contains 2 kg of water and is heated from [X] to 80°C, with the metal pot and water absorbing a total of 5.316×10^5 J of heat. Specific heat capacities of several substances [×10^3J/(kg•°C)]:

| Substance | Water | Iron | Aluminum | Copper |
|-----------|-------|------|----------|--------|
| Specific Heat Capacity | 4.2 | 0.46 | 0.88 | 0.39 |

Find: How much heat is absorbed by the water? (Supplement: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C);) The nominal voltage value of parameters is 220 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 5.04×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 质量为1㎏的金属锅中放有2㎏的水，现把它们从[X]加热到80℃，金属锅和水一共吸收了5.316×10^5J的热量。几种物质的比热容[×10^3J/（kg•℃））] 物质 水 铁 铝 铜 比热容 4.2 0.46 0.88 0.39 求： 水吸收的热量是多少？ （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); ）参数额定电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.04×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

en: [ Temperature change of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])

question.en:
Solar energy has advantages such as being environmentally friendly and renewable. In a certain brand of solar water heater, the mass of water is [X], with an initial temperature of 20℃. [The specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)]
Find:
If this water absorbs heat, how much does the water temperature increase? If this water absorbs 8.4×10^6 J of heat, what is the volume of natural gas consumption value of 0.07 m^3? If we already know the answer to the above question is 40℃, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
太阳能具有环保、可再生等优点，某品牌太阳能热水器中水的质量为[X]，初温为20℃。[水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)]

若这些水吸收了的热量，水温升高了多少？若这些水吸收了8.4×10^6J的热量参数消耗天然气体积的值为0.07 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是40 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [吸收的热量]/([水温升高的度数]*[水的比热容])
en: [ mass of water] = [absorbed heat]/([ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
In order to measure the specific heat capacity of a certain metal, students of the school's physics interest group heated a 200g metal block to 98°C, and then placed it in 80g of water at 12°C. After mixing, the temperature of both the water and the metal block was [X]. Assuming no heat loss, determine: (c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), q_alcohol = 3.0×10^7 J/kg)

How much heat is absorbed by the water? (Supplement: the mass of the water is 0.08kg; ) The calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2016 J, then what should [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
为测定某金属的比热容，学校物理兴趣小组的同学，把质量为200g的某金属块加热到98℃，再投入到80g的12℃的水中，混合后水和金属块的温度均为[X].若不计热损失，求：（c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），q_{酒精}=3.0×10^7J/kg）
水吸收的热量是多少? （补充：水的质量是0.08kg; ）参数天然气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2016 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

question.en: At standard atmospheric pressure, a metal block with a mass of 2 kg is heated to 500℃ and immediately immersed in water with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃, with no heat loss. The water's temperature rises to 80℃. Given [c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)], calculate the heat absorbed by the water. The volume of the water is 1 m³. If we know the answer to the above problem is 2.52×10^5 J, what should the value corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
在标准大气压下，一质量为2kg的金属块被加热到500℃，立即投入质量为[X]、温度为20℃的冷水中，不计热量损失，最终使水的温度升高到80℃。求[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）]
水吸收的热量。参数水的体积的值为1 m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温变化量]=[水的最终温度]-[水的初始温度]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温变化量]*[水的比热容])
en: [ change in water temperature]=[ final temperature of water]-[ initial temperature of water]
[mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ change in water temperature]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
The figure shows China's "Fendouzhe" manned submersible, which successfully reached the seafloor at a depth of 10,909 meters in the Mariana Trench on November 10, 2020, setting a new record for China's manned deep diving. It is known that the energy density of the solid-state lithium battery carried by the submersible is 500 W·h/kg, and its average operating power in deep sea operations is 8,000 W. After completing operations, the submersible can achieve uniform ascent without power by discarding two pieces of ballast iron outside the cabin. If the total mass of the submersible before discarding the ballast iron is 25 tons and the total mass of the discarded ballast iron is 1 ton. (When the submersible ascends in seawater, the resistance of seawater against it is ignored, \(\rho_{\text{seawater}} = 1.0 \times 10^3 \text{ kg/m}^3\), \(g\) is taken as 10 N/kg)

How many hours can the solid-state lithium battery allow the submersible to operate in the deep sea? (Supplement: mass is [X];) The initial temperature value of the parameters is 20 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 6.25 hours, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
图为我国“奋斗者”号载人潜水器，它于2020年11月10日在马里亚纳海沟成功坐底10909m，创造了中国载人深潜新纪录。已知潜水器搭载的固态锂电池能量密度是500W⋅h/kg，它在深海作业的平均功率是8000W，完成作业后，通过抛卸舱外的两块压载铁可实现无动力状态下匀速上浮。若潜水器抛卸压载铁前的总质量为25t，抛卸的两块压载铁总质量为1t。（潜水器在海水中上浮时不计海水对它的阻力，\rho_{海水}=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，g取10N/kg）

的固态锂电池可以让潜水器在深海作业多少小时。 （补充：质量是[X]; ）参数初始温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.25 h，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [锂电池储存的电能] = [作业时间]*[平均功率]
[质量] = [锂电池储存的电能]/[固态锂电池能量密度]
en: [ stored electrical energy of lithium battery] = [ operating time]*[ average power]
[ mass] = [ stored electrical energy of lithium battery]/[Solid-state lithium battery energy density]

arguments.en_name: stored electrical energy of lithium battery

question.en:
With the development of technology, hydrogen fuel new energy buses are gradually being put into use. Hydrogen fuel has advantages such as being clean, non-polluting, and highly efficient, and is considered the ideal energy source of the 21st century. [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), q_hydrogen=1.4×10^8 J/kg] Find:  
If a hydrogen fuel bus travels at a constant power of 140kW in uniform straight-line motion, and its efficiency is [X], how long can the bus travel by burning 0.3kg of hydrogen fuel? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 180 s, what should the value corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
随着科技的发展，氢燃料新能源公交车慢慢在投放使用。氢燃料具有清洁无污染、效率高等优点，被认为是21世纪最理想的能源。[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）、q_氢=1.4×10^8J/kg]求：
如果氢燃料公交车以140kW恒定功率匀速直线行驶，其效率为[X]，则燃烧0.3kg的氢燃料可使公交车行驶多少时间？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是180 s，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]=[氢的质量]×[氢的热值]
[牵引力所做的功] = [功率]*[行驶时间]
[效率] = [牵引力所做的功]/[氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ heat released from complete combustion of hydrogen fuel]=[mass of hydrogen]×[ calorific value of hydrogen]
[ work done by traction] = [ power]*[ travel time]
[ efficiency] = [ work done by traction]/[ heat released from complete combustion of hydrogen fuel]

arguments.zh_name: 氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of hydrogen fuel

question.en: A certain family needs to heat [X] of water from 20℃ to 60℃ for domestic use. When they use a gas stove to heat the water, they need to burn 0.8kg of gas. It is known that the calorific value of gas q=4.2×10^7J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water is c=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃). Find: the amount of heat required to heat [X] of water from 20℃ to 60℃; the calorific value of the diesel oil parameter is 4.2×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^6 J, what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh: 某家庭需要将[X]、20℃的水加热到60℃作为生活用水，他们利用煤气灶烧热水时，需要燃烧0.8kg的煤气．已知煤气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/kg．水的比热容为c=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）．求：把[X]、20℃的水加热到60℃需吸收的热量；参数柴油的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ temperature change of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ temperature change of water])

question.en: To ensure the personal safety of students, a large number of school buses have been put into use. The figure shows the dedicated school bus for the Experimental Middle School. This school bus travels at a constant speed on a section of straight road for 8 km, taking 10 minutes, consuming diesel [X], and experiencing a resistance of 1.8×10^3 N. (The calorific value of diesel is 3.3×10^7 J/kg, and the density of diesel is 0.85×10^3 kg/m^3, with g taken as 10 N/kg.) Calculate: The heat released by the complete combustion of the diesel consumed over this distance. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃). If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 5.61×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 为了保障学生人身安全，目前已有一大批校车投入使用。所示为实验中学专用校车，这辆校车在某段平直公路上匀速行驶8km，用时10min，消耗柴油[X]，受到阻力是1.8×10^3N。(柴油热值为3.3×10^7J/kg，柴油的密度为0.85×10^3kg/m^3，g取10N/kg)求： 这段路程内消耗的柴油完全燃烧放出的热量。参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.61×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [柴油质量] = [柴油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[柴油热值]
[柴油体积] = [柴油质量]/[柴油密度]
en: [ diesel mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of diesel]/[ diesel calorific value]
[Diesel volume] = [ diesel mass]/[ diesel density]

arguments.zh_name: 柴油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of diesel

question.en:
In a certain physics interest group, students use a coal stove to heat 10 kg of water, and meanwhile, they plot a graph showing the change in water temperature over time during the heating process. If [X] kg of coal is completely burned in 6 minutes, and the calorific value of the coal is approximately 3×10^7 J/kg, calculate:

The heat produced by the complete combustion of coal; the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above problem is 3×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
某物理兴趣小组的同学，用煤炉给10kg的水加热，同时他们绘制了所示的加热过程中水温随时间变化的图线。若在6min内完全燃烧了[X]的煤，煤的热值约为3×10^7J/kg。求：


煤完全燃烧产生的热量；参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤的质量] = [煤完全燃烧产生的热量]/[煤的热值]
en: [mass of coal] = [ heat generated by complete combustion of coal]/[ calorific value of coal]

arguments.zh_name: 煤完全燃烧产生的热量
arguments.en_name: heat generated by complete combustion of coal

question.en:
To increase the hardness of materials, some metal workpieces need to undergo quenching treatment, which involves heating the workpiece to a high temperature, maintaining it for a period, and then rapidly cooling it down. A factory uses a natural gas treatment furnace to quench steel workpieces with a mass of 80 kg, consuming [X] of natural gas to heat the workpiece from 20°C to 720°C, and then plunging it into a quenching pool containing an adequate amount of water for rapid cooling. Given that the calorific value of natural gas q = 4.0×10^7 J/m^3 and the specific heat capacity of steel c_steel = 0.46×10^3 J/(kg·°C), find: 
The thermal efficiency of the natural gas treatment furnace. The effective area parameter value is 0.5 m^2. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 32.2%, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
为了使材料硬度增大，部分金属工件需要进行淬火处理，即将工件升温到较高温度保持一段时间后再快速冷却，某厂用天然气处理炉对质量为80kg的钢工件进行淬火处理，耗用[X]天然气将工件从20℃加热到720℃，然后投入装有适量水的淬火池中迅速冷却，已知天然气热值q=4.0×10^7J/m^3，钢的比热容c_钢=0.46×10^3J/（kg·℃），求：
天然气热处理炉的热效率。参数有效面积的值为0.5 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是32.2 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[钢工件吸收的热量]=[钢的比热容]×[钢工件的质量]×[温度变化量]
[天然气燃烧放出的热量] = [钢工件吸收的热量]/[天然气热处理炉的热效率]
[天然气体积] = [天然气燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [ temperature change]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by the steel workpiece]=[specific heat capacity of steel]×[ mass of the steel workpiece]×[ temperature change]
[ heat released by the combustion of natural gas] = [ heat absorbed by the steel workpiece]/[ thermal efficiency of the natural gas heat treatment furnace]
[ volume of natural gas] = [ heat released by the combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.en_name: heat absorbed by the steel workpiece

question.en:
An 11-year-old girl gained overnight fame by singing along to the hit song "Calorie" at an annual meeting and was dubbed a "heartthrob" by netizens. A calorie (abbreviated as "cal") is defined as the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of 1g of water by 1℃ under 1 atmosphere of pressure (the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃)). The basal metabolic rate for an adult is approximately 1.5×10^5 cal per day.
If Xiaoming requires a basal metabolic rate of 1.5×10^5 cal per day, and these calories are provided by natural gas with a calorific value of 4.2×10^7J/m^3, how many cubic meters of natural gas need to be burned? (Given that the combustion efficiency of natural gas is 50%) (Supplement: The actual amount of heat required from burning the natural gas is [X];) Parameter: the mass of the iron nail is 2.1×10^-3 kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.03 m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
，11岁女孩参加年会，跟唱神曲《卡路里》而走红，被网友们称为一夜走红的“万人迷”，卡路里（简称“卡”）定义为在1个大气压下，将1g水温度升高1℃所需要的热量（水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃））。成年人每天的基础代谢热量约为1.5×10^5卡。
若小明每天需要的基础代谢热量为1.5×10^5卡，这些热量由热值是4.2×10^7J/m^3的天然气来提供，需要燃烧多少立方米的天然气？（已知天然气燃烧利用率为50%） （补充：实际需要的天然气燃烧放出的热量是[X]; ）参数铁钉质量的值为2.1×10^-3 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.03 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [实际需要的天然气燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[所需燃烧天然气的体积]
en: [ the actual heat required to be released by burning natural gas] = [The calorific value of natural gas]*[ the volume of natural gas required to burn]

arguments.en_name: The calorific value of natural gas

arguments.zh_name: 实际需要的天然气燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: the actual heat required to be released by burning natural gas

arguments.zh_name: 所需燃烧天然气的体积
arguments.en_name: the volume of natural gas required to burn

question.en:
Natural gas stoves are convenient, economical, and environmentally friendly. As shown, under a standard atmospheric pressure, a natural gas stove heats a pot of water with a mass of 3 kg from 20℃ to boiling in approximately 10 minutes. Given: the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.5×10^7 J/m^3. Find:

The heat absorbed by the water; final temperature = [X] the value of the parameter voltage is 220 V. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 1.008×10^6 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
天然气灶使用方便、经济环保。所示，在一个标准大气压下，天然气灶将一壶质量为3kg、温度为20℃的水加热至沸腾，大约需要10min，已知：水的比热容为4.2×10^3J／（kg·℃），天然气的热值为3.5×10^7J／m^3。求：

水吸收的热量；末温=[X]参数电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.008×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ change in temperature of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ change in temperature of water]

question.en: The image frequency of CCTV Channel 4 is 77.25 MHz, and the audio frequency is 8.375×10^7 Hz. Calculate the wavelengths of the image frequency signal and the audio frequency signal. The speed of light is [X]. The mass of the gas is 20 g. If we know that the answer to the above problem is 3.58 m, what value should correspond to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 中央电视台第四套节目的图像频率为77.25MHz，伴音的频率为8.375×10^7Hz，试求节目图像频率信号和伴音频率信号的波长．光速为[X]参数煤气质量的值为20 g。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.58 m，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [光速] = [伴音频率]*[伴音频率信号的波长]
en: [speed of light] = [ accompanying sound frequency]*[ wavelength of the accompanying sound frequency signal]

arguments.en_name: wavelength of the accompanying sound frequency signal

question.en:
When heating water with a gas stove, 2.2 kg of water with an initial temperature of 20°C is heated to [X], consuming a total of 45 g of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of natural gas). Given that the calorific value of natural gas is 4.4×10^7 J/kg and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), calculate:
The efficiency of the gas stove in heating the water. The parameter value for the volume of water (L) is 65 L. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 37.3%, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
用燃气灶烧水时，把2.2kg初温为20℃的水加热到[X]，共燃烧了45g天然气（假设天然气完全燃烧）．已知天然气热值为4.4×10^7J/kg，水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）．在此过程中，试计算：
燃气灶烧水的效率。参数水的体积(L)的值为65 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是37.3%，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气燃烧放出的热量]=[天然气的质量]×[天然气的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气燃烧放出的热量]*[燃气灶烧水的效率]
[水温升高的度数] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温升高的度数]
en: [ heat released by combustion of natural gas]=[ mass of natural gas]×[ calorific value of natural gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by combustion of natural gas]*[ efficiency of gas stove boiling water]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by combustion of natural gas
efficiency of gas stove boiling water

question.en: As shown, there is a flat-bottomed kettle with a mass of 0.8 kg and a bottom area of 180 cm^2. The kettle is filled with [X] water and placed on a horizontal table. The measured water depth is 10 cm, and the initial temperature is 25°C. [ρ_water = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, C_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg°C), g = 10 N/kg] What is the total mass of the water and the kettle? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). If the answer to the above question is 2 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
所示，是平底热水壶，其质量为0.8kg，内底面积为180cm^2．某次用该热水壶装[X]水放在水平桌面上，测得水深10cm，初温25℃。[ρ_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，C_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg℃），g=10N/kg]
水和热水壶的总质量是多少？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [水和热水壶的总质量] - [热水壶的质量]
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ Mass of water] = [ Total mass of water and the kettle] - [ Mass of the kettle]
[ Volume of water] = [ Mass of water]/[Density of water]

arguments.en_name: Total mass of water and the kettle

question.en:
In summer, students like to drink ice water. Xiao Ming puts a 500mL bottle of mineral water at 30℃ in the refrigerator compartment for a long time, where the temperature is [X], then:  
What is the amount of heat released by the mineral water in J? The density of water is 1.0×10^3kg/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃). The value of parameter voltage 1 is 3 V. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 5.46×10^4 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
夏天，同学们喜欢喝冰水，小明将30℃的一瓶500mL的矿泉水放在冰箱的冷藏室很长一段时间，冷藏室的温度为[X]，则：
矿泉水放出的热量是多少J？水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数电压1的值为3 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.46×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [矿泉水的质量]=[水的密度]×[体积]
[矿泉水温度的变化量] = [矿泉水放出的热量]/([水的比热容]*[矿泉水的质量])
[最终温度] = [初始温度] - [矿泉水温度的变化量]
en: [ mass of mineral water]=[density of water]×[ volume]
[ temperature change of mineral water] = [ heat released by mineral water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of mineral water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] - [ temperature change of mineral water]

question.en: There is a small bulb marked with "12V6W". If it is to be connected to a power supply with a voltage of [X] and the bulb is to light normally, what resistor (in ohms) should be connected in series? How much electrical power (in watts) is consumed by the resistor? The calorific value of natural gas is 3.5×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.5 W, then what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh: 有一个标有“12V6W”字样的小灯泡，如果要接在电压为[X]的电源上，并使小灯泡正常发光，则应串联一个多少欧姆的电阻？该电阻消耗的电功率是多少瓦？参数天然气的热值的值为3.5×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.5 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [灯泡正常发光时的电流]=[灯泡额定功率]/[灯泡额定电压]
[灯泡两端的实际电压]=[灯泡额定电压]
[串联电阻的电流]=[灯泡正常发光时的电流]
[串联电阻两端的电压] = [串联电阻消耗的电功率]/[串联电阻的电流]
[电源电压] = [串联电阻两端的电压] + [灯泡两端的实际电压]
en: [ current when the bulb is lighting normally]=[Rated power of the bulb]/[ rated voltage of the bulb]
[ actual voltage across the bulb]=[ rated voltage of the bulb]
[ current through the series resistor]=[ current when the bulb is lighting normally]
[ voltage across the series resistor] = [ electrical power consumed by the series resistor]/[ current through the series resistor]
[ power supply voltage] = [ voltage across the series resistor] + [ actual voltage across the bulb]

arguments.zh_name: 灯泡正常发光时的电流
arguments.en_name: current when the bulb is lighting normally

arguments.zh_name: 串联电阻消耗的电功率
arguments.en_name: electrical power consumed by the series resistor

question.en:
A family's gas water heater heats 20 kg of water from 10℃ to 60℃, completely burning [X] cubic meters of gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of the gas is 4×10^7 J/m^3. Find:  
What is the heat released by the complete combustion of the gas? The contact area of a single tire with the ground is 0.3 m^2. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
某家庭用的燃气热水器，将20kg的水从10℃加热到60℃，完全燃烧了[X]的煤气.已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），煤气的热值为4×10^7J/m^3.试求：
煤气完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？参数单个轮胎与地面接触面积的值为0.3 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤气体积] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[煤气热值]
en: [Gas volume] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gas]/[ gas calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 煤气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gas

question.en:
A physics interest group heated [X] kg of water using a coal stove, completely burning 0.8 kg of coal. The water temperature rose by 50°C, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10³ J/(kg·°C). The calorific value of coal is approximately 3×10⁷ J/kg. Calculate:
The heat absorbed by the water; (Supplement: the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10³ J/(kg·°C); ) The rated current of the parameter bulb L_1 is 0.5 A. If we know that the answer to the above question is 4.2×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
某物理兴趣小组的同学，用煤炉给[X]的水加热，完全燃烧了0.8kg的煤，水温升高了50℃，水的比热容为4.2×103J/(kg·℃)，煤的热值约为3×107J/kg．求：
水所吸收的热量； （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10³J/(kg·℃); ）参数灯泡L_1的额定电流的值为0.5 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: The temperature of 2 kg of water decreases from [X] to 10°C. [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C)] Find: the heat released by the water Q_released. The parameter for the volume of natural gas consumed is 1 m³. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.2×10^5 J, what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 质量为2千克的水温度从[X]降低到10℃．[c_水=4.2×10^3焦/（千克•℃）]求：水放出的热量Q_放．参数消耗天然气的体积的值为1 m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温变化量] = [水放出的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] + [水温变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat released by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
To improve urban air quality, many cities use mist cannon vehicles to spray water for dust suppression. For a mist cannon vehicle spraying water on a horizontal road surface, the area of the water outlet at the bottom of the water tank is 50 cm². (Take g as 10 N/kg, \rho_water = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of diesel as 4.0×10^7 J/kg) Find:

The resistance experienced by the mist cannon vehicle moving at a constant speed of [X] on a horizontal road surface before spraying, with the engine power at 80 kW; engine power = 80000 W, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 8000 N, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
为改善城市空气质量，很多城市用雾炮车洒水除尘。为一台正在水平路面上洒水的雾炮车，车内水箱底部出水口面积为50cm²。（g取10N/kg，\rho_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，柴油的热值取4.0×10^7J/kg）求：

洒水前雾炮车以[X]的速度在水平路面上做匀速直线运动，发动机的功率为80kW，此时雾炮车受到的阻力；发动机功率=80000W参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8000 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [速度] = [发动机功率]/[牵引力]
en: [ Speed] = [Engine Power]/[ Traction]

question.en: From November 8 to 13, 2022, the 14th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition was held at the Zhuhai International Airshow Center. China's new generation of large jet passenger aircraft, the C919, which has completely independent intellectual property rights, completed its first airshow test flight. If the C919 flies in a straight line at a constant speed of 200 m/s for 100 seconds, consuming 3.5×10^3 kg of aviation fuel, the engine power of the aircraft is [X]. (The calorific value of aviation fuel is 4×10^7 J/kg) Question: What is the resistance force experienced by the aircraft during its flight? The parameter for the increase in water temperature is 50 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 4.9×10^6 N, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 2022年11月8日至13日，第十四届中国航展在珠海国际航展中心举行。我国具有完全自主知识产权的新一代大型喷气式客机C919已完成首次航展试飞，若C919以200m/s的速度匀速直线航行100s，消耗航空燃油3.5×10^3kg，飞机发动机的功率为[X]。（航空燃油的热值为4×10^7J/kg）求：飞机在航行过程中的阻力是多少？参数水温升高的度数的值为50 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.9×10^6 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力] = [阻力]
[发动机功率] = [牵引力]*[飞行速度]
en: [ traction] = [ drag]
[Engine power] = [ traction]*[ flight speed]

question.en: After Xiaohua learned about electric power, he checked the electric kettle at home and found that the nameplate was blurred. He used an electricity meter to measure the power of the kettle. The meter had "1600imp/kW·h" marked on it, meaning the indicator light flashes 1600 times for every 1kW·h of electricity used. During the measurement, he turned off all other electrical appliances in the house and only connected the kettle to the circuit. After being powered on for 6 minutes, the indicator light flashed 160 times, and the temperature of 1 kg of water in the kettle increased from an initial temperature of 20℃ to 70℃. Find: the actual power of the electric kettle; (Supplement: The consumed electric energy is [X];) The final temperature parameter value is 100℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1000W, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 小华同学在学习了电功率的相关知识后查看了家里的电热水壶，发现其铭牌标识已经模糊不清。他借助电能表来测量该电热水壶的功率，电能表表盘上标有“1600imp/kW·h”的字样，表示每用电1kW·h指示灯闪烁1600次。测量过程中他关闭了家中的其他所有用电器，只让该热水器接入电路中，通电6min测量到电能表的指示灯闪烁了160次，热水壶中1kg初温为20℃的水温度升高到70℃。求：该电热水壶的实际功率； （补充：消耗的电能是[X]; ）参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1000W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗的电能] = [时间]*[电热水壶的实际功率]
en: [Consumed energy] = [ time]*[ actual power of the electric kettle]

arguments.en_name: actual power of the electric kettle

question.en: A new model of four-wheel beach kart is shown. The kart travels at a constant speed of 36 km/h on a straight section of the beach for 20 minutes, consuming 1.5 liters of gasoline. During the entire process, the power of the work done by the engine to drive the kart forward is constant at [X]. Given that the density of gasoline is 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3 and the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, find: What is the resistance encountered by the kart during this motion? The parameter for the mass of water is 50 kg. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 1150 N, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
所示是一款新型四轮沙滩卡丁车，该车以36km/h的速度在一段平直的沙滩上匀速行驶20min，消耗汽油1.5L。整个行驶过程中，发动机牵引卡丁车前进所做功的功率恒为[X]。已知汽油的密度为0.8×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，那么，在这段运动过程中，求：
该卡丁车所受的阻力是多少？参数水的质量的值为50 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1150 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [功率] = [汽车速度]*[牵引力]
en: [ power] = [car speed]*[ tractive force]

question.en: Using a gas stove to heat water, [X] amount of gas is burnt to raise the temperature of 50 kg of water from 20°C to 70°C. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of the gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg. Calculate: the efficiency of the gas stove in heating the water. The parameter for the volume of consumed natural gas is 0.14 m^3. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 25%, what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh: 用燃气灶烧水，燃烧[X]的煤气，使50kg的水从20℃升高到70℃。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，煤气的热值为4.2×10^7J/kg。求：燃气灶烧水的效率。参数消耗天然气的体积的值为0.14 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是25%，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量]=[水的质量]×[水的比热容]×[水温升高的度数]
[煤气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [水吸收的热量]/[燃气灶烧水的效率]
[煤气的质量] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[煤气的热值]
en: [ heat absorbed by water]=[mass of water]×[ specific heat capacity of water]×[ temperature increase of water]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gas] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ efficiency of gas stove in heating water]
[ mass of gas] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]/[ calorific value of gas]

arguments.zh_name: 煤气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gas
efficiency of gas stove in heating water

question.en: Yonghao's family recently purchased a new car. From the manual, he learned the following information: The car weighs 1800 kg, and when traveling at a constant speed of 72 km/h, the engine's power is [X]. Given that the calorific value of gasoline is 4×10^7 J/L, find the traction force when the car is traveling at a constant speed of 72 km/h. (Supplement: The engine power is [X]; the car's speed is 20 m/s; the temperature increase for water is 50 ℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.3×10^3 N, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 永浩家新买了一辆汽车，他通过说明书了解到下列信息：汽车自重1800kg，以72km/h的速度匀速行驶时，发动机的功率为[X]。已知汽油的热值为4×10^7J/L，求：汽车以72km/h的速度匀速行驶时所受的牵引力； （补充：发动机功率是[X]; 汽车行驶速度是20m/s; ）参数水升高的温度的值为50 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.3×10^3 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [发动机功率] = [汽车行驶速度]*[牵引力]
en: [Engine power] = [ car speed]*[ traction force]

question.en: To save energy, many rooftops in Panzhihua are equipped with solar water heaters due to abundant sunlight. It is known that the solar water heater tank contains 100 kg of water, and under sunlight, the water temperature rises by [X]. Given that c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), find: the heat absorbed by the water; the value of the parameter time is 60 s. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.092×10^7 J, what should the value of [X] be?
question.zh:
英雄攀枝花，阳光康养地。攀枝花日照丰富，为了节约能源。攀枝花很多屋顶都安装了太阳能热水器。已知太阳能热水器储水箱内有100kg的水，在阳光照射下，水的温度升高了[X]，已知c_水=4.2×10^3J（kg·℃），
求：
水吸收的热量；参数时间的值为60 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.092×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])

question.en: A household gas water heater heats 100 kg of tap water from 20℃ to 50℃, consuming a volume of [X] of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of natural gas). Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.2×10^7 J/m^3. Find: the heat released by complete combustion of natural gas; the value of the initial temperature parameter for water is 20℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 3.2×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg，温度为20℃的自来水加热到50℃，消耗的天然气体积为[X](假设天然气完全燃烧)。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，天然气的热值为3.2×10^7J/m^3。求：天然气完全燃烧放出的热量；参数水的初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.2×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
en: [Volume of natural gas consumed] = [ Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[ Calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: On May 18, 2017, Chinese scientists successfully extracted combustible ice in the South China Sea for the first time, achieving a historic breakthrough in the development of natural gas hydrates in China. Combustible ice is clean and pollution-free, with huge reserves, making it an ideal new energy source. The calorific value of combustible ice is very high, more than 10 times that of natural gas, calculated as 15 times. [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), calorific value of natural gas q=7.0×10^7 J/m^3] Calculate: If 90% of this heat is absorbed by water with a mass of [X], what is the temperature increase of the water? (Supplement: The heat absorbed by the water is 9.45×10^6 J; ) The value of the parameter time is 5 h. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 22.5 °C, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
2017年5月18日，中国科学家首次在南海试采可燃冰取得圆满成功，实现了我国天然气水合物开发的历史性突破．可燃冰清洁无污染，储量巨大，是一种非常理想的新型能源。可燃冰的热值很大，是天然气热值的10倍以上，若按15倍计算．[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），天然气的热值q=7.0×10^7J/m^3]求：
若这些热量的90%被质量为[X]的水吸收，则水升高的温度是多少？ （补充：水吸收的热量是9.45×10^6J; ）参数时间的值为5 h。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是22.5 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: A certain household gas water heater tank has [X] of water. After filling the tank with tap water at a temperature of 20℃ and heating it to 50℃, the mass of natural gas consumed is 1.5 kg (assuming complete combustion of the natural gas). Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃) and the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg, find: the heat absorbed by the water. (Supplement: the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃); ) The parameter value for the volume of water is 160 L. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 2.52×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 某家庭用燃气热水器水箱装有[X]的水，将温度为20℃的自来水装满水箱后加热到50℃，消耗的天然气质量为1.5kg（假设天然气完全燃烧）．已知：水的比热容为4.2×103J/(kg·℃)，天然气的热值为4.2×10^7J/kg，求：水吸收的热量； （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); ）参数水的体积的值为160 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的值]=[最终水温]-[初始水温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的值]*[水的比热容])
en: [ increase in water temperature]=[ final temperature of water]-[ initial temperature of water]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ increase in water temperature]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
Natural gas, as a clean energy source, greatly improves environmental pollution issues. Natural gas has been partially used in our city's urban area. To determine the efficiency of his home's gas stove in boiling water, Xiao Tao recorded the reading of the gas meter as 134.731 m^3 when igniting the stove to boil 4 kg of water at 20℃. Xiao Tao observed the gas meter reading was [X] when the water boiled. Given that the calorific value of natural gas is 4.0×10^7 J/m^3, find: (under 1 standard atmosphere pressure) 

What is the amount of heat released by the complete combustion of the natural gas used this time? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 0.56×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
天然气作为一种清洁能源，大大改善环境污染问题，天然气已在我市城区部分使用，小涛同学为测定他家天然气灶烧水的效率。记录下当时气量表的示数134.731m^3，打火将4kg，20℃的水烧开，小涛这时观察气量表的示数是[X]，已知天然气的热值为4.0×10^7J／m^3，试求：(在l标准大气压下)
这次所用的天然气完全燃烧放出的热量是多少?参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.56×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗天然气的体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
[结束时气量表示数] = [开始时气量表示数] + [消耗天然气的体积]
en: [ Volume of natural gas consumed] = [ Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas]/[ Calorific value of natural gas]
[ Final gas meter reading] = [Initial gas meter reading] + [ Volume of natural gas consumed]

arguments.en_name: Heat released from complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: Given a certain type of diesel [X], with a known calorific value q = 4.2×10^7 J/kg, determine: If this diesel is added to a diesel engine and the thermal efficiency η is 40%, how much useful work in J can be output? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
现有某型号柴油[X]，已知该型号柴油的热值q=4.2×10^7J/kg，求：
某柴油机加入此柴油后，热机效率η是40%，则可输出多少J的有用功？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [柴油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [有用功]/[热机效率]
[柴油的质量] = [柴油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[柴油的热值]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of diesel] = [ useful work]/[ thermal efficiency]
[mass of diesel] = [ heat released by complete combustion of diesel]/[ calorific value of diesel]

arguments.zh_name: 柴油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of diesel

question.en:
As shown, it is the latest prototype of an unmanned vehicle. The car uses radar sensors and laser rangefinders to understand the surrounding traffic conditions during autonomous driving. When the vehicle travels at a constant speed of 72 km/h along a horizontal road for 8 km, it consumes gasoline [X]. Assuming complete combustion of fuel and an engine efficiency of 30%, then during this movement process (with gasoline density of 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3 and gasoline calorific value of 4.6×10^7 J/kg), find:  
How much useful work is done by the car engine? The value of the parameter (voltage) is 220 V. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.656×10^7 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
所示，是最新一款无人驾驶汽车原型图。汽车自动驾驶时使用雷达传感器，以及激光测距器来了解周围的交通状况。该款车以72km/h的速度沿一段水平公路匀速直线行驶了8km时，消耗汽油[X]。假设燃油完全燃烧，汽油机的效率为30%，那么，在这段运动过程中(汽油的密度为0.8×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg)，求：
该汽车发动机做的有用功是多少？参数(电压)的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.656×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [发动机做的有用功]/[汽油机效率]
[汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[汽油体积] = [汽油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline] = [ useful work done by the engine]/[ gasoline engine efficiency]
[ gasoline mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[Gasoline density]

question.en: As shown in the diagram, there is a setup where a car pulls an object from the bottom of a deep well to the wellhead using a pulley system. Given that the well is 10 meters deep, the object weighs 5000 N, the mass of the car is [X], the total contact area between the tires and the ground is 0.2 m^2, the car's pulling force on the rope is 2000 N when moving at a constant speed, and the resistance encountered by the car is 0.1 times its weight. (g = 10 N/kg) Find: What is the traction force experienced by the car? How much work does the traction force do in lifting the weight by 10 meters? Assume the car travels a distance of 30 meters and the initial temperature of the parameter water is 30 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.1×10^5 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
所示，是一辆汽车通过滑轮组将深井中的物体拉至井口的装置图。已知井深10m，物体重5000N，汽车质量为[X]，轮胎与地面的总接触面积是0.2m^2，匀速行驶时汽车对绳子的拉力为2000N，汽车受到的阻力为车重的0.1倍。（g=10N/kg）求：
汽车受到的牵引力是多少？将重物提升10m牵引力做的功是多少？假设汽车行驶距离为30m参数水初始的温度的值为30 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.1×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽车受到的牵引力] = [牵引力做的功]/[假设行驶距离]
[汽车受到的阻力] = [汽车受到的牵引力] - [绳子对汽车的拉力]
[汽车重力] = 10.0*[汽车受到的阻力]
[汽车质量] = [汽车重力]/[重力加速度]
en: [ traction force on the car] = [ work done by traction force]/[ assumed driving distance]
[ resistance force on the car] = [ traction force on the car] - [ tension force on the car]
[ car weight] = 10.0*[ resistance force on the car]
[car mass] = [ car weight]/[ gravitational acceleration]

question.en: As shown in the figure, there is a device where a car lifts a heavy object through a pulley system. The parameters of the car are listed in the table. The heavy object rises at a constant speed of 2 m/s. When lifting the object of weight [X], the force exerted by the car on the rope is 500 N. Neglect the frictional resistance of the car, the rope's weight, and the friction of the pulley system, with g taken as 10 N/kg. Determine: Car ParametersCar Weight/tons3Number of Wheels6Total Wheel Contact Area/cm^21000 the mechanical efficiency of the pulley system; the value of the mass of the water parameter is 2 kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 80%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 所示，是一辆汽车通过滑轮组提升重物的装置图，汽车部分参数如表。重物以2m/s的速度匀速上升，提升重[X]的物体时，汽车拉绳的力为500N，不计汽车所受的摩擦阻力、绳重及滑轮组的摩擦，g取10N/kg，求：汽车部分参数汽车重量/吨3车轮数/个6车轮总受力面积/cm^21000 滑轮组的机械效率；参数水的质量的值为2 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是80 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [重物重力] = [有效股数]*[机械效率]*[汽车拉绳的力]
en: [weight of the object] = [ effective number of strands]*[ mechanical efficiency]*[ force of the car towing rope]

arguments.en_name: force of the car towing rope

question.en: When using a gas stove to heat water, 2 kg of water is heated from [X] to 70℃, consuming 0.03 m^3 of gas. Assume the gas is completely burned, and the calorific value of the gas is approximately 4×10^7 J/m^3 (the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃)). Find: What is the efficiency of the gas stove in heating water? The maximum current parameter value is 10 A. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 35%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
用煤气灶烧水时，把2kg的水从[X]加热到70℃，燃烧了0.03m^3的煤气，假设煤气完全燃烧，已知煤气的热值约为4×10^7J/m^3（水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）试求：
煤气灶烧水时的效率是多少？参数最大电流的值为10 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是35 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]=[煤气的热值]×[煤气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[煤气灶烧水时的效率]
[水温升高的度数] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水温升高的度数]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]=[ calorific value of gas]×[ volume of gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gas]*[ efficiency of gas stove in heating water]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.zh_name: 煤气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gas
efficiency of gas stove in heating water

question.en:
In order to test the efficiency of a certain domestic car engine, a tester drove the car at a constant speed on a horizontal road for 11.5 km, consuming gasoline [X]. It is known that the calorific value of gasoline is 3.3×10^7 J/kg, and the engine's traction force when the car moves at a constant speed is 1000 N. Find:
What is the amount of heat released by the complete combustion of this gasoline? The value of the parameter at the final temperature is 60 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 3.3×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
为了测试某国产汽车发动机的效率，测试员开车在一水平路面上匀速行驶了11.5km，消耗汽油[X]。已知汽油的热值为3.3×10^7J/kg，汽车匀速行驶时发动机的牵引力是1000N。求：
完全燃烧这些汽油放出的热量是多少？参数末温的值为60 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.3×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量] = [完全燃烧汽油放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
en: [Gasoline mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 完全燃烧汽油放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en: With the growing emphasis on the environment, new energy vehicles are becoming popular. A certain brand of electric vehicle has a range of about 500km with a battery capacity of 70kW⋅h. The charging power for a regular home charging pile is 7kW. Another brand of fuel vehicle has a fuel tank capacity of [X], and can provide a traction force of approximately 2000N when driving at a constant speed. A full tank of gasoline allows it to travel about 400km at a constant speed. What is the mass of the oil when the fuel tank of the above-mentioned fuel vehicle is full? (Assume the density of gasoline is 0.7×10^3kg/m^3) The initial temperature value of the parameters is 20 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 56 kg, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 随着重视环境，新能源车开始普及。某品牌纯电动汽车续航里程约为500km，电池容量为70kW⋅h。普通家用充电桩充电功率为7kW。另一品牌燃油车油箱容积为[X]，匀速行驶时能提供的牵引力大约是2000N，加满一箱汽油大约能匀速行驶400km。上述燃油车加满一箱油，油的质量是多少？（汽油密度取0.7×10^3kg/m^3）参数初始温度的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是56 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油体积] = [油的质量]/[汽油密度]
[油箱容积] = [汽油体积]
en: [ volume of gasoline] = [ oil mass]/[ gasoline density]
[Fuel tank capacity] = [ volume of gasoline]

question.en: A certain middle school provides boiling water for students. A boiler heats 100 kg of water from 25°C to [X], burning 3 kg of smokeless coal. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of smokeless coal is 3.4×10^7 J/kg. Find out: What is the amount of heat absorbed by the water in the boiler? The parameter for diesel calorific value is 4×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 3.15×10^7 J, what is the value that corresponds to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
某中学为学生供应开水，用锅炉将100kg的水从25℃加热到[X]，燃烧了3kg的无烟煤。水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，无烟煤的热值是3.4×10^7J/kg。求
锅炉内的水吸收的热量是多少?参数柴油的热值的值为4×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.15×10^7J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化] = [锅炉内的水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化]
en: [ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by the water in the boiler]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ change in water temperature]

arguments.zh_name: 锅炉内的水吸收的热量
arguments.en_name: heat absorbed by the water in the boiler

question.en: A car using gasoline as fuel is driving at a constant speed on a horizontal road with an engine output power of 60 kW. Given that the calorific value of gasoline is q=4.6×10^7J/kg and the specific heat capacity of water is c=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅°C). The car consumes [X] gasoline while driving at constant speed for 23 minutes. What is the efficiency of the engine? The final temperature of the parameters is 100°C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 30%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
一辆使用汽油为燃料的小汽车，在水平路面上匀速行驶，发动机的输出功率是60kW，已知汽油的热值为q=4.6×10^7J/kg，水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅°C)。
小汽车匀速行驶23min消耗[X]汽油，发动机的效率是多少？参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是30 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [发动机做的有用功]=[发动机功率]×[时间]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [发动机做的有用功]/[发动机的效率]
[汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ useful work done by the engine]=[ engine power]×[ time]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ useful work done by the engine]/[ efficiency of the engine]
[mass of gasoline] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]

question.en: The figure shows the latest prototype of a driverless car. The car uses radar sensors and laser rangefinders to understand the surrounding traffic conditions while driving automatically. When the car travels at a constant speed of [X] on a straight road and covers a distance of 8 km, it consumes 1.5 L of gasoline. Assuming complete combustion of the fuel and the engine efficiency being 30%, during this motion (given: the density of gasoline is 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg), find: What is the output power of the car? The final temperature of the parameters is 60 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 4.05×10^4 W, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
所示，是最新一款无人驾驶汽车原型图。汽车自动驾驶时使用雷达传感器，以及激光测距器来了解周围的交通状况。该款车以[X]的速度在一段平直的公路上匀速行驶了8km时，消耗汽油1.5L．假设燃油完全燃烧，汽油机的效率为30%，那么，在这段运动过程中，（已知：汽油的密度为0.8×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.5×10^7J/kg）
求：
该汽车的输出功率为多少？参数末温的值为60 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.05×10^4 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量]=[汽油密度]×[汽油体积]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]=[汽油质量]×[汽油热值]
[汽车牵引力做的功]=[汽油机效率]×[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]
[时间] = [汽车牵引力做的功]/[汽车的输出功率]
[速度] = [路程]/[时间]
en: [ gasoline mass]=[ gasoline density]×[ gasoline volume]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]=[ gasoline mass]×[ gasoline calorific value]
[ work done by car traction force]=[ gasoline engine efficiency]×[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]
[ time] = [ work done by car traction force]/[ car output power]
[ speed] = [distance]/[ time]

question.en:
The total mass of a car is 2 tons, which travels at a constant speed of 90 km/h along a horizontal road for 20 minutes, consuming 2 kg of gasoline in the process. It is known that the resistance the car encounters while driving is 0.045 times the car's weight, and the calorific value of the gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. Find:

The efficiency of the car during this process. (Result to be rounded to one decimal place) (Supplement: the traction force is [X]; ) The initial temperature parameter value is 20 °C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 29.3%, then what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh:
所示，总质量为2t的小汽车以90km/h的速度沿水平路面匀速直线行驶了20min，此过程消耗汽油2kg，已知汽车在行驶过程中受到的阻力为车重的0.045倍，已知汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg。求：


此过程汽车的效率。（结果保留一位小数） （补充：牵引力是[X]; ）参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是29.3 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [路程]=[速度]×[时间]
[汽油燃烧放出的热量]=[汽油质量]×[汽油热值]
[汽车做的功] = [汽油燃烧放出的热量]*[汽车的效率]
[牵引力] = [汽车做的功]/[路程]
en: [ distance]=[velocity]×[ time]
[ heat released by gasoline combustion]=[ gasoline mass]×[ heating value of gasoline]
[ work done by the car] = [ heat released by gasoline combustion]*[ car efficiency]
[ traction] = [ work done by the car]/[ distance]

question.en: A certain unit uses a natural gas water heater to heat 1000 kg of water from 20°C to 100°C, consuming [X] of natural gas. It is known that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the calorific value of the natural gas used is 4×10^7 J/m^3. Find: What is the heat released by the complete combustion of [X] natural gas? The given value for the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 4×10^8 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
某单位用天然气热水器将1000kg水从20℃加热到100℃，消耗了[X]的天然气。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），所用天然气热值为4×10^7J/m^3,求：
[X]天然气完全燃烧放出的热量？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气热值]
en: [natural gas volume] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ natural gas calorific value]

question.en: During the May Day holiday, Xiao Ming's father used the family car for a self-driving trip. The car traveled for 2 hours at a speed of 120 km/h, and it was estimated from the fuel gauge that approximately [X] of gasoline was consumed. The density of gasoline is \rho = 0.75×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of gasoline is q = 4.5×10^7 J/kg. Xiao Ming learned from a physics book that the efficiency of a gasoline engine is about 30%. Find: the heat released by the complete combustion of gasoline; the initial temperature parameter value is 20 °C. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 5.4×10^8 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 五一期间，小明爸爸利用家中汽车进行了自驾旅游，小汽车以120km/h速度行驶了2h，从油量指示表上估计出消耗汽油约[X].汽油密度\rho=0.75×10^3kg/m^3，汽油热值q=4.5×10^7J/kg。小明从物理书上了解到汽油机的效率约为30%.求：汽油完全燃烧放出的热量；参数初温的值为20 °C。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.4×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[汽油体积] = [汽油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ gasoline mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[Gasoline density]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en: During a camping trip at a certain base, Xiaohong's family uses a stove to heat 2 kg of water from an initial temperature of 20°C to 60°C, consuming [X] kilograms of charcoal in the process. Given: the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), and the calorific value of charcoal q = 3.36×10^7 J/kg. Find: the thermal efficiency of the stove for heating the water. The value for the time parameter is 7.5×60 s. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 10%, what should the value corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 小红一家到某基地露营时，用火炉将质量为2kg、初温为20℃的水加热到60℃，燃烧了[X]木炭。已知：水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，木炭的热值q=3.36×10^7J/kg。求：该火炉烧水的热效率。参数时间的值为7.5×60 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的度数]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量]=[水的比热容]×[水的质量]×[水温升高的度数]
[木炭燃烧放出的热量] = [水吸收的热量]/[火炉烧水的热效率]
[木炭的质量] = [木炭燃烧放出的热量]/[木炭的热值]
en: [ temperature increase of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water]=[specific heat capacity of water]×[ mass of water]×[ temperature increase of water]
[ heat released by burning charcoal] = [ heat absorbed by water]/[ thermal efficiency of heating water with a stove]
[ mass of charcoal] = [ heat released by burning charcoal]/[ calorific value of charcoal]

arguments.en_name: thermal efficiency of heating water with a stove

question.en: A household gas water heater heats 100 kg of tap water from a temperature of [X] to 50°C, consuming 1 m^3 of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of the natural gas). [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m^3.] Find: the heat absorbed by the water. The value of the mineral water volume parameter is 500 mL. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.26×10^7 J, what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg、温度为[X]的自来水加热到50℃，消耗的天然气的体积为1m^3（假设天然气完全燃烧）。[水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），天然气的热值是4.2×10^7J/m^3。]求：水吸收的热量。参数矿泉水体积的值为500 mL。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.26×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[水的初始温度] = [水的最终温度] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature of water] = [final temperature of water] - [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
A metal with a mass of 2 kg, and its temperature is raised from 25℃ to 105℃, requires absorbing 7.52x10^4J of heat. 
Question:
If all the heat is supplied by a fuel with a calorific value of 4x10^7J/kg, at least how much kg of this fuel needs to be burned? (Supplement: The heat absorbed by the metal is [X]; The calorific value of the fuel is 4×10^7J/kg; ) The value of the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.88×10^{-3}kg, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
质量为2kg的金属，温度从25℃升高到105℃，需要吸收的热量是7.52x10^4J。
求：
这些热量全部由热值为4x10^7J/kg的燃料提供，至少需要燃烧这种燃料多少kg? （补充：金属吸收的热量是[X]; 燃料的热值是4×10^7J/kg; ）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.88×10^{-3}kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [金属吸收的热量] = [所需燃料质量]*[燃料的热值]
en: [the heat absorbed by the metal] = [ the required mass of fuel]*[ the calorific value of the fuel]

arguments.en_name: the heat absorbed by the metal
the calorific value of the fuel

question.en: The table below shows the relevant working parameters of a certain model of a van. If the van is fully loaded and travels at a constant speed [X] on a straight road, the work done by the traction force is 4×10^5J. (Take g as 10N/kg) Solve for: Brand ModelJACMaximum Speed120km/hFuel Consumption per 100km20LFuel Calorific Value5.25×10^7J/kgFuel Density0.8×10^3kg/m^3 The traction force of the van; the temperature increase of the water parameter is 50 ℃. If we already know the answer to the question above is 4000 N, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 下表为某型号厢式货车的相关工作参数。如果该车满载货物后在平直的公路上匀速行驶[X]，牵引力所做的功为4×10^5J。(g取10N/kg)求： 品牌型号JAC最高车速120km/h满载百公里油耗20L燃油热值5.25×10^7J/kg燃油密度0.8×10^3kg/m^3 该货车的牵引力；参数水温升高的温度的值为50 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4000 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

en: [ distance traveled] = [Work done]/[ traction force]

question.en: A certain brand of electric kettle has a rated heating power of [X]. The kettle has a capacity of 1.5L, and under standard atmospheric pressure, it operates normally for 10 minutes to boil water initially at 20°C. Find: the electrical energy consumed by the kettle operating normally for 10 minutes, with the final temperature being 100°C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 6.0×10^5 J, what should the value of [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 某品牌电热水壶的额定加热功率为[X]，水壶容量为1.5L，在一个标准大气压下，该电热壶正常工作10min，将以满壶初温为20℃的水烧开，求：电热水壶正常工作10min消耗的电能：参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.0×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [功率] = [消耗的电能]/[时间]
en: [Power] = [ Consumed Energy]/[ Time]

question.en:
A solar water heater is a device that converts solar energy into internal energy. This heater receives an average of 4.2×10^6J of solar energy per hour, and in 5 hours of effective exposure, it elevates the temperature of water with a mass of [X] from an initial temperature of 20℃ to 40℃. Find: 

If coal is used to heat this water, how many kilograms of coal need to be completely burned? (The calorific value of coal q=2.9×10^7J/kg, assuming the heat released by coal burning is entirely absorbed by the water) The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃), and the time value parameter is 0.7 h. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 0.29 kg, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
太阳能热水器是把太阳能转化为内能的设备，某热水器每小时平均接收4.2×10^6J的太阳能，在5小时的有效照射时间内，将热水器中质量为[X]、初温为20℃的水温度升高到40℃。求：
若改用煤来加热这些水，需要完全燃烧多少千克煤？（煤的热值q=2.9×10^7J/kg，假设煤燃烧放出的热量全部被水吸收）水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数时间的值为0.7 h。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.29 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤燃烧放出的热量] = [所需煤的质量]*[煤的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤燃烧放出的热量]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ heat released by burning coal] = [ required mass of coal]*[ calorific value of coal]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by burning coal]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ increase in temperature of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: A group of students in a physics experiment want to explore the absorption and release of heat by objects. They heat 10 kg of water from 20°C to 70°C; then take a nail weighing about 10 g from a high-temperature furnace at [X] and cool it to 25°C. (c_iron = 0.46×10^3 J/(kg·°C), c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C)) Find: the heat released by the nail. The value of the parameter flight time is 1 h. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 3.68×10^3 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
某物理实验小组的同学想要探究物体的吸热及放热情况，他们把10kg的水从20℃加热到70℃；接着把一根质量约为10g的铁钉，从[X]的高温炉中取出，冷却至25℃。（c_铁=0.46×10^3J/（kg·℃），c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃））求：
铁钉放出的热量。参数飞行时间的值为1 h。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.68×10^3 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [铁钉的温度降低量] = [铁钉放出的热量]/([铁的比热容]*[铁钉的质量])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] + [铁钉的温度降低量]
en: [ decrease in temperature of the iron nail] = [ heat released by the iron nail]/([ specific heat capacity of iron]*[The mass of the iron nail])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] + [ decrease in temperature of the iron nail]

decrease in temperature of the iron nail
heat released by the iron nail

question.en:
Environmental protection is a basic national policy in our country. Currently, the country is promoting new energy vehicles. According to relevant data, compared with gasoline cars, harmful gas emissions in the exhaust of natural gas cars are significantly reduced, with no dust emissions. Based on the information provided in the table, calculate and explain:
Calorific value Price
Gasoline q_2=4.6×10^7J/kg 8.0 CNY/kg
Natural Gas q_1=3.5×10^7J/m^3 4.5 CNY/m^3
In a test for a certain model of gasoline engine car, the total mass of the car was 1500 kg. The car traveled at a constant speed for 20 km on a flat road, with the resistance being 0.08 times the weight of the car, consuming 2.2 L of gasoline. The density of gasoline is 0.7×10^3 kg/m^3, and g is taken as 10 N/kg. Find: For this model of car, if it uses natural gas as fuel during this test, the consumption of [X] natural gas is required. Compared to using gasoline, how much fuel cost is saved? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 5.57 CNY, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 环境保护是我国一项基本国策，当前，国家正在推广新能源汽车。据有关资料显示，天然气汽车和汽油车相比较，尾气中的有害气体排放明显减少，无粉尘排放。根据如表提供的信息，通过计算说明： 热值 价格 汽油 q_2=4.6×10^7J/kg 8.0元/kg 天然气 q_1=3.5×10^7J/m^3 4.5元/m^3 某型号汽油发动机小汽车，在某次测试中，车的总质量为1500kg，以某速度在平直路面上匀速行驶20km，车受到的阻力是车重的0.08倍，消耗汽油2.2L。汽油的密度为0.7×10^3kg/m^3，g取10N/kg，求： 该型号的小汽车，若用天然气做燃料，在该段测试中消耗[X]的天然气，与用汽油相比，它节约的燃料成本是多少？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.57CNY，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量]=[汽油密度]×[汽油体积]
[汽油成本]=[汽油质量]×[汽油单价]
[天然气成本] = [汽油成本] - [节约的燃料成本]
[天然气体积] = [天然气成本]/[天然气单价]
en: [ Gasoline Mass]=[Gasoline Density]×[ Gasoline Volume]
[ Gasoline Cost]=[ Gasoline Mass]×[ Gasoline Unit Price]
[ Natural Gas Cost] = [ Gasoline Cost] - [ Saved Fuel Cost]
[ Natural Gas Volume] = [ Natural Gas Cost]/[ Natural Gas Unit Price]

question.en:
The figure shows a new type of four-wheel beach go-kart, which travels at a constant speed of 36 km/h on a flat beach for 20 minutes, consuming 1.5 L of gasoline. During the entire journey, the power of the engine pulling the go-kart forward is constantly [X]. Given that the density of gasoline is 0.8×10^3 kg/m^3 and the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, then, during this movement, find:
What is the efficiency of the go-kart's gasoline engine? The initial temperature parameter is 20 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 25%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
所示是一款新型四轮沙滩卡丁车，该车以36km/h的速度在一段平直的沙滩上匀速行驶20min，消耗汽油1.5L。整个行驶过程中，发动机牵引卡丁车前进所做功的功率恒为[X]。已知汽油的密度为0.8×10^3kg/m^3，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg，那么，在这段运动过程中，求：
该卡丁车汽油机的效率为多少？参数初始温度的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是25 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗汽油的质量]=[汽油的密度]×[消耗汽油的体积]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]=[消耗汽油的质量]×[汽油的热值]
[发动机做的功] = [卡丁车汽油机的效率]*[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]
[功率] = [发动机做的功]/[时间]
en: [ mass of consumed gasoline]=[density of gasoline]×[ volume of consumed gasoline]
[ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]=[ mass of consumed gasoline]×[ calorific value of gasoline]
[ work done by the engine] = [ efficiency of the go-kart gasoline engine]*[ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]
[ power] = [ work done by the engine]/[ time]

arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline
efficiency of the go-kart gasoline engine

question.en:
Boiling water with a natural gas stove, burning 0.5m^3 of natural gas raises the temperature of 100kg of water from 20°C to [X]. Given that the specific heat capacity of water c = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of natural gas q = 7.0×10^7 J/m^3. Find:
The heat absorbed by water Q_abs. The parameter consumption value of natural gas volume is 2.5 m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.1×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?

用天然气灶烧水，燃烧0.5m^3的天然气，使100kg的水从20℃升高到[X]。已知水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，天然气的热值q=7.0×10^7J/m^3。求：
水吸收的热量Q_吸。参数消耗天然气体积的值为2.5 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.1×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]

[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en: Xiao Ming uses his knowledge to estimate the calorific value of the natural gas used at home; he uses a gas stove to heat a mass of [X] water from 20℃ to 80℃, during which the meter reading of natural gas changes by 0.035m^3. If the efficiency of the gas stove is 36%, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃), how much heat did the water absorb during this process? The calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m³. If we know that the answer to the above question is 5.04×10^5 J, what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
小明用所学知识估算家中所用天然气的热值；用燃气灶将质量为[X]的水从20℃加热至80℃的过程中，观察到天然气表的数字变化了0.035m^3。若燃气灶的效率为36%，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg⋅℃）。
在这个过程中水吸收了多少热量？参数天然气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.04×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ change in temperature of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ change in temperature of water])

question.en:
A solar water heater is one of the devices that converts solar energy into internal energy. A certain brand of solar water heater receives an average of 4.2×10^6 J of solar energy per hour, and during 5 hours of effective exposure, raises the temperature of water in the heater with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃ to 40℃. Find:
The heat absorbed by the water in the heater Q; [Specific heat capacity of water c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)] The parameter volume value of the fuel is 1.5×10^-3 m³. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 8.4×10^6 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?

太阳能热水器是把太阳能转化为内能的设备之一．某品牌太阳能热水器每小时平均接收4.2×10^6J的太阳能，在5小时的有效照射时间内，将热水器中质量为[X]、初温为20℃的水温度升高到40℃．求：
热水器中的水吸收的热量Q；[水的比热容c=4.2×10^3J/(kg．℃)]参数燃油体积的值为1.5×10^-3 m³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [热水器中的水吸收的热量Q]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by the water in the heater Q]/([ temperature increase of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
A mini truck with a mass of 2 tons carries 4 tons of sand and gravel. It is known that when the truck travels at a constant speed on a flat road, the resistance it encounters is 0.2 times the total weight of the truck. The truck travels at a constant speed of 15 m/s on the flat road, consuming gasoline [X]. (The heating value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg, g=10 N/kg). Calculate: 

How much heat is released by completely burning [X] of gasoline? The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above question is 9×10^7 J, then what should [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
质量为2t的小型载重汽车，装有4t的砂石，已知汽车在平直公路上匀速行驶时所受阻力是汽车总重的0.2倍，汽车以15m/s的速度在平直公路上匀速行驶，消耗了汽油[X]，（汽油的热值取4.5×10^7J/kg，g=10N/kg）求：
[X]的汽油完全燃烧放出多少热量？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是9×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [mass of gasoline] = [ heat released during complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]
