question.en: A factory tested the performance of a car engine by having the car travel 140 km at an average speed of 70 km/h, using [X] liters of gasoline. The density of gasoline is 0.7×10^3 kg/m^3, and its calorific value is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. Determine the heat released when the gasoline is completely burned. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 6.44×10^8 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh: 某工厂为了测试汽车发动机的性能，让汽车以70km/h的平均速度行驶了140km，用去汽油[X]升，已知汽油的密度为0.7×10^3kg/m^3，热值为4.6×10^7J/kg。求：汽油完全燃烧放出的热量。参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.44×10^8 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
[汽油体积] = [汽油质量]/[汽油密度]
en: [ gasoline mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ gasoline calorific value]
[ gasoline volume] = [ gasoline mass]/[gasoline density]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en: To provide the tropical fish in the aquarium with a suitable living environment, Xiaoqiang uses a "220V 300W" heating rod to heat the water. When the water temperature rises to the set value of 25℃, the heating rod automatically stops working. When the water temperature naturally cools to 20℃, the heating rod automatically starts heating again, in a cycle. During each heating cycle, 20% of the heat is lost, and the mass of the water in the aquarium remains at 40 kg. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃). Under the rated voltage, how many minutes does the heating rod work each time? (Keep the calculation result to one decimal place.) (Supplement: Efficiency is 1-20%; (heat absorbed by water) is [X];) Given the value of the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 58.3 min, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 为了让鱼缸内的热带鱼有一个适合的生活环境，小强用一只“220V300W”的加热棒给鱼缸内的水加热。当水温升到设定值25℃时加热棒自动停止工作，待水温自然冷却到20℃时加热棒自动开始加热，周而复始，每次加热期间损失20%的热量，鱼缸内水的质量始终保持为40kg，c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)额定电压下，加热棒每次工作的时间是多少分钟？（计算结果保留一位小数） （补充：效率是1-20%; (水吸收的热量)是[X]; ）参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是58.3 min，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [加热棒产的热量] = [功率]*[加热时间]
[(水吸收的热量)] = [加热棒产的热量]*[效率]
en: [ Heat produced by the heating rod] = [ Power]*[ Heating time]
[ (Heat absorbed by water)] = [ Heat produced by the heating rod]*[Efficiency]

arguments.en_name: Heat produced by the heating rod

question.en:
A car with a power of 40000W and an engine efficiency of [X] is traveling on a straight road, with only 5kg of gasoline left in the tank. Assuming there are no other energy losses in the engine, and the car is moving forward at a speed of 15m/s, how many kilometers can it continue to travel (the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg)?
The final temperature value is 100 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 21.56 km, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
有一功率为40000W，热机的效率为[X]的汽车正在一平直的公路上行驶，此时油箱中仅剩下5kg的汽油。如果不考虑热机其他的能量损失，汽车以15m/s的速度向前行驶，问还可前进多少千米（汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg）
参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是21.56 km，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]=[汽油质量]×[汽油的热值]
[行驶时间] = [行驶距离]/[速度]
[转化的机械能] = [功率]*[行驶时间]
[热机效率] = [转化的机械能]/[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]=[gasoline mass]×[ calorific value of gasoline]
[ travel time] = [ travel distance]/[ speed]
[ converted mechanical energy] = [ power]*[ travel time]
[ thermal efficiency] = [ converted mechanical energy]/[ heat released from complete combustion of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released from complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
Xiaoming uses a gas stove to heat 2 kg of water from 25℃ to [X]. The thermal efficiency of the gas stove is 60%, the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃), and the calorific value of natural gas q is 3.5×10^7 J/m^3. Find:
The volume of natural gas consumed. The value of the current parameter is 0.5 A. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 0.03 m^3, what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh:
小明用天然气灶将质量为2kg、温度为25℃的水加热到[X]，燃气灶的热效率为60%，水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，天然气的热值q=3.5×10^7J/m^3。求：
消耗天然气的体积。参数电流的值为0.5 A。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.03 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[消耗天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[燃气灶的热效率]
[水温升高的度数] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温升高的度数]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas consumed]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]*[ heat efficiency of the gas stove]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.en_name: heat efficiency of the gas stove

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: "The phrase 'Co-building a hygienic city, constructing a beautiful home' describes a scenario where a 'fog cannon vehicle' sprays mist to reduce dust. After a spray, the vehicle moves uniformly over a 200m straight road in 20s under the action of a traction force [X]. Find: The power of the traction force on the vehicle during this process. The calorific value of the gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. If the answer to the above question is known to be 4×10^4 W, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?"
question.zh:
“共建卫生城市，构建美好家园”，所示是“雾炮车”喷洒水雾以减少扬尘的情段。某次喷酒完后，该车在[X]的牵引力作用下，匀速通过200m的平直道路用时20s。求：
此过程中该车牵引力的功率。参数汽油的热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4×10^4 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [速度]=[路程]/[时间]
[牵引力] = [功率]/[速度]
en: [ velocity]=[ distance]/[ time]
[traction force] = [ power]/[ velocity]

question.en:
Excessive exploitation of coal, oil, and natural gas has led humanity to face an energy crisis. In winter, a certain county uses geothermal energy for heating. There is a self-spouting geothermal well in the county with a water temperature of [X] and a water flow rate of 150 m^3/h. 

Calculate the heat released when the temperature of the geothermal water flowing out each hour drops to 50℃. The density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃), the calorific value of gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg. If the known answer to the above problem is 2.52×10^{10} J, then what should be the value corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
煤、石油、天然气的过量开采使人类面临能源危机。某县在冬季利用地热能为用户取暖。县内有一口自喷状态地热井，出水温度为[X]，出水流量为150m^3/h。
求每小时流出的地热水温度降低到50℃，所放出的热量。水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数煤气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.52×10^{10} J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [每小时流出水的质量]=[水的密度]×[每小时出水流量体积]
[水的温度降低量] = [每小时流出的地热水放出的热量]/([每小时流出水的质量]*[水的比热容])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] + [水的温度降低量]
en: [ hourly outflow water mass]=[Density of water]×[ hourly water flow volume]
[ water temperature decrease] = [ hourly released heat from geothermal water]/([ hourly outflow water mass]*[ specific heat capacity of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] + [ water temperature decrease]

arguments.zh_name: 每小时流出的地热水放出的热量
arguments.en_name: hourly released heat from geothermal water

question.en:
With the improvement of people's living standards, more and more families are using "geothermal" for heating. Its principle is: Laying heat dissipation pipes under the decorative layer of the room floor, the heat dissipation of hot water in the pipes increases the room temperature. When the water supply temperature is 45℃, the heat dissipation power per unit area and the corresponding relationship with the floor decorative layer material and heat dissipation pipe material are shown in the table. Find:
Floor Decorative Layer Material/Heat Dissipation Pipe MaterialCeramicPlasticWood Floor
Polyethylene136.6 W/m^2103.5 W/m^293.5 W/m^2
Polybutylene125.7 W/m^296.9 W/m^290.0 W/m^2
If a family has a wood floor area of 100 m^2 and the heat dissipation pipe material is polybutylene, with a water supply temperature of 45℃, what is the heat dissipation of the heating system per hour in joules? (Supplement: The total heat dissipation power is [X]; time is 3600 s; the heating value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 3.24×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?)
question.zh: 随着人们生活水平的提高，越来越多的家庭采用“地热”进行取暖．所示，其原理是：在房间地面装饰层下铺设散热管道，通过管道内的热水散热提高室温．当供水温度为45℃时，单位面积的散热功率与地面装饰层材料、散热管材料的对应关系见表．求：地面装饰层材料散热管材料陶瓷塑料木地板聚乙烯136.6W/m^2103.5W/m^293.5W/m^2聚丁烯125.7W/m^296.9W/m^290.0W/m^2某家庭木地板的面积为100m^2，散热管材料为聚丁烯，供水温度为45℃，则该供暖系统每小时的散热量为多少焦耳？ （补充：总的散热功率是[X]; 时间是3600s; ）参数汽油的热值的值为4.6×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.24×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [总的散热功率] = [每小时散热量]/[时间]
en: [Total heat dissipation power] = [ hourly heat dissipation量]/[ time]

question.en:
One of the devices that converts solar energy into internal energy is a solar water heater. A certain brand of solar water heater receives an average of 4.2×10^6 J of solar energy per hour and raises the temperature of 100 kg of water from an initial temperature of [X] to 40℃ during 5 hours of effective sunlight exposure. Find:
If gas is used to heat this water instead, how many kilograms of gas need to be completely burned? (The calorific value of the gas q = 4.2×10^7 J/kg, assuming the heat released from burning the gas is fully absorbed by the water) The total solar energy received by the solar water heater in 5 hours is 2.1×10^7 J. (Supplement: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃);) The parameter rated voltage value is 220 V. If we know the answer to the above question is 0.2 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
太阳能热水器是把太阳能转化为内能的设备之一．某品牌太阳能热水器每小时平均接收4.2×10^6J的太阳能，在5小时的有效照射时间内，将热水器中质量为100kg、初温为[X]的水温度升高到40℃．求：
若改用煤气来加热这些水，需要完全燃烧多少千克煤气？（煤气的热值q=4.2×10^7J/kg，假设煤气燃烧放出的热量全部被水吸收）太阳能热水器在5小时内接收的总太阳能为2.1×10^7J （补充：水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃); ）参数额定电压的值为220 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.2 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤气燃烧放出的热量] = [所需煤气的质量]*[煤气的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤气燃烧放出的热量]
[水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
en: [ heat released by gas combustion] = [ mass of gas required]*[ calorific value of gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by gas combustion]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])

question.en: Xiao Gang's family installed a solar water heater with a tank capacity of 200L. Xiao Gang conducted an observation activity: on Sunday morning, he measured the temperature of tap water as [X] with a thermometer and then filled the heater's tank with water. At noon, the "temperature sensor" showed that the water temperature in the tank was 70℃. Please solve the following problem: (C_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), q_gas = 4.2×10^7 J/kg) the amount of heat absorbed by the water; the density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3. The calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.2×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh: 小刚家安装了一台太阳能热水器，水箱容积是200L，小刚进行了一次观察活动：星期天早上，他用温度计测得自来水的温度为[X]，然后给热水器水箱送满水，中午时“温度传感器”显示水箱中的水温为70℃．请你求解下列问题：（C_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）、q_{煤气}=4.2×10^7J/kg）水吸收的热量；水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3参数天然气的热值的值为4.2×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初始温度] = [最终温度] - [水升高的温度]
en: [ mass of water]=[density of water]×[ volume of water]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ temperature rise of water]

question.en:
In modern home decoration, most bathrooms use gas water heaters to provide hot water. Xiao Fang's home has installed a gas water heater. It is known that the temperature of the water before entering the water heater is [X], and the temperature of the hot water output by the water heater during the shower is set to 40℃. The density of water ρ_water = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃). If Xiao Fang uses 0.05 m^3 of hot water for one shower, find:
If 70% of the heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas is absorbed by the water, how many m^3 of natural gas are consumed? (The calorific value of natural gas q = 4×10^7 J/m^3, and the formula for the heat released by the complete combustion of gas is Q = qV, where V represents the volume of gas burned.) The voltage across the sliding resistor is 6 V. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 0.225 m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
现代家庭装修中浴室大多用燃气热水器提供热水，小芳家安装了燃气热水器。已知水进入热水器前的温度是[X]，洗澡时热水器输出热水的温度设定为40℃；水的密度ρ_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），如果小芳洗一次澡用热水0.05m^3。求：
若天然气完全燃烧释放热量的70%被水吸收，需要消耗多少m^3的天然气？（天然气的热值q=4×10^7J/m^3，气体完全燃烧放出的热量的公式Q=qV，式中V表示燃烧气体的体积）参数滑动变阻器两端电压的值为6 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.225 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [热水的质量]=[水的密度]×[热水的体积]
[天然气完全燃烧需要释放的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[消耗天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧需要释放的热量]*[效率]
[温差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[热水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [温差]
en: [ mass of hot water]=[density of water]×[ volume of hot water]
[ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas consumed]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]*[ efficiency]
[ temperature difference] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of hot water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ temperature difference]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧需要释放的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
A group of students used an alcohol burner to heat water with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃. After some time, the water temperature was measured to be 50℃, with 7g of alcohol consumed. They then quickly heated it on a natural gas stove to bring it to a boil (at one standard atmospheric pressure, ignoring heat loss during water transfer). Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), the calorific value of alcohol is 3×10^7 J/kg, and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.5×10^7 J/m^3. Calculate:
If the water heating efficiency of the natural gas stove is 60%, how many cubic meters of natural gas are required?
The mass of water is the [X] value of the parameter time of 10 minutes. If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.005 m^3, what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
某小组同学用酒精灯给质量为[X]初温度为20℃的水加热，经过一段时间测得水温为50℃，消耗了7g酒精，然后迅速将其放在天然气灶加热至恰好沸腾（一个标准大气压下，不计水转移过程中的热量损失）。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），酒精的热值为3×10^7J/kg，天然气的热值为3.5×10^7J/m^3．求：
若天然气灶的烧水效率为60%，需要消耗多少m^3的天然气？
水的质量为[X]参数时间的值为10 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.005 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[消耗天然气的体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]*[天然气灶的效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of consumed natural gas]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]*[ efficiency of gas stove]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[Specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: A car is moving at a constant speed of 30 m/s on a straight highway for a distance of 2.3 km, experiencing a resistance of 900 N, and burns [X] gasoline (the heat value of gasoline q = 4.6×10^7 J/kg). Find: the heat released by the complete combustion of this gasoline; the volume value of the natural gas parameter is 0.5 m^3. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 6.9×10^6 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 一辆汽车以30m/s的速度在平直的高速公路上匀速行驶了2.3km，受到的阻力为900N，燃烧了[X]汽油。（汽油的热值q=4.6×10^7J/kg）求：这些汽油完全燃烧放出的热量；参数天然气的体积的值为0.5 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.9×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油的质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油的热值]
en: [ mass of gasoline] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[gasoline calorific value]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
After learning the calorific value of fuel, Xiao Ning was curious about the calorific value of the natural gas used at home. So, he placed a kettle with [X] of water on the gas stove at home to heat it up. By using a thermometer, he measured the water heating from 20°C to 80°C and observed that the gas meter reading changed by 0.035 m³. He found online that the efficiency of the gas stove is approximately 36%. Find:

Determine the mass of the water in the kettle; the density of water is 1×10³ kg/m³ and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10³ J/(kg·°C). If we already know the answer to the above problem is 2 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
小宁同学学习了燃料的热值后，很想知道家中使用的天然气的热值是多少，于是，他在家里将装有[X]水的水壶放到天然气灶上去烧，所示，用温度计测量水从20℃加热至80℃的过程中，观察到天然气表的数字变化了0.035m^3。他通过上网查阅得知天然气灶的效率约为36%。求：


求水壶里水的质量；水的密度为1×10^3kg/m³参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ volume of water] = [ mass of water]/[density of water]

question.en: By the end of 2020, buses in key cities will be fully replaced by new energy buses. The unladen mass of a new energy bus is 3t, the contact area of the tires with the ground is 2500cm^2, the engine rated power is 60000W, and it is equipped with a hydrogen tank that can hold 30kg of hydrogen and a power battery with a capacity of 1000kW·h. After the hydrogen fuel is exhausted, it can switch to pure electric mode to continue operating. (Given that g=10N/kg, q_hydrogen=1.4×10^8J/kg) When the new energy bus travels in a uniform straight motion at rated power on the highway for 5 minutes, it moves [X]. Find out what the resistance acting on the new energy bus is. The specific heat capacity of water is known to be 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above problem is 3×10^3 N, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 2020年底，重点城市公交车将全部更换为新能源公交车，某新能源公交车空车质量为3t，轮胎接触地面面积为2500cm^2，发动机额定功率为60000W，配备能装入30kg氢气的氢气瓶和容量为1000kW·h的动力电池。氢燃料用完后可切换到纯电模式继续运行。(已知g=10N/kg，q_氢=1.4×10^8J/kg)当新能源公交车在公路上以额定功率做匀速直线运动，在5min运动了[X]，求新能源公交车受到的阻力是多少？参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3×10^3 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力] = [阻力]
[速度] = [功率]/[牵引力]
[路程] = [时间]*[速度]
en: [ traction force] = [ resistance]
[ velocity] = [ power]/[ traction force]
[distance] = [ time]*[ velocity]

question.en: Xiao Ming's family has recently purchased a new natural gas water heater with a capacity of 80 liters. After learning about thermal efficiency, Xiao Ming attempts to estimate the thermal efficiency of the water heater. He sets the "inflow" to [X] and the "outflow temperature" to 40°C, then starts heating. When the water temperature reaches 40°C, the heating automatically stops. It is known that the tap water temperature at the time was 20°C, the gas meter reading was 129.96m³ before heating, and became 130.06m³ after heating stopped. The calorific value of natural gas q_natural gas = 4.2×10^7 J/m³, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C). Find: the amount of heat absorbed by the water in the tank; the density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m³; the parameter value for time is 300 s. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 3.36×10^6 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 小明家新买来一台容积为80L的天然气热水器。小明学习了热效率的知识后，尝试估测该热水器的热效率，他把“进水量”设置为[X]，“出水温度”设置为40℃后，开始加热。当水温达到40℃时，自动停止加热。已知当时自来水的温度是20℃，加热前天然气表的示数为129.96m³，停止加热后变为130.06m³。天然气的热值q天然气=4.2×10^7J/m³，水的比热容c水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）。求：水箱中水吸收的热量；水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m³参数时间的值为300 s。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的量]=[出水温度]-[进水温度]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水温升高的量]*[水的比热容])
[水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
en: [ Amount of temperature rise of water]=[ Outlet water temperature]-[ Inlet water temperature]
[ Mass of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([ Amount of temperature rise of water]*[ Specific heat capacity of water])
[ Volume of water] = [ Mass of water]/[Density of water]

arguments.en_name: Amount of temperature rise of water

question.en: Xiao Ming's family bought a new natural gas water heater with a capacity of 80 liters. After learning about thermal efficiency, Xiao Ming tries to estimate the thermal efficiency of the water heater. He sets the "inlet water amount" to [X] and the "outlet temperature" to 40°C before starting heating. The heating stops automatically when the water temperature reaches 40°C. It is known that the tap water temperature at that time was 20°C. Before heating, the gas meter reading was 129.96m^3, and it became 130.06m^3 after heating stopped. The calorific value of natural gas q_gas is 4.2×10^7J/m^3, and the specific heat capacity of water c_water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg°C), with 1L=10^{-3}m^3. Calculate the mass of the water in the tank; the density of water is 1×10^3kg/m^3. The calorific value of dry wood is 1.2×10^7 J/kg. If we know that the answer to the above problem is 40 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 小明家新买来一台容积为80L的天然气热水器。小明学习了热效率的知识后，尝试估测该热水器的热效率，他把“进水量”设置为[X]，“出水温度”设置为40℃后，开始加热。当水温达到40℃时，自动停止加热。已知当时自来水的温度是20℃，加热前天然气表的示数为129.96m^3，停止加热后变为130.06m^3。天然气的热值q_{天然气}=4.2×10^7J/m^3，水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg℃)，1L=10^{-3}m^3。求：水箱中水的质量；水的密度为1×10^3kg/m^3参数干木柴的热值的值为1.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是40 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的体积] = [水的质量]/[水的密度]
[进水量] = [水的体积]
en: [ volume of water] = [ mass of water]/[ density of water]
[inflow] = [ volume of water]

question.en:
To improve urban air quality, many cities use mist cannon trucks to spray water for dust suppression. For a mist cannon truck spraying water on a horizontal surface, the outlet area at the bottom of the truck's water tank is 50 cm^2. (Take g as 10 N/kg, ρ_water = 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3, and the calorific value of diesel as 4.0×10^7 J/kg) Find: 

The mist cannon truck moves at a constant speed for 20 minutes with a power of [X]. Given that the efficiency of the diesel engine is 40%, calculate the mass of diesel consumed. (Supplement: The power is [X];) The value of the temperature increase of the water is 50 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 6 kg, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
为改善城市空气质量，很多城市用雾炮车洒水除尘。为一台正在水平路面上洒水的雾炮车，车内水箱底部出水口面积为50cm^2。（g取10N/kg，ρ_水=1.0×10^3kg/m^3，柴油的热值取4.0×10^7J/kg）求：
雾炮车以[X]的功率匀速行驶20min，若柴油机效率为40%，需要消耗柴油的质量。 （补充：功率是[X]; ）参数水温升高的温度的值为50 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [柴油产生的热量] = [柴油的热值]*[需要消耗柴油的质量]
[发动机做的功] = [柴油产生的热量]*[柴油机效率]
[功率] = [发动机做的功]/[时间]
en: [ heat generated by diesel] = [ calorific value of diesel]*[ required mass of diesel consumption]
[ work done by the engine] = [ heat generated by diesel]*[ diesel engine efficiency]
[Power] = [ work done by the engine]/[ time]

question.en:
In the experiment comparing the heat absorption of different substances, a 250W rated electric heater is used to heat equal masses of water and edible oil for 2 minutes, with the heater working normally. The recorded data is as follows, [ignore the effect of vaporization on mass, c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)] calculate:
Substance Initial Temperature/℃ Final Temperature/℃
Water 18 38
Edible Oil 18 68
Mass of edible oil. (Supplement: the mass of water is [X]; ) The value of natural gas calorific value parameter is 8×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.3 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 在比较不同物质吸热情况的实验中，用额定功率为250W的电加热器分别对质量相等的水和食用油加热2min，电加热器均正常工作，记录的数据如下表所示，[忽略汽化对质量的影响，c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）]求： 物质 初温/℃ 末温/℃ 水 18 38 食用油 18 68 食用油的质量。 （补充：水的质量是[X]; ）参数天然气热值的值为8×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.3 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [食用油的质量]
en: [mass of water] = [ mass of cooking oil]

question.en:
A school uses a boiler to heat water. When heating water with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 20℃ to boiling point, 2.8kg of coal is completely burned. Given that the specific heat capacity of water c_water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of coal q is 3×10^7J/kg, with the local atmospheric pressure being one standard atmosphere, find:
The efficiency of the boiler when heating water. The volume of gasoline parameter is 5 L. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 40%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
某学校用锅炉烧水时，把质量为[X]，初温为20℃的水加热至沸腾，需完全燃烧2.8kg焦炭，已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）焦炭的热值q=3×10^7J/kg，若当地大气压强为一个标准大气压，求：
锅炉烧水时的效率。参数汽油体积的值为5 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是40 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[焦炭完全燃烧放出的热量]=[焦炭的质量]×[焦炭的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [焦炭完全燃烧放出的热量]*[锅炉烧水时的效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat released by complete combustion of coke]=[ mass of coke]×[ calorific value of coke]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of coke]*[ efficiency of boiling water in boiler]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of coke
efficiency of boiling water in boiler

question.en: In modern society, "turning waste into treasure" has become an important way to save energy. For example, burning waste can generate electricity, which not only processes the waste but also contributes to energy saving and emission reduction. Studies have shown that burning 100 kg of waste can release 8.4×10^7 J of heat. If all this energy is absorbed by water, how many kilograms of [X] water can be boiled at standard atmospheric pressure? [c_water=4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃)]. The calorific value of natural gas is 7×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 250 kg, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
现代社会，“变废为宝”已成为节约能源的重要途径，例如将垃圾“焚烧”可以发电，这样既处理了垃圾，又起到了节能减排的效果。经研究表明每焚烧100kg垃圾可放出热量8.4×10^7J。
如果这些能量全部被水吸收，可将多少千克[X]的水在一个标准大气压下烧开？[c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)]。参数天然气的热值的值为7×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是250kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水吸收的热量]=[垃圾放出的热量]
[水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初始温度] = -[水升高的温度] + [沸点温度]
en: [ heat absorbed by water]=[Heat released by waste]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = -[ temperature rise of water] + [ boiling point temperature]

question.en: Xiao Xing's household solar water heater's tank can hold up to 200 kg of water. Xiao Xing conducted an observation activity: one morning, he measured the tap water temperature as 20℃ using a thermometer, then filled the water heater tank to the brim. At noon, the "temperature sensor" showed the water temperature in the tank as [X]. Solve the following problem: If the heat absorbed by the water was supplied by burning natural gas with a burner efficiency of 40%, calculate the minimum volume of natural gas that needs to be burned. (The calorific value of natural gas q_{natural gas} = 3.5×10^7 J/m^3). The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃) and the contact area of a single tire with the ground is 200 cm^2. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.5 m^3, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 小星家的太阳能热水器，水箱最多能装200kg的水。小星进行了一次观察活动：某天早上，他用温度计测得自来水的温度为20℃，然后给热水器水箱加满水，中午时“温度传感器”显示水箱中的水温为[X]。请你求解下列问题：如果水吸收的这些热量，由燃烧天然气来提供，而气灶的效率为40%，求至少需要燃烧多少立方米天然气？（天然气的热值q_{天然气}=3.5×10^7J/m^3）。水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数单个轮胎与地接触面积的值为200 cm^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.5 m^3，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气放出的热量] = [天然气的热值]*[需要燃烧的天然气体积]
[水吸收的热量] = [天然气放出的热量]*[气灶的效率]
[水温升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温升高的温度]
en: [ heat released by natural gas] = [ calorific value of natural gas]*[ volume of natural gas to be burned]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by natural gas]*[ efficiency of gas stove]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[water mass])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.en_name: volume of natural gas to be burned

question.en:
The nameplate of an electric kettle indicates that Xiaoming uses this kettle to boil 1 kg of water at a temperature of 23°C, taking 7 minutes. It is known that c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), assuming the boiling water environment is under 1 standard atmosphere, the kettle works normally. Find:

The heat absorbed by the water when boiled; the final temperature of the water is [X] parameter value for the volume of water is 200 L. If we already know the answer to the question above is 3.234×10^5 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
某电热水壶的铭牌所示，小明用这个电热水壶将1kg、温度为23℃的水烧开，所用时间是7min。已知c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），假设烧水的环境在1标准大气压下，
水壶正常工作．求：


水被烧开所吸收的热量；水的末温为[X]参数水的体积的值为200 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.234×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ change in temperature of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ change in temperature of water]

question.en:
As shown is a type of solid alcohol stove, which is safer to use than a liquid alcohol stove. In order to determine the thermal efficiency of this solid alcohol stove, 40g of solid alcohol is placed in the stove. After the solid alcohol is completely burned, the temperature of 1kg of water in the pot rises from 20°C to [X]. The calorific value of solid alcohol is known to be 1.5×10^7 J/kg, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C).

What is the thermal efficiency of the solid alcohol stove measured by Xiaoming? The volume of the parameter gasoline is 20 L. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 35%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
所示为某种固体酒精炉，固体酒精炉比液体酒精炉使用时更安全。为了测定该固体酒精炉的热效率，在炉中放入40g的固体酒精，当固体酒精燃烧完后，锅中1kg的水温度从20℃升高到了[X]。已知固体酒精的热值为1.5×10^7J/kg，水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃）。

小明测得固体酒精炉的热效率是多大？参数汽油的体积的值为20 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是35 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [固体酒精燃烧放出的热量]=[固体酒精的质量]×[固体酒精的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [固体酒精炉的热效率]*[固体酒精燃烧放出的热量]
[水的温度变化] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化]
en: [ heat released by burning solid alcohol]=[ mass of solid alcohol]×[ calorific value of solid alcohol]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ thermal efficiency of solid alcohol furnace]*[ heat released by burning solid alcohol]
[ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

arguments.en_name: heat released by burning solid alcohol
thermal efficiency of solid alcohol furnace

question.en:
Using a gas stove, 2 kg of water is heated from an initial temperature of 20℃ to [X], consuming 25 g of gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is c=4.2×10^3 J/(kg•℃), and the calorific value of gas is q=4.2×10^7 J/kg, then:  
How much heat is absorbed by the water? The value of the contact area of the parameters is 0.1 m^2. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.2×10^5 J, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
用煤气灶把2kg，初温为20℃的水烧热到[X]，消耗了25g煤气，已知水的比热容是c=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），煤气的热值为q=4.2×10^7J/kg，则：
水吸收的热量为多少？参数接触面积的值为0.1 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水升高的温度差]
en: [ temperature difference of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature difference of water]

question.en:
The minimum fuel consumption of a certain car is [X]/(kW·h), indicating that the car requires at least [X] gasoline to obtain 1 kW·h of energy. It is known that the calorific value of gasoline is 4.6×10^7 J/kg. Find:
The maximum efficiency of the car engine. (Supplement: 1 kW·h converted to J is 3.6×10^6 J; ) The value of the parameter gasoline volume is 1.5 L. If we know that the answer to the above question is 39.1%, what should the content correspond to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
某汽车的最低油耗是[X]/（kW·h），表示该汽车获得1kW·h的能量至少消耗[X]汽油。已知汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg。求：
该汽车发动机的最高效率。 （补充：1kW·h转换为J是3.6×10^6J; ）参数汽油体积的值为1.5 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是39.1 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [最大有用功的能量]=[1kW·h转换为J]
[汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [最大有用功的能量]/[汽车发动机的最高效率]
[汽油质量] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]/[汽油热值]
en: [ energy of maximum useful work]=[ conversion of 1 kW·h to J]
[ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ energy of maximum useful work]/[ maximum efficiency of car engine]
[mass of gasoline] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]/[ calorific value of gasoline]

arguments.zh_name: 汽油完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

arguments.zh_name: 汽车发动机的最高效率

question.en:
The amphibious aircraft "Kunlong-600," independently developed by our country, can undertake large-scale firefighting and water-based rescue missions. If the amphibious aircraft flies at a constant speed of [X] in a straight line for 60 seconds, consuming 50 kg of aviation fuel, and the engine efficiency is 40%, with q_{fuel} = 4.2×10^7 J/kg. Find:
The distance it flies during this process. The parameter total contact area of the wheels with the ground is 300×10^-4 m^2. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 600 m, what should [X] be referring to in the problem statement?
question.zh:
是我国自主研发的水陆两栖飞机“鲲龙-600”，它可以承担大型灭火、水上救援等任务。若该两栖飞机以[X]的速度匀速直线飞行60s，消耗航空燃油50kg，发动机的效率为40%，已知q_{燃油}=4.2×10^7J/kg。求：
它在此过程中飞行的路程。参数车轮与地面接触总面积的值为300×10^-4 m^2。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是600 m，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [速度] = [飞行路程]/[时间]
en: [velocity] = [ flight distance]/[ time]

question.en: Xiaoming uses an iron pot with a mass of 0.5 kg containing 2 kg of water, heated on a natural gas stove until boiling (at this time the room temperature is 20°C and at 1 standard atmospheric pressure), requiring the complete combustion of 0.03 m^3 of natural gas. The specific heat capacity of iron c_iron = 0.46×10^3 J/(kg·°C), the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of natural gas q_natural gas = 4.0×10^7 J/m^3. Find: How much heat does the natural gas stove need to absorb to heat 2 kg of water from 20°C to boiling; the final temperature of water = [X] parameter's calorific value of solid alcohol is 1.5×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 6.72×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 小明用质量为0.5kg的铁锅装了2kg水，放在天然气灶上加热到烧开（此时房间内室温为20℃且为1标准大气压），需要完全燃烧0.03m^3的天然气。其中c_铁=0.46×10^3J/(kg·℃)，c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，q_{天然气}=4.0×10^7J/m^3。求：该天然气灶把2kg水从20℃加热到烧开需要吸收多少热量；水的末温=[X]参数固体酒精的热值的值为1.5×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是6.72×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[水的末温] = [水的初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature of water] = [ initial temperature of water] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en:
During the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, hydrogen fuel buses and pure electric vehicles became the primary means of transportation, with the usage ratio of new energy vehicles being the highest in the history of the Winter Olympics. The scenario shows a hydrogen fuel bus traveling on a flat road, with the calorific value of hydrogen being 1.4×10^8 J/kg. Question:

What is the amount of heat released when hydrogen fuel with a mass of [X] is completely burned? The final temperature parameter is 55 ℃. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^7 J, what should [X] correspond to?
question.zh:
2022年北京冬奥会举行期间，氢燃料客车、纯电动汽车成为承担此次冬奥会交通出行任务的最主要力量，新能源车辆的使用比例为历届冬奥会之最。所示是氢燃料公交车在平直路面行驶时的情景，氢的热值为1.4×10^8J/kg。求：


质量为[X]的氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量是多少？参数末温的值为55 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [氢燃料质量] = [氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]/[氢的热值]
en: [mass of hydrogen fuel] = [ heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen fuel]/[ calorific value of hydrogen]

arguments.zh_name: 氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of hydrogen fuel

question.en:
On the morning of May 28, 2023, China's first self-developed jet airliner with independent intellectual property rights, C919, took [X] from Shanghai to Beijing, marking its first commercial passenger flight.

With the known flight distance from Shanghai to Beijing being 1178 km, find the average speed of C919 flying from Shanghai to Beijing; the initial temperature parameter is 20 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 589 km/h, what should [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
2023年5月28日上午，我国首架自行研制、拥有自主知识产权的喷气式客机C919，甲，历时[X]从上海到北京，开启了首次商业载客飞行。

已知上海到北京航程为1178km，求C919由上海飞往北京的平均速度；参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是589 km/h，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [时间] = [路程]/[平均速度]
en: [ Time] = [Distance]/[ Average Speed]

question.en: In 2023, there was a bountiful harvest of garlic sprouts, and vehicles purchasing garlic sprouts could be seen everywhere on both sides of the rural roads. As shown, a truck with a self-weight of 2.8t, loaded with 2.2t of garlic sprouts, is parked on a level rural road, with the total contact area between the wheels and the ground being 0.2m^2. The driver spent 4 hours transporting the garlic sprouts to a cold storage 256 km away from this place, consuming [X] fuel. It is known that the density of diesel is 0.85×10^3kg/m^3, and the calorific value of diesel is 4.3×10³J/kg, with g taken as 110N/kg. Find the heat released by the complete combustion of [X] diesel. The actual voltage value of the parameter is 3.3 V. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 1.462×10^5 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh: 2023年蒜薹大丰收，乡间道路两侧随处可见收购蒜薹的车辆。所示，自重2.8t的货车装载收购的2.2t蒜薹停在水平乡间公路上，车轮与地面总接触面积为0.2m^2，司机用时4h将蒜薹运到距离此地256km的冷库，耗油[X]。已知柴油的密度为0.85×10^3kg/m^3，柴油的热值为4.3×10³J/kg，g取110N/kg。求：[X]柴油完全燃烧释放的热量。参数实际电压的值为3.3 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.462×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [柴油质量] = [柴油完全燃烧释放的热量]/[柴油热值]
[柴油体积] = [柴油质量]/[柴油密度]
en: [ diesel mass] = [ heat released by complete combustion of diesel]/[ diesel calorific value]
[ diesel volume] = [ diesel mass]/[diesel density]

arguments.zh_name: 柴油完全燃烧释放的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of diesel

question.en:
A certain fluorescent table lamp has a label indicating "rated power [X], rated current 0.05A". When the lamp is normally lit, find:
The voltage across the lamp; the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know the answer to the above question is 220 V, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
某种荧光台灯铭牌上标有“额定功率[X]额定电流0.05A”的字样。当台灯正常发光时，求：
台灯两端的电压；参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是220 V，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [额定功率] = [台灯两端的电压]*[额定电流]
en: [Rated power] = [ voltage across the desk lamp]*[ rated current]

question.en:
To improve student living conditions, a school installed 100 fast-heating electric water heaters of a certain brand in student dormitories. The nameplate of the electric water heater indicates: heating power 4400W, insulation power 100W, water tank capacity 25L; the internal structure is shown in diagram A, R_1 and R_2 are heating elements inside the heating plate in the water tank. After the water tank is filled with water, switch S_1 is closed to start heating. When the water temperature rises to 40°C, the temperature control switch S_2 automatically switches to the insulation state. To understand the performance of this electric water heater, the students conducted the following exploration. Please assist in completing it:
What is the resistance value of R_2? [Voltage of the power supply]=[X] parameter with the terminal temperature value of 100°C. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 11 Ω, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
某校为改善学生生活条件，给学生宿舍安装了100台某品牌速热式电热水器，该电热水器铭牌标明：加热功率4400W，保温功率100W，水箱容积25L；内部结构甲所示，R_1、R_2是水箱中加热盘内的电热丝。水箱放满水后闭合开关S_1开始加热，当水温升高到40℃时，温控开关S_2自动切换到保温状态。同学们为弄清楚该电热水器性能，做了以下探究，请你帮助完成：
R_2的阻值多大？[电源电压]=[X]参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是11 Ω，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [(电源电压)] = -sqrt([加热功率]*[电热丝R_2的阻值])
en: [ (power supply voltage)] = -sqrt([heating power]*[ resistance of heating wire R_2])

question.en: A car has a total mass of 2 tons, traveling at a constant speed of [X] on a flat road for 20 km, consuming 1.2 kg of gasoline. The resistance encountered during the drive is 0.04 times the weight of the car. The heat value of the gasoline q = 4.6×10^7 J/kg, and g is taken as 10 N/kg. Find: the time the car travels; the heat value of natural gas is 8.4×10^7 J/m^3. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 0.2 h, what should [X] be in the question?
question.zh: 一辆小汽车的总质量为2t，在平直公路上以[X]的速度匀速行驶了20km，消耗了1.2kg汽油，汽车在行驶过程中受到的阻力是车重的0.04倍。汽油的热值q=4.6×10^7J/kg，g取10N/kg。求：汽车行驶的时间；参数天然气的热值的值为8.4×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.2 h，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [速度] = [路程]/[时间]
en: [ speed] = [distance]/[ time]

question.en: When heating water on a stove, 10 kg of water is heated from 20°C to [X], burning 0.5 kg of coke. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of coke is 3.0×10^7 J/kg. Find: What is the heat absorbed by the water? The volume of natural gas is 1.2 m^3. If we already know the answer to the above question is 3.36×10^6 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh: 用炉子烧水时，将10kg的水从20℃加热到[X]，燃烧了0.5kg的焦炭。水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），焦炭的热值是3.0×10^7J/kg。试求：水吸收的热量是多少？参数天然气体积的值为1.2 m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是3.36×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水升高的温度]
en: [ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature rise of water]

question.en: A school in Zoucheng provides hot water for students, using a boiler to heat 200 liters of water from [X] to 100°C, consuming 6 kg of anthracite coal. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of anthracite coal is 3.4×10^7 J/kg. Find: What is the efficiency of this boiler? (Keep the result to one decimal place) The density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 30.9%, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
邹城某中学为学生供应开水，用锅炉将200L的水从[X]加热到100℃，燃烧了6kg的无烟煤。水的比热容是4.2×10^3J／（kg·℃），无烟煤的热值是3.4×10^7J／kg。求：
此锅炉的效率是多少?（结果保留一位小数）水的密度为1.0×10^3kg/m^3参数时间的值为1 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是30.9 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水的体积]
[无烟煤完全燃烧放出的热量]=[无烟煤的质量]×[无烟煤的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [无烟煤完全燃烧放出的热量]*[锅炉效率]
[水温升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水温升高的温度]
en: [ mass of water]=[density of water]×[ volume of water]
[ heat released by complete combustion of anthracite]=[ mass of anthracite]×[ calorific value of anthracite]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of anthracite]*[ boiler efficiency]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.zh_name: 无烟煤完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of anthracite

question.en: Mr. Zhao purchased a Honor phone and a power bank released by Huawei. The normal operating voltage of the phone is [X] and the operating current is about 10mA; the maximum capacity of the power bank is 10A•h, the input voltage is 6V, and both input and output efficiency are 80%. The input power while charging the power bank is 3W: What is the rated power of the phone in watts? The mass of water is 2.5 kg. If the answer to the above question is known to be 0.05W, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
赵老师购买了华为公司推出的荣耀手机和充电宝，手机正常工作电压[X]，工作电流约10mA；充电宝的最大容量为10A•h，输入电压为6V，充电宝输入输出效率均为80%，给充电宝充电时的输入功率为3W：
手机的额定功率为多少W？参数水的质量的值为2.5 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.05 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [正常工作电压] = [手机的额定功率]/[工作电流]
en: [Normal operating voltage] = [ rated power of the mobile phone]/[ operating current]

arguments.en_name: rated power of the mobile phone

question.en:
The global number of cars in operation is rapidly increasing, having surpassed 1 billion (10^9) vehicles. If each car consumes 5 kg of fuel daily and the calorific value of the fuel is 4.6×10^7 J/kg, find:
If a car maintains a constant speed over a distance of 46 km and experiences resistance of [X], what is the work done by the car to overcome the resistance? The mass of sand used as a parameter is 0.2 kg. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 9.2×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
全球汽车保有量在迅速增长，全球处于使用状态的汽车数量己突破10亿（10^9）辆，如果每辆汽车每天耗油量为5kg，汽油的热值为4.6×10^7J/kg：求：
如果汽车匀速行驶通过的路程是46km，受到的阻力为[X]，求汽车克服阻力做的功是多少？参数沙子的质量的值为0.2 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是9.2×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力] = [克服阻力做的功]/[路程]
en: [traction force] = [ work done to overcome resistance]/[ distance]

question.en:
To promote environmental protection, the country advocates energy conservation and emission reduction, and the "coal-to-gas" initiative is being actively carried out in rural areas. A student measures and calculates the thermal efficiency of using natural gas to boil water at home. Pour 2 kg of water into a kettle and measure the water temperature to be 20°C. Under standard atmospheric pressure, when the water is just heated to 100°C, the consumption of natural gas [X] is measured. The specific heat capacity of water is known to be 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the calorific value of the gas is 4.0×10^7 J/kg. 

Find: 
Under these conditions, how much heat is released by the complete combustion of natural gas; the parameter for heat preservation power is valued at 200 W. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.68×10^6 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
为了环保国家提倡节能减排，各地农村“煤改气”正在积极进行，某同学测量计算他们家天然气烧水的热效率。将2Kg的水倒入烧水壶中，并测出水温为20℃。在一个标准大气压下，把水刚加热到100℃时，测出消耗天然气[X]。已知水的比热容是4.2×10^3J/（kg·℃），燃气的热值是4.0×10^7J/kg
求：
在这种情况下，完全燃烧的天然气放出了多少热量；参数保温功率的值为200 W。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气的质量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [mass of natural gas] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en: Connect a small bulb to the power supply of [X], with a current of 0.2 A flowing through it. Calculate: the work done by the current in 60 seconds. The final temperature of the parameter is 100 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 36 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh: 把一只小灯泡接到[X]的电源上，通过它的电流为0.2A，求：通电60s电流所做的功。参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是36 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [电功率] = [电流做的功]/[时间]
[电压] = [电功率]/[电流]
en: [ Electric Power] = [ Work Done by Current]/[ Time]
[Voltage] = [ Electric Power]/[ Current]

question.en:
To understand and get close to nature, the school organized students for a social practice activity on Tongzhou Island. Xiao Ming brought a 1 kg alloy pot and a portable butane gas stove as shown (with a new gas bottle inside, parameters are in the table below). Curious Xiao Ming checked online via his mobile phone and found the portable gas stove's thermal efficiency is 30%, and the butane gas combustion efficiency is 90%. The boiling point of water at the camping site is 100°C, and the local water temperature was measured to be 20°C. [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), and the specific heat capacity of the pot is 0.8×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C)]. 

How many joules of heat can be released by the complete combustion of [X] kg of butane gas? The calorific value of butane gas is 9×10^7 J/kg, and the parameter for time (h) is 5 h. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.5×10^7 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the question?
question.zh:
认识自然，亲近自然，学校组织学生到桐洲岛进行社会实践活动，小明携带一个质量为1kg的合金锅、一台所示的便携式丁烷气炉(内置一瓶新的燃气，参数如表格所示)，爱探究的小明通过手机上网查到便携式燃气炉的热效率为30%，丁烷气体的燃烧效率为90%，野炊地水的沸点为100℃，测出当地水的温度为20℃，[水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，锅的比热容为0.8×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)]
完全燃烧[X]的丁烷气体可以放出多少焦耳的热量?丁烷气体的热值为9×10^7J/kg参数时间(h)的值为5 h。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.5×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [燃料质量] = [完全燃烧放出的热量]/[燃料热值]
en: [fuel mass] = [ heat released from complete combustion]/[ fuel calorific value]

question.en:
To determine the efficiency of an electric water heater with a rated power of 1000W, a physics interest group added 2kg of water to the heater, allowed it to operate normally, and plotted a graph of water temperature versus time during the heating process. Find: 
How much does the water temperature increase after 2 minutes of heating? The initial water temperature is 20℃ and the water temperature after 2 minutes of heating is [X]. The calorific value of reference coal is 3×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 10℃, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
为了测定某额定功率为1000W的电热水器的效率，物理兴趣小组的同学在热水器中加了2kg的水，让热水器正常工作，并绘制出通电加热过程中水温随时间的变化情况图，求：
加热2min，水的温度升高了多少？加热开始时的水温为20℃加热2min后的水温为[X]参数煤的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 ℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [加热2min后的水温] = [加热开始时的水温] + [水温变化量]
en: [ Temperature of water after 2 minutes of heating] = [Temperature of water at the start of heating] + [ Change in water temperature]

arguments.en_name: Temperature of water at the start of heating
Temperature of water after 2 minutes of heating

question.en: For the world's largest truck, BelAZ 75710, it is equipped with 8 tires, and the vehicle's own weight reaches 360 tons, with a load capacity of 450 tons, and a maximum speed of [X]. Please answer the following questions, taking g as 10 N/kg. What is the distance the vehicle travels at maximum speed? Set the temperature value as 75 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 10 km, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
为世界上最大的卡车别拉斯75710，安装8条轮胎，车辆自身重量达到360吨，载重量达到450吨，最高速度可达[X]。请回答下列问题，g取10N/kg。
该车辆以最高速度行驶的距离是多少？参数设定温度的值为75 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 km，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [最高速度(km/h)(m/s)] = [行驶距离]/[行驶时间(min)(s)]
en: [Maximum speed (km/h) (m/s)] = [ travel distance]/[ travel time (min) (s)]

question.en: In the experiment where Xiaohai is investigating the "melting characteristics of ice," a temperature-time relationship graph is plotted based on experimental data. Given the mass of ice is [X]. Answer the following questions based on the graph: Determine the amount of heat absorbed by water from 8 minutes to 12 minutes [c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃)]. Given that the calorific value of natural gas is 8.4×10^7 J/m^3, what should the content corresponding to [X] be if the answer to the above question is known to be 1.05×10^4 J?
question.zh: 小海在探究“冰的熔化特点”的实验中，根据实验数据绘制的温度﹣时间关系图象，已知冰的质量为[X]．根据图象解答以下几个问题：求8min到12min水吸收的热量[c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）]．参数天然气的热值的值为8.4×10^7 J/m^3。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.05×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度]=[结束时刻温度]-[起始时刻温度]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: A water heater tank contains 50 kg of water at 20°C. After being exposed to sunlight for 6 hours, the water temperature rises to [X]. How much heat is absorbed by the water? If this heat is produced by burning coal (ignoring heat loss), how many kilograms of coal need to be completely burned? (The calorific value of coal is 3×10^7 J/kg) The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), and the calorific value of coal is 3.0×10^7 J/kg. (Supplement: The density of water is 1.0×10^3 kg/m^3; the tank volume is 50×10^{-3} m^3; ) The rated voltage value of the bulb parameter is 6 V. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 0.28 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
一热水器水箱内装有50千克20℃的水，在太阳照射6小时后，水温升高到[X]，问水吸收了多少热量？若这些热量是燃烧煤产生的(不计热量损失)，则需要完全燃烧多少千克的煤？（煤的热值是3×10^7J/kg）
水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅°C)煤的热值为3.0×10^7J/kg （补充：水的密度是1.0×10^3kg/m^3; 水箱容积是50×10^{-3}m^3; ）参数灯泡额定电压的值为6 V。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.28 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量]=[水的密度]×[水箱容积]
[煤燃烧放出的热量] = [所需煤的质量]*[煤的热值]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤燃烧放出的热量]
[水升高的温度差] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[最终温度] = [初始温度] + [水升高的温度差]
en: [ mass of water]=[density of water]×[ tank volume]
[ heat released by coal combustion] = [ required mass of coal]*[ calorific value of coal]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by coal combustion]
[ temperature rise of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature rise of water]

question.en:
Jia is China's first domestically developed permanent magnet monorail train. Its highlights include the ability to make small angle turns, a high-pressure water mist fire extinguishing system, and a regenerative braking system.

When the nozzles of the high-pressure water mist system are in operation, the pressure of the water at the nozzles is p = 10 MPa, and the velocity of the sprayed mist is v ≥ 10 m/s. The total area of the nozzles is S = [X]. What is the minimum power of the nozzles in watts? (Atmospheric pressure is negligible.) The pressure of the water is 10 × 10^6 Pa, and the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2 × 10^3 J/(kg·℃). If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 5000 W, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
甲是中国自主研制的首列永磁动力单轨列车。其亮点是列车可以小角度转弯，安装有高压水雾灭火系统和制动发电装置。


当高压水雾系统中水枪工作时，水对喷孔的压强p=10MPa，水雾喷出的速度v≥10m/s，喷孔的总面积S=[X]，则水枪的功率至少为多少瓦？（不计大气压强）水的压强=10×10^6Pa参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5000 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水对喷孔的压力] = [水枪的功率]/[速度]
[喷孔的总面积] = [水对喷孔的压力]/[水的压强]
en: [ pressure of water on the nozzle] = [ power of the water gun]/[ velocity]
[ total area of nozzle] = [ pressure of water on the nozzle]/[pressure of water]

arguments.en_name: pressure of water on the nozzle

question.en: Winter is here, and the school uses a boiler to provide hot water for the students. Heating 100 kg of water from 10℃ to [X] consumes 12.6 kg of coal. [The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃), the calorific value of coal is approximately 3×10^7J/kg] Determine: the efficiency of the boiler when heating water. The value of the parameter time is 10 min. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 10%, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 冬天到了，学校利用锅炉为学生提供热水。将100kg水从10℃加热到[X]，消耗了12.6kg的煤。[水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，煤的热值约为3×10^7J/kg]求：锅炉烧水时的效率。参数时间的值为10 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是10 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [煤完全燃烧放出的热量]=[煤的热值]×[煤的质量]
[水吸收的热量] = [煤完全燃烧放出的热量]*[锅炉烧水时的效率]
[水温升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温升高的温度]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of coal]=[ calorific value of coal]×[ mass of coal]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ heat released by complete combustion of coal]*[ efficiency of the boiler when heating water]
[ temperature increase of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature increase of water]

arguments.zh_name: 煤完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of coal
efficiency of the boiler when heating water

question.en:
A kettle marked "220V [X]W" operates at its rated voltage. Calculate:
The current flowing through the kettle when it operates normally; the initial temperature parameter is 20 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.5 A, then what should the value correspond to in [X] in the problem statement?
question.zh:
一个标有“220V[X]W”的电水壶，在额定电压下工作，求：
电水壶正常工作时通过它的电流；参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.5 A，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [额定功率] = [电流]*[额定电压]
en: [ Rated Power] = [ Current]*[Rated Voltage]

question.en: Given that the resistance value of a certain fixed resistor is [X], and the current through the resistor is 0.2A. Find: the voltage U across the resistor. The mass of the parameter copper ball is 100 g. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 2 V, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh: 已知某定值电阻的阻值为[X]，通过该电阻的电流为0.2A．求：该电阻两端的电压U．参数铜球质量的值为100 g。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2 V，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [电阻阻值] = [电阻两端的电压]/[通过电阻的电流]
en: [ resistance value] = [ voltage across the resistor]/[current through the resistor]

question.en: "Garbage classification, green and environmental protection," reasonable classification and utilization of garbage can turn waste into treasure. A garbage processing plant can extract 140kg of fuel oil from 1 ton of classified garbage under certain conditions. If a community produces 3 tons of garbage daily, [the calorific value of the fuel oil q=4.0×10^7J/kg, q_coal=3×10^7J/kg, c_water=4.2×10^3J/(kg•℃)]. Calculate: If 30% of this heat is absorbed by water of initial temperature 20℃ and mass [X], how much does the water's temperature rise? (Supplement: The heat absorbed by water is 5.04×10^9J; The calorific value of alcohol is 3×10^7 J/kg.) If the known answer to the above problem is a temperature rise of 12℃, what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
“垃圾分类，绿色环保”，合理分类并利用垃圾可以变废为宝。某垃圾处理厂处理垃圾时，在一定条件下，1t分类后的垃圾能“榨”出140kg燃料油。若某小区每天产生3t垃圾，[该燃料油的热值q=4.0×10^7J/kg，q_煤=3×10^7J/kg，c_水=4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃）]。求：
若这些热量有30%被初温为20℃、质量为[X]的水吸收，则水的温度升高多少。若这些热量有30%被初温为20℃、质量为[X]的水吸收 （补充：水吸热的热量是5.04×10^9J; ）参数酒精的热值的值为3×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是12℃，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的质量] = [水吸热的热量]/([水温升高量]*[水的比热容])
en: [mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature increase of water]*[ specific heat capacity of water])

question.en: A car undergoes a traffic test on a newly built bridge that is 50 km long. The car has a total mass of 1.5 tons, moving at a constant speed [X] across the bridge, facing a resistance force equal to 0.08 times its total weight, consuming 4 kg of gasoline for the whole journey. Given g as 10 N/kg, determine the time taken for the car to cross the bridge; the parameter value for the mass of water is 100 kg. If the known answer to this question is 0.5 hours, what should be the value of [X] in the problem?
question.zh:
一辆汽车为50km长的新建大桥进行通车测试，所示．汽车总质量为1.5t，以[X]的速度匀速通过大桥，受到的阻力是总重的0.08倍，全程消耗了4kg的汽油．g取10N/kg，求汽车通过大桥；

所需的时间；参数水的质量的值为100 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.5 h，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [速度] = [路程]/[时间]
en: [ Speed] = [Distance]/[ Time]

question.en:
In order to provide Mingming with a comfortable study and living environment at home, his mother bought a new Kelon brand wall-mounted air conditioner. After careful observation, Mingming found the nameplate parameters of the air conditioner as shown in the table: Question:
If the actual voltage during peak electricity usage is 200V, what is the actual consumed electrical power in watts? (Round the result to the nearest integer) The rated voltage is 220V, the rated power is [X], and the parameter's last temperature value is 100 ℃. If we already know the answer to the above question is 909 W, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the question?
question.zh:
妈妈为了让明明在家里有一个舒适的学习和生活环境，新买了一台科龙牌挂式空调机，细心的明明观察后发现这台空调的铭牌参数如下表所示：请问：
如果这台空调在用电高峰期时的实际电压是200V，那么实际消耗的电功率是多少瓦?(结果保留整数)额定电压为220V额定功率为[X]参数末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是909 W，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [空调的电阻] = [实际电压]^2/[空调实际消耗的电功率]
[额定功率] = [额定电压]^2/[空调的电阻]
en: [ resistance of the air conditioner] = [ actual voltage]^2/[ actual electric power consumed by the air conditioner]
[ rated power] = [Rated voltage]^2/[ resistance of the air conditioner]

arguments.zh_name: 空调实际消耗的电功率
arguments.en_name: actual electric power consumed by the air conditioner

question.en:
A household gas water heater heats 100 kg of water from 20°C to 70°C, consuming a volume of [X] of natural gas (assuming complete combustion of natural gas). The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C), and the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/m^3. 

Find: 
The heat released by the complete combustion of natural gas; the time parameter value is 2 min. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^7 J, what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the question?
question.zh:
某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg，温度为20℃的水加热到70℃，消耗天然气体积为[X]（假设天然气完全燃烧）。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/（kg•℃），天然气的热值为4.2×10^7J/m^3。
求：
天然气完全燃烧放出的热量；参数时间的值为2 min。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [消耗天然气体积] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [Volume of natural gas consumed] = [ Heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ Calorific value of natural gas]

arguments.zh_name: 天然气完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: Heat released by complete combustion of natural gas

question.en:
A household gas water heater heats 20 kg of water from [X] to 60°C, completely burning 0.2625 kg of gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C), the calorific value of the gas is 4×10^7 J/m^3, and the density of the gas is 1.25 kg/m^3. Calculate: 
What is the heat absorbed by the water? The calorific value of dry firewood is 1.2×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 4.2×10^6 J, what should [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
某家庭用的燃气热水器，将20kg的水从[X]加热到60℃，完全燃烧了0.2625kg的煤气。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃)，煤气的热值为4×10^7J/m^3，煤气的密度为1.25kg/m^3。请求出：
水吸收的热量是多少？参数干木柴的热值的值为1.2×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是4.2×10^6 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[初温] = [末温] - [水的温度变化量]
en: [ change in water temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ mass of water])
[ initial temperature] = [ final temperature] - [ change in water temperature]

question.en: Xiao Ming uses the home's electric shower to heat [X] of water from 20°C to 50°C, and it is found that the change in the home's electricity meter reading is 2 kW·h (no other electrical appliances are in use during this time). Given the specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), find the thermal efficiency of the electric shower during this process. (Supplement: The electric energy consumed by the shower (converted) is 7.2×10^6 J; ) The calorific value of coke is 3.0×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above problem is 87.5%, then what should be the content corresponding to [X] in the problem?
question.zh: 小明用家中电热淋浴器将[X]的水，从20°C加热到50°C，发现家中电能表的示数变化了2kW·h（此段时间内家中其他用电器均没有工作）。已知水的比热容c_水=4.2×10^3J/(kg·°C)，求此过程中：电热淋浴器的热效率。 （补充：电热淋浴器消耗的电能(转换后)是7.2×10^6J; ）参数焦炭的热值的值为3.0×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是87.5 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量]=[末温]-[初温]
[水吸收的热量] = [电热淋浴器消耗的电能(转换后)]*[电热淋浴器的热效率]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的温度变化量])
en: [ temperature change of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ heat absorbed by water] = [ electrical energy consumed by electric water heater (converted)]*[ thermal efficiency of electric water heater]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity of water]*[ temperature change of water])

arguments.zh_name: 电热淋浴器消耗的电能(转换后)
arguments.en_name: electrical energy consumed by electric water heater (converted)
thermal efficiency of electric water heater

question.en:
When water is heated with a gas stove, the water with a mass of [X] and an initial temperature of 25℃ is heated to 75℃, consuming a total of 0.06 m^3 of gas, assuming complete combustion of the gas. Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅℃) and the calorific value of the gas is approximately 4.2×10^7 J/m^3, find: 

How much heat is absorbed by the water? The value of the area of the parameter collector is 2 m². If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem?
question.zh:
用煤气灶烧水时，把质量为[X]、初温为25℃的水加热到75℃，共燃烧了0.06m^3煤气，设煤气完全燃烧。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅℃），煤气的热值约为4.2×10^7J/m^3，求：
水吸收的热量是多少？参数集热器面积的值为2 m²。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水升高的温度]=[末温]-[初温]
[水的质量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水升高的温度]*[水的比热容])
en: [ temperature rise of water]=[ final temperature]-[ initial temperature]
[ mass of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ temperature rise of water]*[specific heat capacity of water])

question.en:
The mass of China's 99A main battle tank reaches 5×10^4 kg, and the maximum power of the engine is [X]. During a mission, the tank travels on a straight road at maximum power over a distance of 3000 m in 300 s. Given that the calorific value of diesel oil is q=4×10^7 J/kg, find:  

During the above journey, a total of 25 kg of diesel is consumed. What is the efficiency of the engine? The volume of water is valued at 10 dm³. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 33%, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
我国99A主战坦克的质量达5×10^4kg，发动机的最大功率是[X]，某次执行任务时，该坦克在平直公路上以最大功率匀速行驶3000m用时300s，已知柴油的热值q=4×10^7J/kg，求：
在上述行驶过程中共消耗25kg柴油，则发动机的效率是多少？参数水的体积的值为10 dm³。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是33 %，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [燃料完全燃烧释放的热量]=[燃料质量]×[热值]
[发动机做的有用功] = [发动机的效率]*[燃料完全燃烧释放的热量]
[功率] = [发动机做的有用功]/[时间]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of fuel]=[ fuel mass]×[ calorific value]
[ useful work done by the engine] = [ engine efficiency]*[ heat released by complete combustion of fuel]
[Power] = [ useful work done by the engine]/[ time]

arguments.en_name: useful work done by the engine

arguments.zh_name: 燃料完全燃烧释放的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of fuel

question.en: A model of electric heating cup can be heated using car power source [X] or connected to household circuit, its main parameters are listed in the table below. Find: Rated voltage for car use [X] Rated voltage for household use 220V Rated power for car use 120W Rated power for household use 2200W If used in a car circuit, what are the current and resistance of the cup when it works normally? Assuming the mass of water is 100 kg, what should the value corresponding to [X] be, given the answer to the above question is 1.2 Ω?
question.zh: 某款电热杯，它可以用车载[X]电源加热或接在家庭电路进行加热，它的主要参数如表所示，求： 车载额定电压 [X] 家用额定电压 220V 车载额定功率 120W 家用额定功率 2200W 如果在车载电路中使用，电热杯正常工作时的电流和电阻各为多少？参数水的质量的值为100 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.2 Ω，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [车载额定电压] = -sqrt([车载电路中电热杯的电阻]*[车载额定功率])
en: [Rated voltage of the vehicle] = -sqrt([ Resistance of the electric heating cup in the vehicle circuit]*[ Rated power of the vehicle])

arguments.en_name: Operating current of the electric heating cup in the vehicle circuit

arguments.zh_name: 车载电路中电热杯的电阻
arguments.en_name: Resistance of the electric heating cup in the vehicle circuit

question.en: A 1 kg mass of water experiences a temperature increase of [X]. Determine the absorbed heat Q_abs.[c_water = 4.2×10^3 J/(kg•°C)]. The outlet area parameter is given as 50 cm². If it is already known that the answer to the above problem is 8.4×10^4 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 质量为1千克的水温度升高了[X]，求吸收的热量Q_吸.[c_水=4.2×10^3焦/（千克•℃）].参数出水口面积的值为50 cm²。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([比热容]*[质量])
en: [ change in temperature] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([specific heat capacity]*[ mass])

question.en:
A pot made of aluminum with a mass of 0.5 kg contains 5 kg of water at 20°C. They are heated together, and their temperature increases by [X] after absorbing heat. Find:  
How much heat did the aluminum pot absorb? The specific heat capacity of aluminum is 0.88×10^3 J/(kg·°C). The calorific value of gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 2.2×10^4 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
一个质量为0.5kg的铝壶里面装有5kg、20℃的水，现将它们一起加热，吸收热量后它们的温度升高了[X]．求：
铝壶吸收了多少热量？铝的比热容为0.88×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数汽油的热值的值为4.5×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2.2×10^4 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [铝壶的温度变化量] = [铝壶吸收的热量]/([铝壶质量]*[铝的比热容])
en: [ temperature change of the aluminum kettle] = [ heat absorbed by the aluminum kettle]/([mass of the aluminum kettle]*[ specific heat capacity of aluminum])

arguments.en_name: temperature change of the aluminum kettle
heat absorbed by the aluminum kettle

question.en: Alcohol is a commonly used fuel in laboratories, and now an alcohol lamp is used to heat water. Assuming 50% of the heat generated by the complete combustion of alcohol is absorbed, if 500g of water at 20°C is heated to [X], find the heat absorbed by the water; the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·°C), and the heat value of gasoline is 5.0×10^7 J/kg. If we already know the answer to the above question is 1.68×10^5 J, then what should [X] correspond to in the problem?
question.zh:
酒精是实验室里常用的燃料，现用酒精灯来加热水，若酒精完全燃烧产生的热量有50%被吸收，现在把500g、20℃的水加热到[X]，求
水吸收的热量；水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)参数汽油热值的值为5.0×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.68×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水的温度变化量] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水的温度变化量]
en: [ temperature change of water] = [ heat absorbed by water]/([ specific heat capacity of water]*[mass of water])
[ final temperature] = [ initial temperature] + [ temperature change of water]

question.en: The hydrogen-gasoline engine uses hydrogen and gasoline as two fuels, allowing for free switching between them. The calorific values of hydrogen and gasoline are q_{hydrogen} = 1.5×10^8 J/kg and q_{gasoline} = 4.5×10^7 J/kg, respectively. A driver operates a car with the above engine on a straight road from location A to location B, with a distance of 225 km between them. At departure, the gasoline tank contains 25 kg of gasoline. Assume complete combustion of both hydrogen and gasoline in the engine cylinder, and that the resistance encountered by the car during travel is constant. The energy output from the engine is entirely used to drive the car. The journey consists of two phases: Phase 1: The car uses hydrogen fuel, departing from location A, and travels at a constant speed of 25 m/s for 1 hour to reach location C. During this time, the power of the car's driving force is 20 kW, and the engine efficiency when using hydrogen fuel is [X]; Phase 2: Starting from location C, due to hydrogen deficiency, the driver switches to gasoline as the fuel. The car continues to travel at a constant speed of 25 m/s and reaches location B with 15 kg of gasoline remaining in the tank. Find: the mass of hydrogen fuel consumed in Phase 1; (Supplement: the driving force power is 20×10^3 W; ) the initial temperature parameter is 20 °C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 0.96 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
氢气﹣汽油发动机采用氢气和汽油两种燃料工作，可进行自由切换，氢气和汽油的热值分别取q_{氢气}=1.5×10^8J/kg、q_{汽油}=4.5×10^7J/kg。某司机驾驶使用上述发动机的轿车沿平直公路从甲地至乙地，甲、乙两地相距225km，出发时油箱内汽油的质量25kg。设氢气和汽油在气缸内均完全燃烧，轿车行驶中所受阻力恒定，发动机输出的能量全部用来驱动轿车行驶，全程分两个阶段，所示：阶段一：轿车使用氢燃料从甲地出发，以25m/s的速度匀速行驶1h到达丙地，此过程中轿车牵引力的功率为20kW，在使用氢燃料的情况下，轿车发动机的效率为[X]；阶段二：从丙地开始，由于氢气不足，司机切换汽油为燃料，轿车仍以25m/s的速度匀速行驶，到达乙地油箱内汽油的质量还剩15kg。求：
阶段一中消耗的氢燃料的质量； （补充：牵引力功率是20×10^3W; ）参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是0.96 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [阶段一有用功]=[牵引力功率]×[时间]
[消耗氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量] = [氢气的热值]*[消耗氢燃料的质量]
[发动机效率] = [阶段一有用功]/[消耗氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量]
en: [ stage one useful work]=[traction power]×[ time]
[ heat released by complete combustion of consumed hydrogen fuel] = [ calorific value of hydrogen]*[ mass of consumed hydrogen fuel]
[ engine efficiency] = [ stage one useful work]/[ heat released by complete combustion of consumed hydrogen fuel]

arguments.zh_name: 消耗氢燃料完全燃烧放出的热量
arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of consumed hydrogen fuel

question.en: To improve the learning environment, the school installed a Changhong air conditioner with a rated voltage of [X] and a rated power of 1210W in each of the 20 classrooms. Find: the rated current of the air conditioner; the calorific value of the parameter gasoline is 4.5×10^7 J/kg. If we already know that the answer to the above problem is 5.5 A, then what should the value corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh:
为改善学习环境，学校在全部20间教室各安装了一台额定电压为[X]、额定功率为1210W的长虹空调。求：
空调的额定电流大小；参数汽油的热值的值为4.5×10^7 J/kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是5.5 A，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [额定电压] = [额定功率]/[空调的额定电流]
en: [ rated voltage] = [Rated power]/[ rated current of the air conditioner]

arguments.en_name: rated current of the air conditioner

question.en: A household gas water heater heats tap water with a mass of 100kg and a temperature of 20℃ to [X], consuming a natural gas volume of 1m^3 (assuming complete combustion of the natural gas). Given that the specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃) and the calorific value of natural gas is 3.2×10^7 J/m^3. Determine: the heat absorbed by the water; the parameter gasoline volume value is 30 L. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 1.26×10^7 J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] be?
question.zh: 某家庭用燃气热水器将质量为100kg，温度为20℃的自来水加热到[X]，消耗的天然气体积为1m^3(假设天然气完全燃烧)。已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg·℃)，天然气的热值为3.2×10^7J/m^3。求：水吸收的热量；参数汽油体积的值为30 L。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是1.26×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [水温升高的温度] = [水吸收的热量]/([水的比热容]*[水的质量])
[末温] = [初温] + [水温升高的温度]
en: [ Temperature increase of water] = [ Heat absorbed by water]/([Specific heat capacity of water]*[ Mass of water])
[ Final temperature] = [ Initial temperature] + [ Temperature increase of water]

question.en:
A sightseeing car powered by gasoline travels at a constant speed of 36 km/h along a mountain road (approximated as an inclined plane), taking 15 minutes to reach the top from the base. The traction force obtained along the road when the car is ascending is constant [X]. Find:  
What is the work done by the traction force when the car is climbing in joules? The final temperature of the water is 100 °C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.28×10^7 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
某辆以汽油为燃料的观光汽车沿盘山公路（盘山公路近似处理为斜面），以36km/h的速度匀速行驶，经过15min从山脚到达山顶。汽车上山时沿路面获得的牵引力恒为[X]。求：
汽车上山时牵引力做的功是多少J？参数水的末温的值为100 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.28×10^7 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [行驶距离]=[速度]×[时间]
[牵引力] = [牵引力做的功]/[行驶距离]
en: [ travel distance]=[speed]×[ time]
[ traction force] = [ work done by the traction force]/[ travel distance]

arguments.en_name: work done by the traction force

question.en:
The C919 large passenger aircraft shown is China's first civil trunk airliner with independent intellectual property rights developed according to the latest international airworthiness standards, and its development began in 2008. In 2019, three C919 aircraft will complete their first flight tests. During a test flight, the horizontal thrust of the aircraft engine is 1.6×10^5 N, and the aircraft cruises at a constant horizontal speed of 600 km/h [X], consuming 4000 kg of aviation kerosene. Find [X] in: (The calorific value of aviation kerosene is 4×10^7 J/kg)

The work done by the engine. The parameter value for the mass of water is 50 kg. If we already know that the answer to the above question is 9.6×10^{10} J, then what should the content corresponding to [X] in the question be?
question.zh:
所示的C919大型客机，是中国首款按照最新国际适航标准，具有自主知识产权的干线民用飞机，于2008年开始研制。2019年将有三架C919飞机完成首次飞行试验。某次试飞时，飞机发动机的水平推力为1.6×10^5N，飞机以600km/h的速度沿水平方向匀速航行[X]，消耗航空煤油4000kg。求[X]内：（航空煤油的热值为4×10^7J/kg）


发动机所做的功。参数水的质量的值为50 kg。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是9.6×10^{10} J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [路程] = [发动机所做的功]/[水平推力]
[时间] = [路程]/[速度]
en: [ distance] = [ work done by the engine]/[horizontal thrust]
[ time] = [ distance]/[ velocity]

question.en: SAIC Maxus FCV80 is the first domestic fuel cell light passenger vehicle model using a new access standard. It replaces petroleum with hydrogen as fuel and uses a fuel cell instead of an engine. In the fuel cell, hydrogen reacts with oxygen to produce electric energy. Its power can reach [X], and the cruising range can reach 500 km. The hydrogen storage capacity of the onboard hydrogen tank is 6.2 kg. The calorific value of hydrogen is 1.4×10^8 J/kg. If the vehicle travels at a uniform speed with maximum power, the speed can reach 108 km/h. What is the resistance experienced by the vehicle at this time? (Note: The power is [X]; ) The initial temperature value is 20 ℃. If we have already known the answer to the above question is 2500 N, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
上汽大通FCV80是国内第一款运用全新准入标准的燃料电池轻客车型，它是用氢气代替石油作为燃料，用燃料电池代替发动机，氢气在燃料电池中与氧气发生反应产生电能据悉，其功率可达[X]，续航里程可达500km。已知车载储氢罐的氢存储量为6.2kg氢气的热值为1.4×10^8J/kg。
若该车以最大功率匀速行驶时，速度可达108km/h，此时该车所受的阻力是多大？ （补充：功率是[X]; ）参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是2500 N，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [牵引力] = [阻力]
[功率] = [原始速度]*[牵引力]
en: [ Traction] = [ Resistance]
[Power] = [ Initial Velocity]*[ Traction]

question.en: As people's living standards are increasingly improving, cars are increasingly becoming part of households. A car using gasoline as fuel, driving at a constant speed of 72 km/h on a horizontal road, has an actual engine power of 20 kW. If the car travels a distance of [X] and the calorific value of gasoline q = 4.6×10^7 J/kg, with the engine efficiency of the car being 25%, find the mass of gasoline consumed during this journey. The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃). Given that the answer to the above problem is 8.7 kg, what should the content corresponding to [X] be in the problem statement?
question.zh: 随着人们生活水平的日益提高，小汽车越来越多地走进了百姓人家．一辆使用汽油为燃料的小汽车，以72km／h的速度在水平路面上匀速行驶时，发动机的实际功率为20kW．若小汽车行驶的距离为[X]，汽油的热值q=4.6×10^7J／kg，小汽车发动机的效率为25％．求小汽车在这段路程中：消耗汽油的质量．参数水的比热容的值为4.2×10^3 J/(kg·℃)。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.7 kg，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量] = [汽油的热值]*[消耗汽油的质量]
[发动机做的功] = [汽油完全燃烧放出的热量]*[热机效率]
[时间] = [发动机做的功]/[功率]
[路程] = [时间]*[速度]
en: [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline] = [ calorific value of gasoline]*[ mass of gasoline consumed]
[ work done by the engine] = [ heat released by complete combustion of gasoline]*[ heat engine efficiency]
[ time] = [ work done by the engine]/[ power]
[distance] = [ time]*[ speed]

arguments.en_name: heat released by complete combustion of gasoline

question.en:
A gas stove is used to heat 2 kg of water from an initial temperature of 30°C to 80°C, consuming [X] of natural gas. (The specific heat capacity of water is 4.2×10^3 J/(kg⋅°C); the calorific value of natural gas is 4.2×10^7 J/kg.) Find: 
The heat released by the complete combustion of the natural gas; (Supplementary: The mass of the natural gas is [X];) The value of the initial temperature parameter is 20°C. If we already know the answer to the above question is 8.4×10^5 J, what should the content corresponding to [X] in the problem be?
question.zh:
用天然气灶将质量为2kg、初温为30°C的水加热到80°C，消耗了[X]天然气。（已知水的比热容为4.2×10^3J/(kg⋅°C)；天然气的热值为4.2×10^7J/kg）求：
天然气完全燃烧放出的热量； （补充：天然气的质量是[X]; ）参数初温的值为20 ℃。如果我们已经知道上述问题的答案是8.4×10^5 J，那么题目中[X]对应的内容应该是什么？

zh: [天然气的质量] = [天然气完全燃烧放出的热量]/[天然气的热值]
en: [mass of natural gas] = [ heat released by complete combustion of natural gas]/[ calorific value of natural gas]
